```tsx
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { IMPORT_RULES, ImportView, type ImportLineView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ImportStart } from "../src/app/settings/import/index";
import { ImportStateView } from "../src/app/settings/import/[id]";
import { PostList } from "../src/components/import/PostList";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, ruleWords } from "../src/lib/import-words";
import { formatBytes } from "../src/lib/imports";
import { utcDay } from "../src/lib/time";
import { TITLE_WORDS, UI_WORDS, fill } from "../src/lib/ui-words";

/**
 * The import's screens (3b design, sections 10.1 to 10.5 and 10.9; Task 7): the start, each state's view of one import,
 * and the list of posts, server-rendered with made-up imports in every state and read as HTML, which is what a screen
 * reader gets: each view's level-2 heading, its words, its controls' names and states, its links. What a static render
 * cannot show (the poll, the upload, a press, the focus moving to the heading) is held by lib/imports.ts's own test and by
 * the source; the browser check walks it.
 */
const SRC = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "src");
const read = (...parts: string[]): string => readFileSync(path.join(SRC, ...parts), "utf8");

const session = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  state: {
    status: "signed-in",
    me: { user: { id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada Lovelace" }, standing: null },
  } as unknown,
}));
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  Redirect: () => null,
  router: { push: () => undefined, replace: () => undefined, back: () => undefined, canGoBack: () => false },
  useLocalSearchParams: () => ({}),
  usePathname: () => "/settings/import",
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ state: session.state, refresh: async () => session.state }) }));
vi.mock("expo-image", async () => {
  const { createElement } = await import("react");
  return { Image: ({ source, accessibilityLabel }: { source: { uri: string }; accessibilityLabel: string }) => createElement("img", { "data-uri": source.uri, alt: accessibilityLabel }) };
});
vi.mock("@/components/toast", () => ({ toast: { show: vi.fn() }, Toaster: () => null }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const textOf = (markup: string): string =>
  markup
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
const tags = (markup: string): string[] => markup.match(/<[a-z0-9]+\b[^>]*>/g) ?? [];
const withRole = (markup: string, role: string): string[] => tags(markup).filter((tag) => tag.includes(`role="${role}"`));
function attr(tag: string, name: string): string | null {
  const at = tag.indexOf(` ${name}="`);
  if (at < 0) return null;
  const from = at + name.length + 3;
  return tag.slice(from, tag.indexOf('"', from)).replace(/&#x27;/g, "'").replace(/&amp;/g, "&");
}
const hrefs = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/<a\b[^>]*\bhref="([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]!.replace(/&amp;/g, "&"));
/** The text of every button, read up to the first closing div, as the other screen tests read it. */
const buttons = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/<(?:div|button)\b[^>]*\brole="button"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/(?:div|button)>/g)].map((match) => textOf(match[1]!));
/** Every heading's level and words, in order. */
const headings = (markup: string): [number, string][] => [...markup.matchAll(/<h([1-6])\b[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h\1>/g)].map((match) => [Number(match[1]), textOf(match[2]!)]);

const ID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000801";
const W = IMPORT_WORDS;

/** An import of `status`, in the view's shape, with what each test changes. */
function view(status: ImportView["status"], extra: Partial<ImportView> = {}): ImportView {
  return ImportView.parse({
    id: ID,
    source: "mastodon",
    status,
    createdAt: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.000Z",
    endedAt: null,
    declaredBytes: 840_000_000,
    receivedBytes: 0,
    chunkBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes,
    failure: null,
    stopReason: null,
    endedByStaff: null,
    staffDecisionId: null,
    scan: null,
    samples: [],
    choice: null,
    picks: [],
    progress: { imagesTotal: 0, imagesSettled: 0, postsTotal: 0, postsPublished: 0, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 0, imagesLeftOut: {} },
    paused: false,
    refusalId: null,
    refusedAt: null,
    refusedWords: null,
    undoable: false,
    ...extra,
  });
}

/** A scan with replies, long posts and warnings, posts and images left out, cleaned characters and replaced links. */
const SCAN = {
  posts: 1240,
  images: 300,
  skipped: { repost: 120, not_public: 40, poll: 3 },
  imagesSkipped: { video: 12 },
  cleaned: 4,
  warnings: 6,
  sourceLinks: 7,
  protectedPosts: 0,
  readInPart: false,
  months: [
    { month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 900, 250, 50], [1, 200, 30, 0], [4, 6, 0, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] },
    { month: "2021-05", groups: [[0, 132, 20, 0], [2, 2, 0, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] },
  ],
  first: "2019-03",
  last: "2021-05",
  fromRef: 0,
};
const READY = view("ready", { declaredBytes: 840_000_000, receivedBytes: 840_000_000, scan: SCAN, samples: [{ at: "2019-03-03", text: "Morning, @ada: the ferries run late https://example.org/a" }] });
const ME = { displayName: "Ada Lovelace", handle: "ada" };

const state = (v: ImportView, extra: Partial<Parameters<typeof ImportStateView>[0]> = {}) => html(<ImportStateView view={v} author={ME} onView={() => undefined} {...extra} />);

    failure.partial_archive failure.encrypted failure.too_many_entries failure.too_large_uncompressed failure.bad_entry_name failure.unreadable

    expect(W["import.label.a11y"]).toBe("Imported from {source}, dated {date}. About imported posts");

describe("the start (10.2)", () => {
  const LIST = [view("ready", { scan: SCAN }), view("undone", { id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000802", source: "x", createdAt: "2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z" })];

  test("the two sentences of decision 28, then Where from? as a radio group of the sources the site has on, each with its line", () => {
    const out = html(<ImportStart sources={["x", "mastodon"]} imports={[]} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const key of ["import.intro", "import.found", "import.unchecked"] as const) expect(text).toContain(W[key]);
    expect(headings(out)).toContainEqual([2, W["import.whereFrom"]]);
    const group = withRole(out, "radiogroup");
    expect(group).toHaveLength(1);
    const labelled = attr(group[0]!, "aria-labelledby")!;
    expect(out).toMatch(new RegExp(`<h2[^>]*id="${labelled}"[^>]*>${W["import.whereFrom"]}`));
    const radios = withRole(out, "radio");
    expect(radios).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(text).toContain(W["import.source.x"]);
    expect(text).toContain(W["import.source.x.desc"]);
    expect(text).toContain(W["import.source.mastodon.desc"]);
    // Bluesky only when the owner turned it on.
    expect(text).not.toContain(W["import.source.bluesky"]);
    expect(textOf(html(<ImportStart sources={["x", "mastodon", "bluesky"]} imports={[]} />))).toContain(W["import.source.bluesky.desc"]);
    // Before a source is chosen, nothing about one source and no archive to choose.
    expect(text).not.toContain(W["import.how.title"]);
    expect(buttons(out)).not.toContain(W["import.choose"]);
  });

  test("a chosen source says how to get its archive in numbered steps, what korbat reads and never reads, the transit and what may be trimmed", () => {
    const out = html(<ImportStart sources={["x", "mastodon"]} imports={[]} initialSource="x" />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(withRole(out, "radio").map((tag) => attr(tag, "aria-checked"))).toEqual(["true", "false"]);
    expect(headings(out).map(([, words]) => words)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([W["import.how.title"], W["import.reads.title"], W["import.never.title"]]));
    // The steps are a list, one item a step, each with its number drawn beside it.
    const items = [...out.matchAll(/<li\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/li>/g)].map((match) => textOf(match[1]!));
    expect(items).toEqual(["1. On X, open Settings, Your account, Download an archive of your data.", "2. Confirm your password there, on X.", "3. X emails you when the archive is ready, which can take a few days.", "4. Download the .zip file."]);
    for (const key of ["import.reads.body", "import.never.x", "import.transit", "import.trim.x"] as const) expect(text).toContain(W[key]);
    expect(text).not.toContain(W["import.never.mastodon"]);
    expect(buttons(out)).toContain(W["import.choose"]);
  });

  test("Your imports lists the account's imports as links to their screens, by source, state in words and day; none, no list", () => {
    const out = html(<ImportStart sources={["x", "mastodon"]} imports={LIST} />);
    expect(headings(out)).toContainEqual([2, W["import.yours"]]);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([`/settings/import/${ID}`, "/settings/import/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000802"]));
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(fill(W["import.row"], { state: W["import.state.ready"], date: "27 Oct 2026" }));
    expect(text).toContain(fill(W["import.row"], { state: W["import.state.undone"], date: "20 Oct 2026" }));
    expect(textOf(html(<ImportStart sources={["x"]} imports={[]} />))).not.toContain(W["import.yours"]);
  });

  test("with no source on, it says imports are paused and offers none", () => {
    const out = html(<ImportStart sources={[]} imports={[]} />);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(W["import.unavailable"]);
    expect(withRole(out, "radio")).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("one import, drawn by its state (10.3 to 10.5)", () => {
  test("each state's view starts with a level-2 heading the screen can move the focus to", () => {
    const shown: [ImportView, string][] = [
      [view("uploading"), W["import.state.uploading"]],
      [view("scanning"), W["import.state.scanning"]],
      [READY, W["import.found.title"]],
      [view("preparing"), W["import.state.preparing"]],
      [view("publishing"), W["import.state.publishing"]],
      [view("done"), W["import.state.done"]],
      [view("stopped", { stopReason: "by_author" }), W["import.state.stopped"]],
      [view("undoing"), W["import.state.undoing"]],
      [view("undone"), W["import.state.undone"]],
      [view("failed", { failure: "encrypted" }), W["import.state.failed"]],
      [view("cancelled"), W["import.state.cancelled"]],
      [view("expired"), W["import.state.expired"]],
    ];
    for (const [v, words] of shown) {
      const out = state(v);
      expect(headings(out)[0], v.status).toEqual([2, words]);
      const tag = tags(out).find((t) => t.startsWith("<h2"))!;
      expect(attr(tag, "tabindex"), v.status).toBe("-1");
    }
  });

  test("uploading: a progress bar with the four values and its value text, the sentence, and Cancel import", () => {
    const out = state(view("uploading", { receivedBytes: 120_000_000 }), { run: { receivedBytes: 120_000_000, error: null, running: true } });
    const bar = withRole(out, "progressbar")[0]!;
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-valuemin")).toBe("0");
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-valuemax")).toBe("100");
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-valuenow")).toBe("14");
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-valuetext")).toBe("120 MB of 840 MB");
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-label")).toBe(W["import.bar.upload"]);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(W["import.uploading"]);
    expect(buttons(out)).toContain(W["import.cancel"]);
  });

  test("uploading with no file in hand (a reload, another tab): where it stopped, and the file button to go on", () => {
    const out = state(view("uploading", { receivedBytes: 120_000_000 }));
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(fill(W["import.resume"], { done: formatBytes(120_000_000), total: formatBytes(840_000_000) }));
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([W["import.choose"], W["import.cancel"]]));
  });

  test("reading: an indeterminate spinner named by the sentence, the sentence, and Cancel import", () => {
    const out = state(view("scanning"));
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(W["import.reading"]);
    const spinner = withRole(out, "progressbar")[0]!;
    expect(attr(spinner, "aria-valuenow")).toBeNull();
    expect(buttons(out)).toContain(W["import.cancel"]);
  });

  test("failed: the failure's sentence as an alert and the link Start again", () => {
    const out = state(view("failed", { failure: "not_this_source", source: "x" }));
    expect(withRole(out, "alert").length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(fill(W["import.failure.not_this_source"], { source: "X" }));
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain("/settings/import");
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(W["import.startAgain"]);
  });

  test("preparing and publishing: a bar per phase in its words, You can leave this page, and Stop import; paused, the notice", () => {
    const preparing = state(view("preparing", { progress: { imagesTotal: 1200, imagesSettled: 340, postsTotal: 1240, postsPublished: 0, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 0, imagesLeftOut: {} } }));
    expect(textOf(preparing)).toContain(fill(W["import.preparing"], { done: "340", total: "1,200" }));
    expect(textOf(preparing)).toContain(W["import.leave"]);
    expect(buttons(preparing)).toContain(W["import.stop"]);
    const bar = withRole(preparing, "progressbar")[0]!;
    expect(attr(bar, "aria-valuetext")).toBe(fill(W["import.preparing"], { done: "340", total: "1,200" }));
    const publishing = state(view("publishing", { paused: true, progress: { imagesTotal: 0, imagesSettled: 0, postsTotal: 1240, postsPublished: 800, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 440, imagesLeftOut: {} } }));
    expect(textOf(publishing)).toContain(fill(W["import.publishing"], { done: "800", total: "1,240" }));
    expect(textOf(publishing)).toContain(W["import.paused"]);

  test("done: the success notice with what was left out, the link to the Imported tab, and Remove imported posts", () => {
    const out = state(view("done", { undoable: true, progress: { imagesTotal: 10, imagesSettled: 10, postsTotal: 1240, postsPublished: 1240, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 0, imagesLeftOut: { not_checked: 2 } } }));

  test("stopped by a refused image: the post's day and first words, the notice and the text only; nothing published, nothing to remove", () => {
    const refusal = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000901";
    const out = state(view("stopped", { stopReason: "refused_image", refusalId: refusal, refusedAt: "2019-03-03", refusedWords: "Morning at the harbour" }));
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(fill(W["import.stopped.refused_image"], { date: utcDay("2019-03-03"), words: "Morning at the harbour" }));
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([`/settings/cases/uploads/${refusal}`, "/settings/import?source=mastodon"]));
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(W["import.stopped.notice"]);

  test("stopped by the author or by time: the published count and Remove imported posts; by staff: the rule, and no Remove", () => {
    const progress = { imagesTotal: 0, imagesSettled: 0, postsTotal: 1240, postsPublished: 300, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 0, imagesLeftOut: {} };
    const author = state(view("stopped", { stopReason: "by_author", undoable: true, progress }));
    expect(textOf(author)).toContain(fill(W["import.stopped.by_author"], { n: "300" }));
    expect(buttons(author)).toContain(W["import.remove"]);
    expect(textOf(state(view("stopped", { stopReason: "time_ran_out", undoable: true, progress })))).toContain(fill(W["import.stopped.time_ran_out"], { n: "300" }));
    const staff = state(view("stopped", { stopReason: "by_staff", endedByStaff: "R6", staffDecisionId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000902", undoable: true, progress }));
    expect(textOf(staff)).toContain(fill(W["import.stopped.by_staff"], { rule: ruleWords("R6"), n: "300" }));
    expect(buttons(staff)).not.toContain(W["import.remove"]);
  });

  test("removing: its bar; ended by staff, the undoing and undone screens say so with the link to the decision", () => {
```

### Create `apps/app/test/imports-uploader.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { IMPORT_RULES, ImportView, type ImportChoice } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError } from "../src/lib/api";
import {
  announcement,
  archiveProblem,
  chosenTotals,
  chunkHash,
  formatBytes,
  formatCount,
  importErrorMessage,
  imports,
  leftOutCounts,
  marksPass,
  monthInChoice,
  uploadArchive,
} from "../src/lib/imports";
import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "../src/lib/import-words";
import { fill } from "../src/lib/ui-words";

/**
 * The import's client (3b design, sections 4.2, 7.3, 9.2 and 10.3; Task 7): the chunked uploader against a fake fetch that
 * keeps the archive as the API does (7.3: a chunk at the stored offset, exactly chunkBytes but the last, its SHA-256 in
 * Import-Chunk-Sha256), and the pure functions the screens count and word with. The app imports no other app, so the
 * chosen totals are held here to the same table and answers as the API's apps/api/test/imports-plan.test.ts.
 */
const ID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000801";

/** An import as GET /api/imports/:id answers it, in `status`, with `receivedBytes` stored. */
function viewOf(status: ImportView["status"], receivedBytes: number, declaredBytes: number): ImportView {
  return ImportView.parse({
    id: ID,
    source: "mastodon",
    status,
    createdAt: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.000Z",
    endedAt: null,
    declaredBytes,
    receivedBytes,
    chunkBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes,
    failure: null,
    stopReason: null,
    endedByStaff: null,
    staffDecisionId: null,
    scan: null,
    samples: [],
    choice: null,
    picks: [],
    progress: { imagesTotal: 0, imagesSettled: 0, postsTotal: 0, postsPublished: 0, postsRemoved: 0, postsLeft: 0, imagesLeftOut: {} },
    paused: false,
    refusalId: null,
    refusedAt: null,
    refusedWords: null,
    undoable: false,
  });
}

const json = (status: number, body: unknown) => new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
const refusal = (status: number, code: string, details?: unknown) => json(status, { error: { code, message: code, ...(details === undefined ? {} : { details }) } });
const sha = (bytes: Uint8Array) => createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");

/** One request the fake API saw: a chunk's offset, length and hash, or a read of the import. */
type Seen = { kind: "put"; offset: number; length: number; sha256: string; type: string | null } | { kind: "get" };

/**
 * The API's chunk route in a fake fetch: the stored archive, refusals planned by offset (chunk_mismatch, a lost answer, a
 * lost request), and GET /api/imports/:id, which answers the stored size.
 */
function fakeApi(declared: number, plan: { mismatch?: Record<number, number>; lostAnswer?: number[]; lostRequest?: number[]; stored?: number; status?: ImportView["status"]; refuse?: Record<number, string> } = {}) {
  const stored = { bytes: new Uint8Array(declared), size: plan.stored ?? 0 };
  const seen: Seen[] = [];
  const mismatch = { ...(plan.mismatch ?? {}) };
  const lostAnswer = new Set(plan.lostAnswer ?? []);
  const lostRequest = new Set(plan.lostRequest ?? []);
  const fetch = vi.fn(async (url: string, init: { method: string; headers: Record<string, string>; body?: Blob }) => {
    if (init.method === "GET" && url === `/api/imports/${ID}`) {
      seen.push({ kind: "get" });
      return json(200, viewOf(plan.status ?? "uploading", stored.size, declared));
    }
    if (init.method !== "PUT" || url !== `/api/imports/${ID}/archive`) return refusal(404, "not_found");
    const offset = Number(init.headers["import-offset"]);
    const body = new Uint8Array(await init.body!.arrayBuffer());
    const hash = init.headers["import-chunk-sha256"]!;
    seen.push({ kind: "put", offset, length: body.length, sha256: hash, type: init.headers["content-type"] ?? null });
    if (lostRequest.has(offset)) {
      lostRequest.delete(offset);
      throw new TypeError("Failed to fetch");
    }
    if (plan.refuse?.[offset]) return refusal(400, plan.refuse[offset]!);
    if (offset !== stored.size) return refusal(409, "wrong_offset", { receivedBytes: stored.size });
    if ((mismatch[offset] ?? 0) > 0) {
      mismatch[offset]! -= 1;
      return refusal(400, "chunk_mismatch");
    }
    if (sha(body) !== hash) return refusal(400, "chunk_mismatch");
    stored.bytes.set(body, offset);
    stored.size = offset + body.length;
    if (lostAnswer.has(offset)) {
      lostAnswer.delete(offset);
      throw new TypeError("Failed to fetch");
    }
    return json(200, { receivedBytes: stored.size });
  });
  vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetch);
  return { stored, seen, puts: () => seen.filter((entry) => entry.kind === "put") as Extract<Seen, { kind: "put" }>[] };
}

/** An archive of `size` bytes whose every byte depends on its place, starting with a zip's local header. */
function archive(size: number): { file: Blob; bytes: Uint8Array } {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) bytes[i] = (i * 31 + 7) & 0xff;
  bytes.set([0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04], 0);
  return { file: new Blob([bytes]), bytes };
}

const noWait = async () => undefined;

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe("the chunked uploader (7.3, 10.3)", () => {
  test("sends the archive one chunk at a time, exactly chunkBytes but the last, each at its offset with its SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex", async () => {
    const { file, bytes } = archive(2500);
    const api = fakeApi(2500);
    const progress: number[] = [];
    const outcome = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, onProgress: (received) => progress.push(received), wait: noWait });
    expect(outcome).toEqual({ status: "done", receivedBytes: 2500 });
    expect(api.puts().map(({ offset, length }) => [offset, length])).toEqual([
      [0, 1000],
      [1000, 1000],
      [2000, 500],
    ]);
    for (const put of api.puts()) {
      expect(put.sha256).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
      expect(put.sha256).toBe(sha(bytes.subarray(put.offset, put.offset + put.length)));
      expect(put.type).toBe("application/octet-stream");
    }
    expect(progress).toEqual([1000, 2000, 2500]);
    expect(api.stored.bytes).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  test("with the real chunk size, a 20 MB archive is three chunks of 8 MiB, 8 MiB and the rest", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(20_000_000);
    const api = fakeApi(20_000_000);
    const outcome = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, wait: noWait });
    expect(outcome.status).toBe("done");
    expect(api.puts().map(({ offset, length }) => [offset, length])).toEqual([
      [0, IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes],
      [IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes],
      [2 * IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes, 20_000_000 - 2 * IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes],
    ]);
  }, 30_000);

  test("goes on from receivedBytes: a resumed upload sends only what the API does not hold yet", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(2500);
    const api = fakeApi(2500, { stored: 2000 });
    expect(await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 2000, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait })).toEqual({ status: "done", receivedBytes: 2500 });
    expect(api.puts().map(({ offset }) => offset)).toEqual([2000]);
  });

  test("a chunk the API answers chunk_mismatch is sent again, at most chunkRetries times", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(2500);
    const api = fakeApi(2500, { mismatch: { 1000: IMPORT_RULES.chunkRetries } });
    expect((await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait })).status).toBe("done");
    expect(api.puts().map(({ offset }) => offset)).toEqual([0, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000, 2000]);

    const again = fakeApi(2500, { mismatch: { 1000: IMPORT_RULES.chunkRetries + 1 } });
    const outcome = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait });
    expect(outcome.status).toBe("failed");
    expect(outcome.status === "failed" && outcome.error.code).toBe("chunk_mismatch");
    expect(outcome.status === "failed" && outcome.receivedBytes).toBe(1000);
    // The first try and chunkRetries more, then nothing.
    expect(again.puts().map(({ offset }) => offset)).toEqual([0, 1000, 1000, 1000, 1000]);
  });

  test("wrong_offset moves the upload to the stored size the answer carries", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(2500);
    const api = fakeApi(2500, { stored: 2000 });
    expect((await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 1000, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait })).status).toBe("done");
    expect(api.puts().map(({ offset }) => offset)).toEqual([1000, 2000]);
  });

  test("after a network error it reads the import before it sends more, and goes on from that import's receivedBytes", async () => {
    const { file, bytes } = archive(2500);
    // The second chunk arrived but its answer was lost; the third request was lost on its way.
    const api = fakeApi(2500, { lostAnswer: [1000], lostRequest: [2000] });
    expect(await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait })).toEqual({ status: "done", receivedBytes: 2500 });
    expect(api.seen.map((entry) => (entry.kind === "get" ? "get" : entry.offset))).toEqual([0, 1000, "get", 2000, "get", 2000]);
    expect(api.stored.bytes).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  test("an import that left uploading meanwhile ends the upload with its view; any other refusal ends it with its error", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(2500);
    fakeApi(2500, { lostAnswer: [0], status: "cancelled" });
    const moved = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait });
    expect(moved.status).toBe("moved");
    expect(moved.status === "moved" && moved.view.status).toBe("cancelled");

    const api = fakeApi(2500, { refuse: { 0: "not_an_archive" } });
    const refused = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, wait: noWait });
    expect(refused.status === "failed" && refused.error.code).toBe("not_an_archive");
    expect(api.puts()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("stops before the next chunk once the person cancelled", async () => {
    const { file } = archive(2500);
    const api = fakeApi(2500);
    let sent = 0;
    const outcome = await uploadArchive({ id: ID, file, from: 0, chunkBytes: 1000, onProgress: () => (sent += 1), stopped: () => sent >= 1, wait: noWait });
    expect(outcome).toEqual({ status: "stopped", receivedBytes: 1000 });
    expect(api.puts()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("chunkHash is the chunk's SHA-256 through crypto.subtle, in lowercase hex", async () => {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode("korbat");
    expect(await chunkHash(bytes.buffer)).toBe(sha(bytes));
  });

  test("the client's calls: PUT with Import-Offset and Import-Chunk-Sha256, the routes of 9.2, and the statement with the choice", async () => {
    const calls: { url: string; method: string; headers: Record<string, string>; body: unknown }[] = [];
    vi.stubGlobal(
      "fetch",
      vi.fn(async (url: string, init: { method: string; headers: Record<string, string>; body?: unknown }) => {
        calls.push({ url, method: init.method, headers: init.headers, body: init.body });
        if (url.endsWith("/archive")) return json(200, { receivedBytes: 4 });
        if (url.includes("/lines?")) return json(200, { lines: [], pages: 0 });
        if (url.includes("/lines/")) return json(200, { ref: 3, leftOut: true, alts: [], picks: [] });
        if (url === "/api/imports" && init.method === "GET") return json(200, { imports: [], sources: ["x", "mastodon"] });
        return json(200, viewOf("ready", 4, 4));
      }),
    );
    await imports.chunk(ID, 8, new Blob([new Uint8Array(4)]), "a".repeat(64));
    expect(calls[0]).toMatchObject({ url: `/api/imports/${ID}/archive`, method: "PUT", headers: { "import-offset": "8", "import-chunk-sha256": "a".repeat(64), "content-type": "application/octet-stream" } });
    expect(await imports.list()).toEqual({ imports: [], sources: ["x", "mastodon"] });
    await imports.lines(ID, 2);
    expect(calls.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ url: `/api/imports/${ID}/lines?page=2`, method: "GET" });
    await imports.pick(ID, 3, { leftOut: true, alts: [] });
    expect(calls.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ url: `/api/imports/${ID}/lines/3`, method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify({ leftOut: true, alts: [] }) });
    const choice: ImportChoice = { from: null, to: null, replies: false, warnings: false, protected: false, images: false, long: "leave" };
    await imports.confirm(ID, choice);
    expect(calls.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ url: `/api/imports/${ID}/confirm`, method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ choice, statement: true }) });
    for (const action of ["cancel", "stop", "undo"] as const) {
      await imports[action](ID);
      expect(calls.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ url: `/api/imports/${ID}/${action}`, method: "POST" });
    }
    await imports.create("x", 1234);
    expect(calls.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ url: "/api/imports", method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ source: "x", bytes: 1234 }) });
    expect(imports.mediaUri(ID, "3-0.jpg")).toBe(`/api/imports/${ID}/media/3-0.jpg`);
  });
});

describe("the archive's first bytes, before anything is sent (4.2 step 2)", () => {
  const zip = new Uint8Array([0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04, 0x14, 0x00]);
  const gzip = new Uint8Array([0x1f, 0x8b, 0x08, 0x00]);
  // A CAR: the header's length as a varint (58), then a CBOR map of two members.
  const car = new Uint8Array([0x3a, 0xa2, 0x65, 0x72, 0x6f, 0x6f, 0x74, 0x73]);

  test("a zip for X and Mastodon, a CAR for Bluesky; gzip is the old Mastodon archive; anything else is not this source's", () => {
    expect(archiveProblem("x", 1000, zip)).toBeNull();
    expect(archiveProblem("mastodon", 1000, zip)).toBeNull();
    expect(archiveProblem("bluesky", 1000, car)).toBeNull();
    expect(archiveProblem("mastodon", 1000, gzip)).toBe("import.tarGz");
    expect(archiveProblem("x", 1000, gzip)).toBe("import.tarGz");
    expect(archiveProblem("bluesky", 1000, zip)).toBe("import.notArchive");
    expect(archiveProblem("x", 1000, car)).toBe("import.notArchive");
    expect(archiveProblem("x", 0, new Uint8Array())).toBe("import.notArchive");
  });

  test("an archive over 2 GiB is refused by its size first", () => {
    expect(archiveProblem("x", IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes, zip)).toBeNull();
    expect(archiveProblem("x", IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes + 1, zip)).toBe("import.tooLarge");
  });
});

describe("the choice's totals, as the API counts them (the orchestrator's ruling for Task 5)", () => {
  const CHOICE: ImportChoice = { from: null, to: null, replies: false, warnings: false, protected: false, images: true, long: "leave" };
  // apps/api/test/imports-plan.test.ts's table: March, 3 posts without marks with 4 images (1 undescribed) and 2 replies
  // with 2 images; May, 1 post with 1 image.
  const scan = {
    months: [
      { month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 3, 4, 1], [1, 2, 2, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] },
      { month: "2019-05", groups: [[0, 1, 1, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] },
    ],
  };
  // Its picks as the view counts them ([marks, posts left out, their described images, descriptions given]): a post of
  // March left out with 2 described images, a post of March given one description, a reply left out with 1.
  const picks = [{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[0, 1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 1, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] }];

  test("the same answers as the API's chosenTotals for the same table", () => {
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks: [] }, CHOICE, true)).toEqual({ posts: 4, images: 4 });
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks: [] }, { ...CHOICE, replies: true }, true)).toEqual({ posts: 6, images: 6 });
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks: [] }, { ...CHOICE, from: "2019-04" }, true)).toEqual({ posts: 1, images: 1 });
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks }, CHOICE, true)).toEqual({ posts: 3, images: 3 });
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks }, CHOICE, false)).toEqual({ posts: 3, images: 0 });
    expect(chosenTotals({ scan, picks: [] }, { ...CHOICE, from: "2019-04", to: "2019-04" }, true)).toEqual({ posts: 0, images: 0 });
  });

  test("the reasons the app counts: replies, long posts, warnings and protected posts the choice leaves out, and the posts left out by hand", () => {
    expect(leftOutCounts({ scan, picks }, CHOICE)).toEqual({ reply: 2, left_out: 1 });
    expect(leftOutCounts({ scan, picks }, { ...CHOICE, replies: true })).toEqual({ left_out: 2 });
    const marked = { months: [{ month: "2019-03", groups: [[2, 4, 0, 0], [3, 1, 0, 0], [4, 2, 0, 0], [8, 3, 0, 0]] as [number, number, number, number][] }] };
    // A line with several marks is counted once, by the first mark the choice refuses.
    expect(leftOutCounts({ scan: marked, picks: [] }, CHOICE)).toEqual({ too_long: 4, reply: 1, warning: 2, protected: 3 });
    expect(leftOutCounts({ scan: marked, picks: [] }, { ...CHOICE, long: "shorten", warnings: true, protected: true })).toEqual({ reply: 1 });
  });

  test("marksPass and monthInChoice as plan.ts has them: either end of a range may be open", () => {
    expect(marksPass(0, CHOICE)).toBe(true);
    expect(marksPass(1, CHOICE)).toBe(false);
    expect(marksPass(2, { ...CHOICE, long: "shorten" })).toBe(true);
    expect(monthInChoice("2019-03", { from: null, to: "2019-03" })).toBe(true);
    expect(monthInChoice("2019-03", { from: "2019-04", to: null })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("numbers, sizes, refusals and announcements", () => {
  test("counts with a thousands separator, sizes in decimal megabytes as the value text prints them", () => {
    expect(formatCount(1240)).toBe("1,240");
    expect(formatBytes(120_000_000)).toBe("120 MB");
    expect(formatBytes(840_000_000)).toBe("840 MB");
    expect(formatBytes(2_500_000)).toBe("2.5 MB");
    expect(formatBytes(4_000)).toBe("4 KB");
    expect(formatBytes(0)).toBe("0 KB");
    expect(formatBytes(1_500_000_000)).toBe("1.5 GB");
  });

  test("the refusals of 9.4 in the words of 10.9: each code its sentence, the weekly and the network limit apart", () => {
    const words = (code: string, status = 400) => importErrorMessage(new ApiError(status, code, "the server's"), { during: "create" });
    expect(words("import_active", 409)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.active"]);
    expect(words("imports_unavailable", 503)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.unavailable"]);
    expect(words("import_weekly_limit", 429)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.limit"]);
    expect(words("rate_limited", 429)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.limit.network"]);
    expect(words("import_too_soon", 403)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.tooSoon"]);
    expect(words("archive_too_large", 413)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.tooLarge"]);
    expect(words("wrong_state", 409)).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.wrongState"]);
    expect(words("statement_required")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.statementRequired"]);
    expect(words("nothing_chosen")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.publish.nothing"]);
    // The shared codes keep the server's or the app's shared sentence; rate_limited is the network's limit only on a create.
    expect(words("account_suspended", 403)).toBe("the server's");
    expect(importErrorMessage(new ApiError(429, "rate_limited", "the server's"), { during: "act" })).toBe("the server's");
    expect(importErrorMessage(new ApiError(400, "not_an_archive", "the server's"), { source: "x" })).toBe(fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.notArchive"], { source: "X" }));
  });

  test("a change of state while the screen is open is said in one polite sentence; a change that is no news says nothing", () => {
    expect(announcement("scanning", "ready")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.ready"]);
    expect(announcement("scanning", "failed")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.failed"]);
    expect(announcement("uploading", "failed")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.failed"]);
    expect(announcement("publishing", "done")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.done"]);
    expect(announcement("uploading", "scanning")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.scanning"]);
    expect(announcement("preparing", "publishing")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.publishing"]);
    expect(announcement("publishing", "stopped")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.stopped"]);
    expect(announcement("undoing", "undone")).toBe(IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.undone"]);
    expect(announcement("ready", "ready")).toBeNull();
    // The person's own press is answered where they pressed it: their confirm, cancel, stop and remove say nothing more here.
    expect(announcement("ready", "publishing")).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/app/test/rich-text.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { PostView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RichText } from "../src/components/social/RichText";
import { PostCard, QuoteEmbed } from "../src/components/social/PostCard";

/**
 * A post's words (3b design, sections 5.3, 10.6 and decision 21; Task 7): mentions are links in a native post and never in
 * an imported one, whose @names belong to another platform, even where an account of that name exists on korbat; and
 * every link to an outside page is marked nofollow and ugc, opens without a reference back and sends no referrer.
 */
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  router: { push: () => undefined, replace: () => undefined },
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ state: { status: "signed-out" }, refresh: async () => undefined }) }));
vi.mock("expo-image", async () => {
  const { createElement } = await import("react");
  return { Image: ({ source, accessibilityLabel }: { source: { uri: string }; accessibilityLabel: string }) => createElement("img", { "data-uri": source.uri, alt: accessibilityLabel }) };
});
vi.mock("@/components/toast", () => ({ toast: { show: vi.fn() }, Toaster: () => null }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const anchors = (markup: string): string[] => markup.match(/<a\b[^>]*>/g) ?? [];
const hrefOf = (tag: string): string => /href="([^"]+)"/.exec(tag)?.[1] ?? "";
const REL = "nofollow ugc noopener noreferrer";

const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
// An account @ada exists on korbat: the author of this card.
const ADA = { id: id(1), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada Lovelace", verified: false };
const BODY = "Thanks @ada and @grace_h, notes at https://example.org/notes and http://example.com/x";

function post(extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView {
  return {
    id: id(10),
    author: { id: id(2), handle: "grace", displayName: "Grace Hopper", verified: false },
    body: BODY,
    createdAt: "2026-10-21T10:00:00.000Z",
    state: "visible",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    imported: null,
    ...extra,
  };
}

describe("RichText", () => {
  test("in a native post a mention is a link to the profile, and every outside link carries rel nofollow ugc noopener noreferrer", () => {
    const out = html(<RichText body={BODY} />);
    const links = anchors(out);
    expect(links.map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["/u/ada", "/u/grace_h", "https://example.org/notes", "http://example.com/x"]);
    for (const tag of links.filter((link) => hrefOf(link).startsWith("http"))) {
      expect(tag).toContain(`rel="${REL}"`);
      expect(tag).toContain('target="_blank"');
    }
  });

  test("with mentions off, @ada stays text, while an account @ada exists, and the outside links keep their rel", () => {
    const out = html(<RichText body={BODY} mentions={false} />);
    expect(anchors(out).map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["https://example.org/notes", "http://example.com/x"]);
    expect(out).toContain("@ada");
    for (const tag of anchors(out)) expect(tag).toContain(`rel="${REL}"`);
  });

  test("an imported post's card draws its body with mentions off: no /u/ada link but the author's own", () => {
    const imported = post({ author: ADA, imported: { source: "x", at: "2019-03-03", shortened: false } });
    const out = html(<PostCard post={imported} />);
    // The author line links Ada's profile once, the avatar's hidden link once: the body's @ada links nothing.
    expect(anchors(out).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/ada")).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(anchors(out).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/grace_h")).toEqual([]);
    const native = html(<PostCard post={post({ author: ADA })} />);
    expect(anchors(native).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/ada")).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  test("a quoted imported post shows the short label and no mention as a link", () => {
    const quoted = { ...post({ id: id(11), imported: { source: "mastodon", at: "2019-03-03", shortened: true } }), quoteOf: null };
    const out = html(<QuoteEmbed quote={quoted} />);
    expect(out).toContain("Imported from Mastodon");
    expect(out).not.toContain("dated");
    // Quoted words are plain text: no mention, no link but the quote's own (its author and its time).
    expect(anchors(out).map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["/u/grace", `/post/${id(11)}`]);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * An account's case that holds an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material and reaches images that are still
 * served: the seal and "Do not seal now" are offered on it. Its newest snapshot holds the account's fields as they read
 * now, so nothing asks for a fresh one.
 */
export function sealableCase(id: string, accountId: string): CaseView {
  const fields = { handle: "an_account", displayName: HOSTILE.quote, bio: LOOKALIKE.label };
  const base = accountCase();
  const [copied] = base.snapshots;
  if (!copied || copied.withheld) throw new Error("the account case's snapshot shows its content");
  return accountCase({
    id,
    target: { type: "account", id: accountId, ...fields, deleted: false },
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 2, images: 3, sealed: 0, served: 3, newestPostOn: "2026-09-30" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } },
    snapshots: [{ ...copied, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "5a5a5a5a"), targetId: accountId, authorHandle: fields.handle, ...fields }],
    // An item of its own, so that no two fixture cases hold the same one.
    items: base.items.map((each) => ({ ...each, id: accountId.replace(/^.{8}/, "6b6b6b6b") })),
    history: [],
  });
}

/** An announced suspension of 3 days, as a decision's row on the case page holds it, with where its period stands and its reply. */
function announcedSuspension(id: string, period: NonNullable<CaseDecisionAction["period"]>, reply: CaseDecisionAction["reply"]): CaseDecisionAction {
  return {
    id,
    kind: "suspend",
    mediaId: null,
    noEffect: null,
    inForce: true,
    reversesActionId: null,
    liftedBy: null,
    sealed: null,
    ...NO_STANDING,
    days: 3,
    announced: true,
    basis: "strikes",
    restsOn: THREE_STRIKES.map((strike) => strike.decisionId),
    earliestStart: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z",
    period,
    reply,
  };
}
```

```tsx
describe("the hidden-characters view", () => {

  test("draws every character outside printable ASCII as its code point, and keeps the lines", () => {
    expect(showHidden("plain text, 100%")).toBe("plain text, 100%");
    expect(showHidden(`${RLO}gnp.exe`)).toBe("[U+202E]gnp.exe");
    expect(showHidden(`p${CYRILLIC_A}ypal`)).toBe("p[U+0430]ypal");
    expect(showHidden(`a${ZWSP}b`)).toBe("a[U+200B]b");
    expect(showHidden(`one${LF}two`)).toBe(`one[U+000A]${LF}two`);
    expect(showHidden(String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600))).toBe("[U+1F600]");
    expect(hasHidden("plain")).toBe(false);

    expect(mentionedHosts("no address here, not even javascript:alert(3)")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an address whose host the console cannot read is counted, never passed over: one followed by a direction override, and one that is no address at all", () => {
    // The override stands where the host ends, so it is part of what a browser would take for the host.

    expect(mentionedAddresses(`${overridden} http://[not-an-address`)).toEqual({ hosts: [], unread: 2 });
    expect(mentionedAddresses("https://example.com/a")).toEqual({ hosts: ["example.com"], unread: 0 });
    expect(mentionedAddresses("no address")).toEqual({ hosts: [], unread: 0 });

describe("the console's words", () => {
  test("a waiting time is coarse: minutes, hours, days", () => {
    expect(waited("2026-10-01T09:46:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("14 minutes");
    expect(waited("2026-10-01T09:59:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("1 minute");
    expect(waited("2026-10-01T07:00:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("3 hours");
    expect(waited("2026-09-29T11:00:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("47 hours");
    expect(waited("2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("3 days");
    expect(waited("2026-10-01T10:05:00.000Z", NOW)).toBe("0 minutes");
  });

  test("a category is a few plain words", () => {
    expect(categoryLabel("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS")).toBe("protection of minors");
    expect(categoryLabel("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC")).toBe("other breach of the rules");
  });

  test("a source is worded from its bands, with the items answered without the images apart from the share acted on; only a source that names someone can be revealed", () => {
    expect(sourceWords(SOURCES.reporter)).toBe("account 1 to 12 months old; 2 to 9 reports filed; under half of the decided ones acted on; 1 answered without the images");
    expect(sourceWords({ ...SOURCES.reporter, answeredUnseen: "none" })).not.toContain("answered without the images");
    expect(sourceWords(SOURCES.notifier)).toBe("signed out; gave a name; gave an address; address not confirmed");
    expect(sourceWords(SOURCES.unnamed)).toBe("signed out; gave no name; gave an address; address confirmed; asked korbat to stop its emails");
    expect(sourceWords(SOURCES.lost)).toBe("signed out; contact lost or forgotten");
    expect(writtenBy(SOURCES.reporter)).toBe("Written by Reporter A");
    expect(writtenBy(SOURCES.notifier)).toBe("Written by a notifier");
    expect(writtenBy(SOURCES.anonymous)).toBe("Written by a notifier");
    expect(Object.entries(SOURCES).filter(([, source]) => revealable(source)).map(([name]) => name)).toEqual(["reporter", "notifier"]);
    expect(SOURCES.staff.label).toBe(SOURCE_LABELS.staff);
  });

  test("the message table has one entry for every moderation code the console can meet, and the app's own codes are not among them", () => {
    // 3d Task 6 (8.8): objection_not_open is the app's, and (review L10) objection_exists; already_protected and
    // automation_capped never leave the API, since the automated step records them on the signal.
    const appOnly = ["human_check_failed", "staff_cannot_report", "notice_not_found", "already_reported", "appeal_not_open", "appeal_exists", "reexamination_not_open", "reexamination_exists", "not_appealable", "objection_not_open", "objection_exists"];
    const apiOnly = ["already_protected", "automation_capped"];
    expect([...CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES, ...appOnly, ...apiOnly].sort()).toEqual([...ModerationErrorCode.options].sort());
    expect(Object.keys(MODERATION_MESSAGES).sort()).toEqual([...CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES].sort());
    for (const code of CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES) expect(messageFor(code).length, code).toBeGreaterThan(15);
    // A recusal says nothing of whom the conflict concerns.
    expect(messageFor("staff_recused")).toBe(
      "You cannot open or decide this case: an account linked to you takes part in it, or follows, blocks, mutes or replied to someone who does, or the post replies to or quotes a post of an account linked to you. Another staff member must handle it.",
    );
    // The server's own message is never shown: a screen words a code itself, and may say more where it knows more.
    const err = Object.assign(new Error("the server's own words"), { code: "not_found" });
    expect(describeError(err, FINDING_WORDS)).toBe("That link names nothing live on korbat: the post or the account does not exist or was deleted.");
    expect(describeError(err, CASE_WORDS)).toBe("No case has this address.");
    expect(describeError(Object.assign(new Error("x"), { code: "rate_limited" }), CASE_WORDS)).toContain("after midnight UTC");
  });
});

describe("text from others", () => {
  const frame = { by: "Written by Reporter A", open: false, hiddenShown: false, onOpen: noop, onToggleHidden: noop };

  test("is drawn as escaped text inside a frame that says who wrote it, with the hosts it mentions as text", () => {
    const out = html(<FrameView {...frame} text={`${HOSTILE.script} ${LOOKALIKE.address}`} />);
    expect(out).toContain('<p class="frame-label">Written by Reporter A</p>');
    expect(out).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    expect(out).toContain("Mentions addresses at: <bdi>korbat.example.evil.test, evil.test</bdi>");
    expect(out).toContain(">Show hidden characters</button>");
    expectInert(out);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an address the console cannot read is said to be there, in the console's own words, once for each", () => {
    const overridden = `https://korbat.example${String.fromCharCode(0x202e)}/tsop`;
    const beside = html(<FrameView {...frame} text={`${overridden} and https://good.test/x`} />);
    expect(beside).toContain('<p class="hint">Mentions addresses at: <bdi>good.test</bdi> and an address this console cannot read</p>');
    const alone = html(<FrameView {...frame} text={`${overridden} then http://[not-an-address`} />);
    expect(alone).toContain('<p class="hint">Mentions an address this console cannot read and an address this console cannot read</p>');
    expect(html(<FrameView {...frame} text="no address here" />)).not.toContain("Mentions");
    expectInert(beside + alone);
  });

  test("a text made to look like the console's own line stays inside its frame", () => {
    const out = html(<FrameView {...frame} by="Written by a notifier" text={LOOKALIKE.label} />);
    expect(out).toMatch(/<div class="frame"><p class="frame-label">Written by a notifier<\/p><p class="frame-text"><bdi>korbat: verified notice from police<\/bdi><\/p>/);
  });

  test("its hidden characters are drawn as code points on request", () => {
    const out = html(<FrameView {...frame} text={HOSTILE.bidi} hiddenShown />);
    expect(out).toContain("<bdi>[U+202E]gnp.exe</bdi>");
    expect(out).toContain(">Show the text as written</button>");
  });

  test("a text citing R3 or R5 opens collapsed behind a button that says what it is", () => {
    const collapsed = html(<FrameView {...frame} text="the threat's own words" collapsedLabel="Show text (R5: direct threats)" />);
    expect(collapsed).toContain(">Show text (R5: direct threats)</button>");
    expect(collapsed).not.toContain("the threat");
    expect(html(<FrameView {...frame} text="the threat's own words" collapsedLabel="Show text (R5: direct threats)" open />)).toContain("the threat&#x27;s own words");
  });
});

describe("the queue", () => {
  const props: QueueViewProps = {
    rows: { state: "ready", value: QUEUE_ROWS },
    more: true,
    loadingMore: false,
    now: NOW,
    finding: { link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", busy: false, error: null },
    onLoadMore: noop,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onFindingChange: noop,
    onFindingSubmit: noop,
  };

  test("lists open cases in the API's order with their lane, age, target, what they cite and their marks, each linked to its case", () => {
    const out = html(<QueueView {...props} />);
    expect(out.indexOf(`/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`)).toBeLessThan(out.indexOf(`/cases/${CASE_ACCOUNT}`));
    expect(out.indexOf(`/cases/${CASE_ACCOUNT}`)).toBeLessThan(out.indexOf(`/cases/${CASE_POST}`));
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`, `/cases/${CASE_ACCOUNT}`, `/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);
    expect(out).toContain("14 minutes");
    expect(out).toContain(", 3 items");
    expect(out).toContain("R3, R5, protection of minors");
    expect(out).toContain("notice under Art. 16, CSAM: no images, re-examination");
    expect(out).toContain("an account");
    expect(out).toContain("notice under Art. 16, deferred");
    expect(out).toContain(">Load more</button>");
    expectInert(out);
    // No count of reports per person and no weight: the table has the six columns and nothing else.
    expect([...out.matchAll(/<th scope="col">/g)]).toHaveLength(6);
  });

  test("the marks are the console's own words for what the unanswered items are", () => {
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ allegesIllegal: false }))).toEqual([]);
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ allegesIllegal: true, suspect: true, reexamination: true, deferred: true }))).toEqual(["notice under Art. 16", "CSAM: no images", "re-examination", "deferred"]);
  });

  test("an empty queue, a queue still loading, and no further page", () => {
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} rows={{ state: "ready", value: [] }} more={false} />)).toContain("No case is open.");
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} rows={{ state: "loading" }} more={false} />)).toContain("Loading");
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} more={false} />)).not.toContain(">Load more</button>");
  });

  test("Open a case takes a korbat link, the rule and the category, and words a link that names nothing in its own words", () => {
    const out = html(<QueueView {...props} finding={{ ...props.finding, error: FINDING_WORDS.not_found }} />);
    expect(out).toContain(">Open a case</button>");
    expect(out).toContain("That link names nothing live on korbat: the post or the account does not exist or was deleted.");
    for (const rule of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(out).toContain(`<option value="${rule}"`);
    // Each rule is offered with its title, as the rulebook in force words it.
    for (const rule of RULES) expect(out, rule.id).toContain(`>${rule.id}: ${rule.title}</option>`);
    expect(RULES.map((rule) => rule.id)).toEqual(["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]);
    expect(out).toContain('<option value="STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS">protection of minors</option>');
    expect(out).not.toContain("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    // The categories offered are the contracts' own list of what a finding may carry: the form restates no rule of it.
    expect([...out.matchAll(/<option value="(STATEMENT_CATEGORY_[A-Z_]+)"/g)].map((found) => found[1])).toEqual([...FINDING_CATEGORIES]);
    // The form posts nowhere by itself: the page sends the finding.
    expect(out).not.toMatch(/<form[^>]*action=/);
    expect(findingOf({ link: " http://localhost:8081/post/7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36 ", ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toEqual({
      target: { kind: "link", url: "http://localhost:8081/post/7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36" },
      ground: "rule",
      ruleId: "R2",
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
    });
    for (const link of ["", "not a link", "javascript:alert(1)", `http://x.test/${"a".repeat(300)}`]) expect(findingOf({ link, ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" }), link).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the queue is read page by page from its start; its own refresh carries no activity mark, its person's reads do", async () => {
    const first: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(0, 2), nextCursor: "page_2-cursor", replies: [] };
    const second: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS.slice(2), nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/queue": { status: 200, body: first }, "GET /api/staff/queue?cursor=page_2-cursor": { status: 200, body: second } });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    expect(await readQueue(api, 1, true)).toEqual({ rows: first.cases, next: "page_2-cursor", replies: [] });
    expect(await readQueue(api, 2, false)).toEqual({ rows: QUEUE_ROWS, next: null, replies: [] });
    expect(fake.requests.map((request) => `${request.url} ${request.headers["x-staff-activity"] ?? "unmarked"}`)).toEqual([
      "/api/staff/queue 1",
      "/api/staff/queue unmarked",
      "/api/staff/queue?cursor=page_2-cursor unmarked",
    ]);
  });

  test("the screen reads the queue when it opens, marked, and again every 60 seconds, unmarked, until it is left", async () => {
    const page: QueuePage = { cases: QUEUE_ROWS, nextCursor: null, replies: [] };
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/queue": { status: 200, body: page } });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    const clock = new FakeClock();
    const marks = () => fake.requests.map((request) => request.headers["x-staff-activity"] ?? "unmarked");
    const stop = startQueueReads(clock, (activity) => void readQueue(api, 1, activity));
    await settle();
    // Opening the screen is its person's action.
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1"]);
    expect(QUEUE_REFRESH_MS).toBe(60_000);
    await clock.advance(QUEUE_REFRESH_MS - 1);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1"]);
    // The refresh is the page's own: it never moves the session's idle end.
    await clock.advance(1);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1", "unmarked"]);
    await clock.advance(3 * QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
    expect(marks()).toEqual(["1", "unmarked", "unmarked", "unmarked", "unmarked"]);
    // Leaving the screen ends its reads.
    stop();
    expect(clock.pending).toBe(0);
    await clock.advance(5 * QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
    expect(marks()).toHaveLength(5);
  });
});

describe("the home screen's overview", () => {
  test("the lanes with their open cases and oldest waiting time, the appeals waiting, every reveal with its staff handle and its case, and the day's counts by staff handle", () => {
    const out = html(<OverviewView overview={overview()} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview()).success).toBe(true);
    expect(out).toContain("Urgent: 2 cases, oldest 14 minutes");
    expect(out).toContain("Lane 1: no open case");
    expect(out).toContain("Lane 2: 1 case, oldest 3 days");
    expect(out).toContain("3 appeals wait; you may review 1; 1 has no possible reviewer now.");
    expect(out).toContain("The emergency switch is off.");
    expect(out).toContain(`<bdi>${HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script}</bdi>`);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);
    expect(out).toContain(`<bdi>${HOSTILE_ESCAPED.img}</bdi>: 4 images viewed`);
    expect(out).toContain(": 1 finding opened");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Mails waiting");
    expect(out).not.toContain("not released");
    expectInert(out);
  });

  test("late erasures are said only when there are any: each count above zero under its own words, then the runbook's sentence", () => {
    const none = { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 0, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 0 };
    // The runbook's sentence, in the words of the design's runbook bullet (section 13, Task 12(a)).
    expect(ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK).toBe(
      "A count of late erasures names the due rule whose step keeps failing, so evidence, an intake record or a notifier's name and address outlives its published period: read the API log for moderation-retention and for auth janitor: purge failed, and check that API_MODERATION_RETENTION was not left off after a restore (the API logs it at every start).",
    );
    // Every count of the contract has its words, and no other key has any.
    expect(Object.keys(ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape.erasureOverdue.shape).sort());
    expect(erasureOverdue(none)).toBeNull();
    const quiet = html(<OverviewView overview={overview()} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(quiet).not.toContain("Erasures more than a day late");
    expect(quiet).not.toContain("moderation-retention");

    expect(erasureOverdue({ ...none, images: 60 })).toBe(`Erasures more than a day late: image rows nothing retains: 60. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`);
    const late = { ...none, caseEvidence: 2, redactions: 1, contacts: 3 };
    expect(erasureOverdue(late)).toBe(`Erasures more than a day late: closed cases whose evidence is due: 2; R4 erasures: 1; notifiers' contacts and confirmations: 3. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`);
    const out = html(<OverviewView overview={overview({ erasureOverdue: late })} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(out).toContain('<p role="alert" class="error">Erasures more than a day late: closed cases whose evidence is due: 2; R4 erasures: 1; notifiers&#x27; contacts and confirmations: 3. A count of late erasures names');
    // A count of zero is not listed among the late ones.
    expect(out).not.toContain("unconfirmed drafts");
    expect(out).not.toContain("image rows nothing retains");
    for (const key of Object.keys(none) as (keyof typeof none)[]) {
      expect(erasureOverdue({ ...none, [key]: 7 }), key).toBe(`Erasures more than a day late: ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS[key]}: 7. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`);
    }
    expectInert(out);
  });

  test("what waits too long is said only when it does: mails, the release, more reveals than the list holds, and the switch", () => {
    const busy = overview({
      appealsWaiting: 1,
      appealsYouMayReview: 0,
      appealsWithoutReviewer: 0,
      mailsWaiting: { receipts: 1, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 2 },
      mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 3, outcomes: 0 },
      releaseOverdue: 4,
      deferUnproven: true,
      reveals: { total: 140, items: Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({ at: "2026-09-30T10:00:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE_POST })) },
    });
    const out = html(<OverviewView overview={busy} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(out).toContain("1 appeal waits; you may review none.");
    expect(out).toContain("Mails waiting for more than an hour: 1 receipt, 0 statements to authors, 2 outcomes.");
    expect(out).toContain("Mails given up in the last 30 days: 0 receipts, 3 statements to authors, 0 outcomes.");
    // The count, and the runbook's sentence for it, in the words of the design's runbook bullet (section 13, Task 12(a)).
    expect(RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK).toBe(
      "A count of decisions not released means the daily release keeps failing: notifiers are not told and re-examination windows do not open, so read the API log for moderation-dispatch and fix it the same day.",
    );
    expect(releaseOverdue(4)).toBe(`Decisions not released after 26 hours: 4. ${RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`);
    expect(out).toContain(
      '<p role="alert" class="error">Decisions not released after 26 hours: 4. A count of decisions not released means the daily release keeps failing: notifiers are not told and re-examination windows do not open, so read the API log for moderation-dispatch and fix it the same day.</p>',
    );
    expect(out).toContain("Showing the newest 100 of 140.");
    expect(out).toContain("The emergency switch is on");
    // An id that is no lower-case uuid never becomes a link.
    const odd = html(<OverviewView overview={overview({ reveals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: "2026-09-30T10:00:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE_POST.toUpperCase() }] } })} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(hrefs(odd)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("the home screen's three lists of the path for child sexual abuse material", () => {
  const at = "2026-09-30T10:00:00.000Z";
  const lists = overview({
    protectionLifted: {
      total: 2,
      items: [
        { at, handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_FROZEN, kind: "unsealed" },
        { at, handle: HOSTILE.img, caseId: CASE_ACCOUNT, kind: "dismissed" },
      ],
    },
    sealsDeclined: { total: 1, items: [{ at, handle: HOSTILE.quote, caseId: CASE_QUOTED }] },
    interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at, handle: HOSTILE.script, caseId: CASE_FROZEN, posts: 3, images: 7 }] },
  });

  test("the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the choices not to seal, and the seals taken while deciding that are in force: time, staff handle, case link, and what each did or covers", () => {
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(lists).success).toBe(true);
    const out = html(<OverviewView overview={lists} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(out).toContain("Lifted a seal");
    expect(out).toContain("Answered a report of child sexual abuse material without a seal");
    expect(out).toContain("Chose not to seal");
    expect(out).toContain("7 images on 3 posts");
    // Each row links to its case, in the console, and every handle is text.
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_POST}`, `/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`, `/cases/${CASE_ACCOUNT}`, `/cases/${CASE_QUOTED}`, `/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`]);
    expect(out).toContain(`<bdi>${HOSTILE_ESCAPED.quote}</bdi>`);
    expectInert(out);
    for (const heading of ["Protection of reported images lifted in the last 30 days", "Choices not to seal in the last 30 days", "Seals taken while deciding that are in force"]) expect(out).toMatch(new RegExp(`<h3[^>]*>${heading}</h3>`));
  });

  test("an empty list says so, and a list longer than it shows says how many there are", () => {
    const quiet = html(<OverviewView overview={overview()} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(quiet).toContain("No decision lifted the protection of reported images in the last 30 days.");
    expect(quiet).toContain("Nobody recorded a choice not to seal in the last 30 days.");
    expect(quiet).toContain("No seal taken while deciding is in force.");
    const row = { at, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE_FROZEN };
    const many = html(
      <OverviewView
        overview={overview({
          protectionLifted: { total: 130, items: Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({ ...row, kind: "dismissed" as const })) },
          sealsDeclined: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => row) },
          interimSeals: { total: 250, items: Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({ ...row, posts: 1, images: 1 })) },
        })}
        now={NOW}
        onOpenCase={noop}
      />,
    );
    for (const total of [130, 101, 250]) expect(many).toContain(`Showing the newest 100 of ${total}.`);
    expect(many).toContain("1 image on 1 post");
    // An id that is no lower-case uuid never becomes a link.
    const odd = html(<OverviewView overview={overview({ sealsDeclined: { total: 1, items: [{ ...row, caseId: CASE_FROZEN.toUpperCase() }] } })} now={NOW} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(hrefs(odd)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_POST}`]);
  });
});

describe("the case page", () => {
  const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
    shownImage: null,
    busy: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    note: "",
    reveal: null,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onShowImage: noop,
    onShowClearly: noop,
    onHideImage: noop,
    onImageError: noop,
    onSnapshot: noop,
    onNoteChange: noop,
    onNoteSave: noop,
    onRevealOpen: noop,
    onRevealChange: noop,
    onRevealConfirm: noop,
    onRevealClose: noop,
  };
  const page = (view: CaseView, extra: Partial<CaseScreenViewProps> = {}) => html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={caseId(view.id)} view={view} {...extra} />);

  test("the fixtures are cases as the contracts describe them", () => {
    for (const view of [postCase(), frozenCase(), accountCase()]) expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success, view.id).toBe(true);
  });

  test("with a role the page ends in the decision composer and offers Lift what was done while deciding beside the decision; without one it decides nothing", () => {
    const view = postCase();
    const compose: NonNullable<CaseScreenViewProps["compose"]> = {
      role: "moderator",
      draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, "moderator"),
      now: new Date(NOW),
      busy: false,
      error: null,
      textErrors: {},
      declining: null,
      onChange: noop,
      onTextBlur: noop,
      onSeal: noop,
      onConfirm: noop,
      onDeclineOpen: noop,
      onDeclineChange: noop,
      onDeclineSave: noop,
      onDeclineClose: noop,
      onCancelCorrection: noop,
      onCorrect: noop,
      onReview: noop,
      onAnswer: noop,
      onWithdraw: noop,
      onWithdrawMarks: noop,
    };
    const out = page(view, { compose });
    // The composer comes last, after the notes.
    expect(out.indexOf('<h3 id="composer-title">Decide</h3>')).toBeGreaterThan(out.indexOf(">Add a note</label>"));
    expect(out).toContain(">Confirm with your staff key</button>");
    expect(out).toContain(">Lift what was done while deciding</button>");
    // Still no link into the app, and nothing a hostile string could have made.
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([]);
    expectInert(out);
    const bare = page(view);
    expect(bare).not.toContain("composer-title");
    expect(bare).not.toContain("Lift what was done while deciding");
    // A correction takes the composer's place while it is open.
    const correcting = page(view, { compose: { ...compose, draft: correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, "moderator") } });

  });

    expect(out).toContain("Withhold the post: in force");
    expect(out).toContain(">Add a note</label>");
    // No banner of the urgent lane or of a suspicion on a case without either.
    expect(out).not.toContain("Art. 18");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Nobody opens the images");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Take a fresh snapshot");
  });

  test("the decisions: a measure in force, one a later decision lifted, one that ended with the case's decision, a seal that ended with the admin's answer, and beside a field reset that it was written once", () => {
    const LIFTING = "0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8776-5a4b3c2d1e0f";
    const action = (id: string, kind: CaseView["decisions"][number]["actions"][number]["kind"], more: Partial<CaseView["decisions"][number]["actions"][number]> = {}) => ({ id, kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: false, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, ...more });
    const WITHHOLD = "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d";
    const out = page(
      accountCase({
        decisions: [
          decision({
            actions: [
              action(WITHHOLD, "withhold", { liftedBy: LIFTING }),
              action("2b3c4d5e-6f7a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e", "withhold_media", { mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }),
              action("3c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-ae1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f", "seal_media", { sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedPosts: 0, list: [] } }),
              action("4d5e6f7a-8b9c-4dae-bf2a-3b4c5d6e7f8a", "reset_display_name", { inForce: true }),
              action("5e6f7a8b-9cad-4ebf-803b-4c5d6e7f8a9b", "reset_bio", { noEffect: "already" }),
            ],
          }),
          decision({ id: LIFTING, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", decidedAt: "2026-10-01T10:15:00.000Z", actions: [action("6f7a8b9c-adbe-4fc0-914c-5d6e7f8a9bac", "restore", { reversesActionId: WITHHOLD })] }),
        ],
      }),
    );
    // What lifted a measure: the decision that reversed it, by its time.
    expect(out).toContain("<li>Withhold the post: lifted by the decision of 2026-10-01 10:15</li>");
    expect(out).toContain(`<li>Withhold one image <code>${IMAGE_ONE}</code>: ended with the case&#x27;s decision</li>`);
    expect(out).toContain("Seal the images this case reaches: ended with the admin&#x27;s answer");
    expect(out).toContain("<li>Reset display name: in force; written once; the field as it reads now is shown above</li>");
    expect(out).toContain("<li>Reset bio: ended with the case&#x27;s decision; changed nothing when imposed; written once; the field as it reads now is shown above</li>");
    // A reversal is no measure: it has no state of its own.
    expect(out).toContain("<li>Lift the restriction of the post</li>");
    // Each decision's kind and outcome in the console's own words, one table each.
    expect(out).toContain(`<strong>${DECISION_KINDS.interim}</strong>: ${DECISION_OUTCOMES.restricted}, 2026-10-01 09:00, by `);
    expect(out).toContain(`<strong>${DECISION_KINDS.correction}</strong>: ${DECISION_OUTCOMES.reversed}, 2026-10-01 10:15, by `);
    expect(DECISION_KINDS).toEqual({ interim: "While deciding", final: "Final decision", order: "Order", review: "Review of an appeal", correction: "Correction" });
    // An item's outcome, once answered.
    expect(page(postCase({ items: [item({ outcome: "restricted_rule", answeredBy: LIFTING })] }))).toContain(`<p>Answered: ${OUTCOME_WORDS.restricted_rule}.</p>`);
    expect(OUTCOME_WORDS.not_available).toBe("nothing live at the link");
  });
```
