```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import * as lucide from "lucide-react";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { FONT_FACES, FONT_FAMILY, fontFaceCss } from "@/theme/fonts.web";
import { SYSTEM_MONO_STACK, SYSTEM_STACK, TEXT_STEPS, Text, VARIANTS, stepped, textStyle, type TextVariant } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { Icon } from "@/components/kit/Icon";
import { ICONS, type IconName } from "@/components/icons";
import { BREAKPOINTS, GUTTER, layoutKind } from "@/theme/layout";
import { MOTION } from "@/theme/motion";
import { LEGACY_COLOUR_FILES, SRC, sourceFiles } from "./legacy-files";

/**
 * The type, the fonts and the other constants of the design language (UI design, sections 4.3 to 4.7, 5.1 and 7.1):
 * the bundled font files exist and are declared as their packages declare them, their licences sit beside the app,
 * the text-size step's maths, the variants, and the icons' closed list.
 */
const APP = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const requireFromApp = createRequire(path.join(APP, "package.json"));
const PACKAGES = ["@fontsource-variable/fraunces", "@fontsource-variable/atkinson-hyperlegible-next", "@fontsource-variable/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono"];

/** The package CSS's @font-face rule for one woff2 file, as its fields. */
function packageRule(file: string): Record<string, string> {
  const pkg = file.split("/files/")[0]!;
  const name = file.split("/files/")[1]!;
  const dir = path.dirname(requireFromApp.resolve(`${pkg}/package.json`));
  for (const css of ["full.css", "full-italic.css", "wght.css", "wght-italic.css"]) {
    if (!existsSync(path.join(dir, css))) continue;
    for (const block of readFileSync(path.join(dir, css), "utf8").matchAll(/@font-face\s*\{([^}]*)\}/g)) {
      if (!block[1]!.includes(`./files/${name})`)) continue;
      return Object.fromEntries([...block[1]!.matchAll(/([a-z-]+)\s*:\s*([^;]+);/g)].map((match) => [match[1]!, match[2]!.trim()]));
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`no rule in ${pkg} names ${name}`);
}

});

      easeOut: { type: "timing", easing: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] },
      easeInOut: { type: "timing", easing: [0.77, 0, 0.175, 1] },
      springSnap: { type: "spring", dampingRatio: 1, duration: 300 },
      springRelease: { type: "spring", dampingRatio: 0.85, duration: 350 },
      press: { type: "timing", in: 100, out: 160, easing: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] },
      fade: { type: "timing", duration: 150, easing: [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] },
    });
  });

  test("tailwind.config.js adds section 4.5's five radii", () => {

    expect(config.theme.extend.borderRadius).toEqual({ control: "10px", media: "12px", card: "16px", sheet: "24px", full: "9999px" });
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type Ref } from "react";
import type { View } from "react-native";
import { useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import type { ImportStatus, ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { ImportProgress } from "@/components/import/ImportProgress";
import { ImportResult } from "@/components/import/ImportResult";
import { Preview } from "@/components/import/Preview";
import type { CardAuthor } from "@/components/import/PostList";
import { UploadProgress } from "@/components/import/UploadProgress";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/kit/ErrorState";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/kit/Skeleton";
import { VisuallyHidden } from "@/components/kit/VisuallyHidden";
import { ScreenHeader, ScreenScroll } from "@/components/ScreenHeader";
import { SettingsNav } from "@/components/SettingsNav";
import { useHaptics } from "@/lib/haptics";
import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { announcement, forgetUpload, IMPORT_POLL_MS, importErrorMessage, imports, useUploadRun, type UploadRunState } from "@/lib/imports";
import { usePageTitle } from "@/lib/page-title";
import { useSession } from "@/lib/session";

/**
 * One import, drawn by its state (3b design, sections 10.1 and 10.3 to 10.5): uploading and reading, the preview and the
 * choice, the progress, and the ends. While the import moves by itself (uploading elsewhere, reading, preparing,
 * publishing, removing) the screen reads it every 3 seconds while the page is visible; while this tab uploads it, the
 * upload's own answers move it. When its state changes while the screen is open, one polite sentence says so
 * (import.now.*), and the focus goes to the new view's level-2 heading, but only when the element that held it is gone
 * (WCAG 2.2 4.1.3 and 2.4.3). Nothing about an import is kept on the device.
 */

/** The states that change without the person: the screen reads the import again while one of them lasts. */
const MOVING: readonly ImportStatus[] = ["uploading", "scanning", "preparing", "publishing", "undoing"];

/** One import's view by its state, which the screen draws under its header and the render tests draw on their own. */
export function ImportStateView({
  view,
  author,
  onView,
  run = null,
  headingRef,
}: {
  view: ImportView;
  author: CardAuthor | null;
  onView: (next: ImportView) => void;
  run?: UploadRunState | null;
  headingRef?: Ref<View>;
}) {
  switch (view.status) {
    case "uploading":
    case "scanning":
      return <UploadProgress view={view} run={run} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} />;
    case "ready":
      return <Preview view={view} author={author} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} />;
    case "preparing":
    case "publishing":
    case "undoing":
      return <ImportProgress view={view} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} />;
    default:
      return <ImportResult view={view} author={author} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} />;
  }
}

/** The browser's document, typed locally, for the page's visibility and the element that has the focus. */
const page = () => (globalThis as unknown as { document?: { visibilityState?: string; activeElement?: { isConnected?: boolean } | null; body?: unknown; addEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void) => void; removeEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void) => void } }).document;

export default function ImportScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const title = usePageTitle("title.import");
  const { state } = useSession();
  const haptic = useHaptics();
  const profile = state.status === "signed-in" ? state.me.profile : null;
  const author: CardAuthor | null = profile ? { displayName: profile.displayName, handle: profile.handle } : null;
  const [view, setView] = useState<ImportView | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const run = useUploadRun(id);
  const heading = useRef<View>(null);
  /** The element that held the focus when a change of state arrived, to know after the render whether it is gone. */
  const focused = useRef<{ isConnected?: boolean } | null>(null);
  const shown = useRef<ImportStatus | null>(null);

  /** Every new view of the import goes through here: a change of state is said, and the focus kept or moved after it. */
  const apply = useCallback(
    (next: ImportView) => {
      const before = shown.current;
      if (before !== null && before !== next.status) {
        focused.current = page()?.activeElement ?? null;
        const words = announcement(before, next.status);
        if (words !== null) setSaid(words);
        // The removal's end is felt as well as heard (10.5).
        if (before === "undoing" && next.status === "undone") haptic("success");
      }
      shown.current = next.status;
      setView(next);
    },
    [haptic],
  );

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    imports.get(id).then(apply, setError);
  }, [id, apply]);
  useEffect(load, [load]);

  // The focus goes to the new view's heading when the element that held it left with the old view, or none holds it.
  useEffect(() => {
    const held = focused.current;
    if (held === null) return;
    focused.current = null;
    const doc = page();
    if (held.isConnected === false || doc?.activeElement === doc?.body || doc?.activeElement === null) (heading.current as unknown as { focus?: () => void } | null)?.focus?.();
  }, [view?.status]);

  // Read it again every 3 s while it moves by itself and the page is visible, and at once when the page shows again.
  const status = view?.status;
  const uploadingHere = run?.running === true;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === undefined || !MOVING.includes(status) || (status === "uploading" && uploadingHere)) return;
    const doc = page();
    const read = () => {
      if (doc?.visibilityState === "hidden") return;
      imports.get(id).then(apply, () => undefined);
    };
    const timer = setInterval(read, IMPORT_POLL_MS);
    const onVisible = () => {
      if (doc?.visibilityState === "visible") read();
    };
    doc?.addEventListener?.("visibilitychange", onVisible);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      doc?.removeEventListener?.("visibilitychange", onVisible);
    };
  }, [id, status, uploadingHere, apply]);

  // When this tab's upload ends (the last chunk, a refusal, a cancel), the import is read again for its new state.
  const runEnded = run !== null && !run.running;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!runEnded) return;
    imports.get(id).then((next) => {
      if (next.status !== "uploading") forgetUpload(id);
      apply(next);
    }, () => undefined);
  }, [id, runEnded, apply]);

  return (
    <AppShell>
      {title}
      <ScreenHeader title={IMPORT_WORDS["import.title"]} back="/settings/import">
        <SettingsNav current="import" />
      </ScreenHeader>
      <ScreenScroll screen="import">
        <VisuallyHidden role="status">{said}</VisuallyHidden>
        {error !== null ? (
          <ErrorState message={importErrorMessage(error)} onRetry={load} />
        ) : view === null ? (
          <Skeleton.Page />
        ) : (
          <ImportStateView view={view} author={author} onView={apply} run={run} headingRef={heading} />
        )}
      </ScreenScroll>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Platform, View } from "react-native";
import { router, useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import { ImportSource, type ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { ArchiveButton, type ChosenFile } from "@/components/import/UploadProgress";
import { SourcePicker } from "@/components/import/SourcePicker";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/kit/ErrorState";
import { ListRow } from "@/components/kit/ListRow";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/kit/Skeleton";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { ScreenHeader, ScreenScroll } from "@/components/ScreenHeader";
import { SettingsNav } from "@/components/SettingsNav";
import { Button, ErrorText, SectionRows } from "@/components/ui";
import { errorMessage } from "@/lib/api";
import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { formatBytes, importErrorMessage, imports, startUpload, type ImportList } from "@/lib/imports";
import { usePageTitle } from "@/lib/page-title";
import { localDay } from "@/lib/time";
import { fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";

/**
 * Settings, Import posts (3b design, sections 10.1 and 10.2): what an import is and the two sentences of decision 28,
 * Where from? with the sources the site has on, then for the chosen source how to get its archive and what korbat reads,
 * never reads and lets the person delete first; Choose your archive, which checks the file before anything is sent; and
 * with a good file, its name and size and Upload and read, which creates the import, starts the upload and moves to the
 * import's screen. Your imports lists the account's imports below. The web is the only platform for now: on iOS and
 * Android the screen says so and offers no file (sub-project 5 brings the picker there).
 */
export function ImportStart({ sources, imports: list, initialSource = null }: { sources: readonly ImportSource[]; imports: readonly ImportView[]; initialSource?: ImportSource | null }) {
  const [source, setSource] = useState<ImportSource | null>(initialSource !== null && sources.includes(initialSource) ? initialSource : null);
  const [file, setFile] = useState<ChosenFile | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const start = async () => {
    if (source === null || file === null || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const created = await imports.create(source, file.size);
      // The upload goes on in this tab while the person is on the import's screen, which follows it.
      startUpload(created, file);
      router.push(`/settings/import/${created.id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(importErrorMessage(err, { source, during: "create" }));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <Text className="mt-2">{IMPORT_WORDS["import.intro"]}</Text>
      <Text tone="medium" className="mt-3">
        {IMPORT_WORDS["import.found"]}
      </Text>
      <Text tone="medium" className="mt-3">
        {IMPORT_WORDS["import.unchecked"]}
      </Text>
      {Platform.OS !== "web" ? (
        <Text className="mt-6">{IMPORT_WORDS["import.webOnly"]}</Text>
      ) : (
        <>
          <SourcePicker
            sources={sources}
            chosen={source}
            onChoose={(next) => {
              setSource(next);
              setFile(null);
              setError(null);
            }}
          />
          {source !== null && sources.includes(source) ? (
            <View className="mt-4">
              <ArchiveButton
                source={source}
                onFile={(chosen) => {
                  setFile(chosen);
                  setError(null);
                }}
              />
              {file !== null ? (
                <>
                  <Text className="mt-3">{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.chosen"], { name: file.name, size: formatBytes(file.size) })}</Text>
                  <Button label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.start"]} busy={busy} full={false} onPress={() => void start()} />
                  <ErrorText message={error} />
                </>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </>
      )}
      {list.length > 0 ? (
        <View className="mt-8 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1 p-4">
          <Text as="h2" variant="title">
            {IMPORT_WORDS["import.yours"]}
          </Text>
          <SectionRows end>
            {list.map((item) => (
              <ListRow
                key={item.id}
                label={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.source.${item.source}`]}
                description={fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.row"], { state: IMPORT_WORDS[`import.state.${item.status}`], date: localDay(item.createdAt) })}
                icon="import"
                href={`/settings/import/${item.id}`}
              />
            ))}
          </SectionRows>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function ImportStartScreen() {
  const title = usePageTitle("title.import");
  // "Import the text only" after a refused image opens this screen with its source chosen (10.5).
  const { source } = useLocalSearchParams<{ source?: string }>();
  const [list, setList] = useState<ImportList | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    imports.list().then(setList, setError);
  }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load]);
  const asked = ImportSource.safeParse(source);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      {title}
      <ScreenHeader title={IMPORT_WORDS["import.title"]}>
        <SettingsNav current="import" />
      </ScreenHeader>
      <ScreenScroll screen="import">
        {error !== null ? (
          <ErrorState message={errorMessage(error)} onRetry={load} />
        ) : list === null ? (
          <Skeleton.Page />
        ) : (
          <ImportStart sources={list.sources} imports={list.imports} initialSource={asked.success ? asked.data : null} />
        )}
      </ScreenScroll>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/import/ImportProgress.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState, type ReactNode, type Ref } from "react";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { Link, type Href } from "expo-router";
import type { ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { FOCUS_RING } from "@/components/kit/interaction";
import { ProgressBar } from "@/components/kit/ProgressBar";
import { Sheet } from "@/components/kit/Sheet";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { Button, ErrorText, Notice } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, ruleWords } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { formatCount, importErrorMessage, imports } from "@/lib/imports";
import { UI_WORDS, fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";
import { cn } from "@/theme/cn";

/**
 * The parts every view of an import shares (3b design, sections 10.1 and 10.5), and the progress of an import that
 * prepares, publishes or removes its posts.
 */

/**
 * The level-2 heading each state's view starts with (10.1). It can take the focus (tabIndex -1), so the screen moves the
 * focus to it when a change of state removed the element that held it; it shows the kit's ring then.
 */
export function StateHeading({ children, headingRef, variant = "display-3" }: { children: string; headingRef?: Ref<View>; variant?: "display-3" | "title" }) {
  return (
    // The title variant heads the preview's first card, inside its padding; the others start a view.
    <Text as="h2" variant={variant} className={cn(variant === "title" ? undefined : "mt-6", "self-start rounded-sm", FOCUS_RING)} {...({ ref: headingRef, tabIndex: -1 } as object)}>
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

/** A sentence of a view, in ink-medium unless it is the view's news. */
export function Line({ children, tone = "medium" }: { children: string; tone?: "high" | "medium" }) {
  return (
    <Text tone={tone} className="mt-3">
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

/** A real link inside a view: accent-ink and underlined, 44 px tall, as TextLink is but at the start of its line. */
export function ViewLink({ label, href }: { label: string; href: Href }) {
  return (
    <Link href={href} asChild>
      <Pressable className={cn("mt-3 min-h-[44px] justify-center self-start rounded-control active:opacity-70", FOCUS_RING)}>
        <Text tone="accent" className="underline web:underline-offset-2">
          {label}
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Link>
  );
}

/**
 * A question asked once in a Sheet before an action that cannot be taken back (10.3: Cancel import; 10.5: Stop import,
 * Remove imported posts): the question names the dialog, the action in danger, the way back as a second button. A
 * refusal is said under them; the sheet stays open for another try.
 */
export function AskSheet({
  open,
  title,
  confirm,
  keep,
  busy,
  error,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
  onClosed,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  confirm: string;
  keep: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onClosed: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onClose={onClose} onClosed={onClosed} title={title}>
      <View className="px-5 pb-4">
        <ErrorText message={error} />
        <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-x-2">
          <Button label={confirm} tone="danger" full={false} busy={busy} onPress={onConfirm} />
          <Button label={keep} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={onClose} />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

/**
 * An action asked once (AskSheet) behind a secondary button, which then answers the import as it now stands: the view's
 * Cancel import, Stop import and Remove imported posts. `onAsk` runs as the sheet opens (the warning haptic of Remove).
 */
export function AskedAction({
  label,
  question,
  confirm,
  keep,
  act,
  onView,
  onAsk,
}: {
  label: string;
  question: string;
  confirm: string;
  keep: string;
  act: () => Promise<ImportView>;
  onView: (next: ImportView) => void;
  onAsk?: () => void;
}) {
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState({ mounted: false, open: false });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const run = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const next = await act();
      setSheet({ mounted: true, open: false });
      onView(next);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(importErrorMessage(err, { during: "act" }));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        label={label}
        tone="secondary"
        full={false}
        onPress={() => {
          onAsk?.();
          setError(null);
          setSheet({ mounted: true, open: true });
        }}
      />
      {sheet.mounted ? (
        <AskSheet
          open={sheet.open}
          title={question}
          confirm={confirm}
          keep={keep}
          busy={busy}
          error={error}
          onConfirm={() => void run()}
          onClose={() => setSheet({ mounted: true, open: false })}
          onClosed={() => setSheet({ mounted: false, open: false })}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** A phase's bar with its words above it as its value text ("Publishing posts: 800 of 1,240"). */
function Phase({ words, done, total }: { words: string; done: number; total: number }) {
  const text = fill(words, { done: formatCount(done), total: formatCount(total) });
  return (
    <View className="mt-4 gap-2">
      <Text variant="body-strong">{text}</Text>
      <ProgressBar label={text} value={done} max={total} valueText={text} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * Preparing and publishing (10.5): a bar per phase, You can leave this page, and Stop import, asked once; while the author
 * is suspended, the notice that the import is paused (its bars stand still, since nothing moves). Removing (10.5): the
 * bar of the posts removed, and when korbat's staff ended the import, their sentence with the link to the decision (8.7).
 */
export function ImportProgress({ view, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const { progress } = view;
  if (view.status === "undoing") {
    return (
      <View>
        <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.state.undoing"]}</StateHeading>
        {view.endedByStaff !== null ? <StaffEnded view={view} /> : null}
        <Phase words={IMPORT_WORDS["import.removing"]} done={progress.postsRemoved} total={progress.postsPublished} />
      </View>
    );
  }
  return (
    <View>
      <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS[view.status === "preparing" ? "import.state.preparing" : "import.state.publishing"]}</StateHeading>
      {view.paused ? <Notice message={IMPORT_WORDS["import.paused"]} /> : null}
      {view.status === "preparing" ? <Phase words={IMPORT_WORDS["import.preparing"]} done={progress.imagesSettled} total={progress.imagesTotal} /> : null}
      <Phase words={IMPORT_WORDS["import.publishing"]} done={progress.postsPublished} total={progress.postsTotal} />
      <Line>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.leave"]}</Line>
      <View className="mt-2">
        <AskedAction
          label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stop"]}
          question={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stop.ask"]}
          confirm={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stop"]}
          keep={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stop.keep"]}
          act={() => imports.stop(view.id)}
          onView={onView}
        />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/** korbat's staff ended the import (8.7): their rule, and the decision, which can be appealed, under the person's Cases. */
export function StaffEnded({ view }: { view: ImportView }): ReactNode {
  return (
    <View>
      <Line tone="high">{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.endedByStaff"], { rule: ruleWords(view.endedByStaff ?? "") })}</Line>
      {view.staffDecisionId !== null ? <ViewLink label={UI_WORDS["reach.decision"]} href={`/settings/cases/${view.staffDecisionId}`} /> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Ref } from "react";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { Link, type Href } from "expo-router";
import { IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS, type ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Icon } from "@/components/kit/Icon";
import { ListRow } from "@/components/kit/ListRow";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { buttonFace, LABEL_TONE } from "@/components/ui";
import { useHaptics } from "@/lib/haptics";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, ruleWords, sourceName } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { formatCount, imports } from "@/lib/imports";
import { utcDay } from "@/lib/time";
import { UI_WORDS, fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";
import { AskedAction, Line, StaffEnded, StateHeading, ViewLink } from "./ImportProgress";
import type { CardAuthor } from "./PostList";

/**
 * An import that has ended (3b design, sections 10.3 and 10.5): done, with what was left out while it published, the way
 * to the Imported tab and Remove imported posts; stopped, by its reason (a refused image with the post's day and first
 * words, the notice and the text only; the person's Stop or the time, with the published count and Remove; korbat's
 * staff, with the rule); removed, cancelled, expired and failed, one sentence each and the way to start again. Remove
 * asks once in a Sheet, with the warning haptic as it opens; the screen plays success when the removal ends.
 */

/** "See your Imported tab" (10.5): a link drawn with the primary Button's face, since it goes somewhere. */
function PrimaryLink({ label, href }: { label: string; href: Href }) {
  return (
    <Link href={href} asChild>
      <Pressable className={`mt-4 self-start ${buttonFace({ face: "primary", size: "md" })}`}>
        <Text variant="body-strong" tone={LABEL_TONE.primary}>
          {label}
        </Text>
      </Pressable>
    </Link>
  );
}

/** Remove imported posts, asked once (10.5): it deletes them for everyone and cannot be undone. */
function RemovePosts({ view, onView }: { view: ImportView; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const haptic = useHaptics();
  return (
    <AskedAction
      label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.remove"]}
      question={fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.remove.ask"], { n: formatCount(view.progress.postsPublished) })}
      confirm={IMPORT_WORDS["import.remove.confirm"]}
      keep={IMPORT_WORDS["import.remove.keep"]}
      act={() => imports.undo(view.id)}
      onView={onView}
      onAsk={() => haptic("warning")}
    />
  );
}

/** The stopped import's sentence, by its reason (10.5). */
function stoppedWords(view: ImportView): string {
  const n = formatCount(view.progress.postsPublished);
  switch (view.stopReason) {
    case "refused_image":
      return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.refused_image"], { date: view.refusedAt === null ? "" : utcDay(view.refusedAt), words: view.refusedWords ?? "" });
    case "by_staff":
      return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.by_staff"], { rule: ruleWords(view.endedByStaff ?? ""), n });
    case "time_ran_out":
      return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.time_ran_out"], { n });
    default:
      return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.by_author"], { n });
  }
}

export function ImportResult({ view, author, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; author: CardAuthor | null; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const again = <ViewLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.again"]} href="/settings/import" />;
  const heading = <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS[`import.state.${view.status}`]}</StateHeading>;

  if (view.status === "done") {
    const leftOut = IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS.map((reason) => [reason, view.progress.imagesLeftOut[reason] ?? 0] as const).filter(([, count]) => count > 0);
    return (
      <View>
        {heading}
        <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-start gap-3 rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
          <View className="pt-[2px]">
            <Icon name="done" size={20} tone="accent" />
          </View>
          <Text className="flex-1">{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.done"], { n: formatCount(view.progress.postsPublished) })}</Text>
        </View>
        {leftOut.length > 0 ? (
          <View className="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1">
            <View className="-mb-px">
              {leftOut.map(([reason, count]) => (
                <ListRow key={reason} info label={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.image.${reason}`]} value={formatCount(count)} />
              ))}
            </View>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {author !== null ? <PrimaryLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.done.view"]} href={`/u/${author.handle}?tab=imported`} /> : null}
        {view.undoable ? (
          <>
            <View className="mt-6 h-px bg-line-low" />
            <View className="mt-2">
              <RemovePosts view={view} onView={onView} />
            </View>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (view.status === "stopped") {
    return (
      <View>
        {heading}
        <Line tone="high">{stoppedWords(view)}</Line>
        {view.stopReason === "refused_image" ? (
          <>
            {view.refusalId !== null ? <ViewLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.notice"]} href={`/settings/cases/uploads/${view.refusalId}`} /> : null}
            <ViewLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.stopped.textOnly"]} href={`/settings/import?source=${view.source}`} />
          </>
        ) : null}
        {view.stopReason === "by_staff" && view.staffDecisionId !== null ? <ViewLink label={UI_WORDS["reach.decision"]} href={`/settings/cases/${view.staffDecisionId}`} /> : null}
        {view.undoable && view.stopReason !== "by_staff" ? (
          <View className="mt-2">
            <RemovePosts view={view} onView={onView} />
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (view.status === "failed") {
    return (
      <View>
        {heading}
        <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-start gap-2">
          <View className="pt-[3px]">
            <Icon name="error" size={16} tone="danger" />
          </View>
          <Text accessibilityRole="alert" tone="danger" className="shrink">
            {fill(IMPORT_WORDS[`import.failure.${view.failure ?? "unreadable"}`], { source: sourceName(view.source) })}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <ViewLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.startAgain"]} href="/settings/import" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View>
      {heading}
      {view.status === "undone" && view.endedByStaff !== null ? (
        <StaffEnded view={view} />
      ) : (
        <Line tone="high">{IMPORT_WORDS[view.status === "undone" ? "import.removed" : view.status === "cancelled" ? "import.cancelled" : "import.expired"]}</Line>
      )}
      {again}
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/import/PostList.tsx`

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useState } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import { Image } from "expo-image";
import type { ImportChoice, ImportLineView, ImportSource, ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Avatar } from "@/components/kit/Avatar";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/kit/Checkbox";
import { Icon } from "@/components/kit/Icon";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/kit/Skeleton";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { Button, ErrorText, Field } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, importedLabel } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { formatCount, importErrorMessage, imports, marksPass, monthInChoice, shortened } from "@/lib/imports";
import { UI_WORDS, fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";

/**
 * The list of posts (3b design, section 10.4): every offered line of the archive as it will read, 50 a page, in the
 * archive's order, each with "Leave this one out", the lines the current choice leaves out drawn in ink-low with their
 * reason, and, while images are brought, each image with a field for a description where its source gave none. Each
 * change is saved at once (PUT /api/imports/:id/lines/:ref), so a reload loses nothing; nothing is kept on the device.
 * Samples and lines are not PostViews, so they are drawn as a static card: the person's own name, the label, and the
 * words as plain text, no link, no mention, no action.
 */

/** Who the preview's cards are by: the person importing, as their profile names them. */
export interface CardAuthor {
  displayName: string;
  handle: string;
}

/**
 * A post of the archive as it will read on korbat (10.4): the person's avatar, name and handle, the provenance label as
 * text (the source and the archive's day; ", shortened on import" when the choice cuts it), and the words, plain.
 * `dimmed` draws it in ink-low, for a line the choice leaves out.
 */
export function StaticCard({ author, source, at, text, long = false, cut = false, dimmed = false }: { author: CardAuthor; source: ImportSource; at: string; text: string; long?: boolean; cut?: boolean; dimmed?: boolean }) {
  const shown = long && cut ? shortened(text) : { body: text, cut: false };
  const label = importedLabel({ source, at, shortened: shown.cut });
  const tone = dimmed ? "low" : "high";
  return (
    <View className="flex-row gap-2 py-3">
      <View aria-hidden className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center">
        <Avatar account={{ id: author.handle, displayName: author.displayName }} size={40} />
      </View>
      <View className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <View className="flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1.5">
          <Text variant="body-strong" tone={tone}>
            {author.displayName}
          </Text>
          <Text variant="mono" tone="low">
            {`@${author.handle}`}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <View className="flex-row items-center gap-1.5 py-1">
          <Icon name="import" size={16} tone={dimmed ? "low" : "medium"} />
          <Text variant="meta" tone={dimmed ? "low" : "medium"} className="shrink">
            {label.text}
          </Text>
        </View>
        {shown.body !== "" ? (
          <Text variant="post" tone={tone} className="mt-1 web:break-words">
            {shown.body}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const MARK_WORDS = [
  [1, "import.dimmed.reply"],
  [2, "import.dimmed.long"],
  [4, "import.dimmed.warning"],
  [8, "import.dimmed.protected"],
] as const;

/** Why the choice leaves a line out, in import.list.dimmed's words; null when it keeps it (a pick by hand is the checkbox's). */
export function dimmedReason(line: Pick<ImportLineView, "at" | "marks">, choice: ImportChoice): string | null {
  if (!monthInChoice(line.at.slice(0, 7), choice)) return IMPORT_WORDS["import.dimmed.month"];
  const refused = MARK_WORDS.find(([bit]) => (line.marks & bit) !== 0 && !marksPass(bit, choice));
  return refused ? IMPORT_WORDS[refused[1]] : null;
}

/** One line of the list, with its checkbox and, while images are brought, its images and their description fields. */
function LineRow({ importId, source, line, choice, images, author, onPick }: { importId: string; source: ImportSource; line: ImportLineView; choice: ImportChoice; images: boolean; author: CardAuthor; onPick: (ref: number, leftOut: boolean, alts: (string | null)[]) => void }) {
  const reasonId = useId();
  const reason = dimmedReason(line, choice);
  const [alts, setAlts] = useState<string[]>(() => line.media.map((_, index) => line.alts[index] ?? ""));
  const saved = (next: string[]) => next.map((alt) => (alt.trim() === "" ? null : alt.trim()));
  return (
    <View {...({ dataSet: { line: String(line.ref) } } as object)} className="border-b border-line-low">
      <StaticCard author={author} source={source} at={line.at} text={line.text} long={(line.marks & 2) !== 0} cut={choice.long === "shorten"} dimmed={reason !== null || line.leftOut} />
      {reason !== null ? (
        <Text nativeID={reasonId} variant="meta" tone="medium" className="pl-[52px]">
          {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.dimmed"], { reason })}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
      {images && line.media.length > 0 ? (
        <View className="gap-3 pl-[52px] pt-2">
          {line.media.map((media, index) => (
            <View key={media.file} className="gap-1">
              <Image
                source={{ uri: imports.mediaUri(importId, media.file) }}
                accessibilityLabel={media.alt ?? (alts[index]?.trim() || IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.imageNoAlt"])}
                contentFit="cover"
                style={{ width: 120, height: 90, borderRadius: 8 }}
              />
              {media.alt === null ? (
                <Field
                  label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.describe"]}
                  value={alts[index] ?? ""}
                  maxLength={1000}
                  multiline
                  onChangeText={(text) => setAlts((current) => current.map((alt, at) => (at === index ? text : alt)))}
                  onBlur={() => onPick(line.ref, line.leftOut, saved(alts))}
                />
              ) : null}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View className="pl-[52px]">
        <Checkbox label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.leaveOut"]} checked={line.leftOut} describedBy={reason !== null ? reasonId : undefined} onChange={(leftOut) => onPick(line.ref, leftOut, saved(alts))} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The lines loaded so far, with the range they cover and the way to the next page. Presentational: the panel below reads
 * the pages and saves the picks.
 */
export function PostList({
  importId,
  source,
  lines,
  pages,
  page,
  choice,
  images,
  author,
  onPick,
  onPage,
  total,
}: {
  importId: string;
  source: ImportSource;
  lines: readonly ImportLineView[];
  pages: number;
  /** The last page loaded, from 0. */
  page: number;
  choice: ImportChoice;
  images: boolean;
  author: CardAuthor;
  onPick: (ref: number, leftOut: boolean, alts: (string | null)[]) => void;
  onPage: () => void;
  total?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <View className="mt-3">
      {total !== undefined && lines.length > 0 ? (
        <Text variant="meta" tone="medium">
          {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.range"], { from: "1", to: formatCount(lines.length), total: formatCount(total) })}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
      {lines.map((line) => (
        <LineRow key={line.ref} importId={importId} source={source} line={line} choice={choice} images={images} author={author} onPick={onPick} />
      ))}
      {page + 1 < pages ? <Button label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.list.more"]} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={onPage} /> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * See every post's panel: reads the pages of GET /api/imports/:id/lines one after the other, and saves each pick at once,
 * handing the picks' new counts to the preview (`onPicks`), so its totals stay exact. A pick refused is said under the
 * list and its line keeps what the API holds.
 */
export function PostListPanel({ view, choice, images, author, onPicks }: { view: ImportView; choice: ImportChoice; images: boolean; author: CardAuthor; onPicks: (picks: ImportView["picks"]) => void }) {
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<ImportLineView[]>([]);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(-1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const load = useCallback(
    async (next: number) => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const answer = await imports.lines(view.id, next);
        setLines((current) => [...current, ...answer.lines.filter((line) => !current.some((held) => held.ref === line.ref))]);
        setPages(answer.pages);
        setPage(next);
      } catch (err) {
        setError(importErrorMessage(err, { during: "act" }));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [view.id],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    void load(0);
  }, [load]);
  const pick = async (ref: number, leftOut: boolean, alts: (string | null)[]) => {
    setLines((current) => current.map((line) => (line.ref === ref ? { ...line, leftOut } : line)));
    try {
      const answer = await imports.pick(view.id, ref, { leftOut, alts: alts.slice(0, 4) });
      setLines((current) => current.map((line) => (line.ref === ref ? { ...line, leftOut: answer.leftOut, alts: answer.alts } : line)));
      onPicks(answer.picks);
    } catch (err) {
      setLines((current) => current.map((line) => (line.ref === ref ? { ...line, leftOut: !leftOut } : line)));
      setError(importErrorMessage(err, { during: "act" }));
    }
  };
  return (
    <View>
      <PostList
        importId={view.id}
        source={view.source}
        lines={lines}
        pages={pages}
        page={page}
        choice={choice}
        images={images}
        author={author}
        onPick={(ref, leftOut, alts) => void pick(ref, leftOut, alts)}
        onPage={() => void load(page + 1)}
        total={view.scan?.posts}
      />
      {loading ? <Skeleton.Page /> : null}
      <ErrorText message={error} />
      {error !== null && page < 0 ? <Button label={UI_WORDS["error.retry"]} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={() => void load(0)} /> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/import/Preview.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ReactNode, type Ref } from "react";
import { Platform, Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS, IMPORT_RULES, IMPORT_SKIP_REASONS, type ImportChoice, type ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/kit/Checkbox";
import { dataAttribute } from "@/components/kit/interaction";
import { ListRow, RadioGroup } from "@/components/kit/ListRow";
import { MonthPicker } from "@/components/kit/MonthPicker";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { VisuallyHidden } from "@/components/kit/VisuallyHidden";
import { toast } from "@/components/toast";
import { Button, buttonFace, ErrorText, LABEL_TONE, SectionRows } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, sourceName } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { chosenTotals, formatCount, foundImages, imagesOn, importErrorMessage, imports, leftOutCounts, startingChoice, undescribedCount } from "@/lib/imports";
import { fullDate, monthWords } from "@/lib/time";
import { UI_WORDS, fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";
import { AskedAction, StateHeading, ViewLink } from "./ImportProgress";
import { PostListPanel, StaticCard, type CardAuthor } from "./PostList";

/**
 * The preview and the choice (3b design, section 10.4), in one column of four cards: What we found (the counts, the three
 * newest posts as static cards and See every post), What will be left out (one row a reason with its count, posts then
 * images), Choose (the range, replies, long posts, warnings, protected posts, images, and the live result), and Confirm
 * (the rules, decision 28's two sentences again, the statement and Publish). The counts are the app's own, from the
 * month table and the picks, as the API counts them (lib/imports.ts's chosenTotals), so Publish says exactly what will
 * happen. The choice lives on this screen only: nothing is kept on the device.
 */

/** A card of the preview with its level-2 heading; the first one's heading is the view's (StateHeading). */
function Card({ heading, children }: { heading: ReactNode; children: ReactNode }) {
  return <View className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1 p-4">{heading}{children}</View>;
}

function CardTitle({ children, id }: { children: string; id?: string }) {
  return (
    <Text as="h2" variant="title" nativeID={id}>
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

/** A count's row in What will be left out: the reason's words, and the count at its end. */
function CountRow({ words, count }: { words: string; count: number }) {
  return <ListRow info label={words} value={formatCount(count)} />;
}

/** How long the preview waits after the person stops changing the choice before its result is said (10.4). */
const SAY_AFTER_MS = 500;

export function Preview({ view, author, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; author: CardAuthor | null; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const [choice, setChoice] = useState<ImportChoice>(() => startingChoice(view));
  const [range, setRange] = useState(() => choice.from !== null || choice.to !== null);
  const [picks, setPicks] = useState(view.picks);
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState(false);
  const [listOpen, setListOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const statementRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const publishRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const reasonId = useId();
  const chooseId = useId();
  const longId = useId();
  const scan = view.scan;
  const tables = { scan, picks };
  const on = imagesOn(view);
  const bring = on && choice.images;
  const totals = chosenTotals(tables, choice, bring);
  const result = fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.result"], { posts: formatCount(totals.posts), images: formatCount(totals.images) });

  // The result is said politely once the person has stopped changing the choice for 500 ms, never as the preview opens.
  const opened = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (opened.current) {
      opened.current = false;
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setSaid(result), SAY_AFTER_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [result]);

  // Publish stays a tab stop while it cannot publish (10.4). react-native-web draws a role=button as a native button and
  // makes any disabled state of its own (disabled, aria-disabled, accessibilityDisabled) the native disabled attribute,
  // which takes it out of the tab order; so the state is written on the element itself, which React then leaves alone.
  const blocked = !(statement && totals.posts > 0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (Platform.OS !== "web") return;
    const node = publishRef.current as unknown as { setAttribute?: (name: string, value: string) => void; removeAttribute?: (name: string) => void } | null;
    if (blocked) node?.setAttribute?.("aria-disabled", "true");
    else node?.removeAttribute?.("aria-disabled");
  }, [blocked, scan]);

  if (scan === null) {
    return (
      <View>
        <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.found.title"]}</StateHeading>
        <ErrorText message={IMPORT_WORDS["import.wrongState"]} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const change = (patch: Partial<ImportChoice>) => setChoice((current) => ({ ...current, ...patch }));
  const months = scan.months.map(({ month }) => month);
  const images = foundImages(scan);
  const appSkips = leftOutCounts(tables, choice);
  const postRows = IMPORT_SKIP_REASONS.map((reason) => [reason, (scan.skipped[reason] ?? 0) + (appSkips[reason as keyof typeof appSkips] ?? 0)] as const).filter(([, count]) => count > 0);
  const missing = bring ? undescribedCount(tables, choice) : 0;
  // While images come with the import, those of the chosen posts that the choice does not bring, or that lack a description.
  const appImages: Partial<Record<(typeof IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS)[number], number>> = {
    not_chosen: on && !choice.images ? chosenTotals(tables, choice, true).images + undescribedCount(tables, choice) : 0,
    no_description: missing,
  };
  const imageRows = IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS.map((reason) => [reason, (scan.imagesSkipped[reason] ?? 0) + (appImages[reason] ?? 0)] as const).filter(([, count]) => count > 0);
  const can = statement && totals.posts > 0;
  const reason = !statement ? IMPORT_WORDS["import.publish.needStatement"] : totals.posts === 0 ? IMPORT_WORDS["import.publish.nothing"] : null;
  const keptUntil = fullDate(new Date(Date.parse(view.createdAt) + IMPORT_RULES.previewHours * 3_600_000).toISOString());

  const publish = async () => {
    // Pressed while it cannot publish, it takes the person to what is missing: the statement (10.4).
    if (!statement) {
      statementRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (totals.posts === 0 || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const next = await imports.confirm(view.id, { ...choice, images: bring });
      // The person is already on the import's screen: the toast announces, with no action (UI design, 5.4).
      toast.show({ message: IMPORT_WORDS["import.started"] });
      onView(next);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(importErrorMessage(err, { during: "act" }));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <Card
        heading={
          <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef} variant="title">
            {IMPORT_WORDS["import.found.title"]}
          </StateHeading>
        }
      >
        <Text className="mt-2">{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.found.posts"], { n: formatCount(scan.posts), first: scan.first === null ? "" : monthWords(scan.first), last: scan.last === null ? "" : monthWords(scan.last) })}</Text>
        {(scan.imagesSkipped.images_off ?? 0) > 0 ? (
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-1">
            {IMPORT_WORDS["import.found.imagesOff"]}
          </Text>
        ) : view.source !== "bluesky" && images.n > 0 ? (
          <Text className="mt-1">{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.found.images"], { n: formatCount(images.n), kept: formatCount(images.kept) })}</Text>
        ) : null}
        {view.samples.length > 0 && author !== null ? (
          <>
            <Text as="h3" variant="body-strong" className="mt-5">
              {IMPORT_WORDS["import.samples"]}
            </Text>
            <View {...dataAttribute("samples")}>
              {view.samples.map((sample) => (
                <StaticCard key={`${sample.at} ${sample.text}`} author={author} source={view.source} at={sample.at} text={sample.text} />
              ))}
            </View>
            <View {...dataAttribute("samples-end")} />
          </>
        ) : null}
        {listOpen && author !== null ? (
          <PostListPanel view={view} choice={choice} images={bring} author={author} onPicks={setPicks} />
        ) : (
          <Button label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.seeAll"]} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={() => setListOpen(true)} />
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card heading={<CardTitle>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.left.title"]}</CardTitle>}>
        <SectionRows end={scan.cleaned === 0 && scan.sourceLinks === 0}>
          {postRows.map(([skip, count]) => (
            <CountRow key={skip} words={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.skip.${skip}`]} count={count} />
          ))}
          {imageRows.map(([skip, count]) => (
            <CountRow key={skip} words={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.image.${skip}`]} count={count} />
          ))}
        </SectionRows>
        {scan.cleaned > 0 ? (
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-3">
            {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.cleaned"], { n: formatCount(scan.cleaned) })}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        {scan.sourceLinks > 0 ? (
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-2">
            {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.sourceLinks"], { source: sourceName(view.source) })}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </Card>

      <Card heading={<CardTitle id={chooseId}>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.title"]}</CardTitle>}>
        <SectionRows>
          <RadioGroup labelledBy={chooseId}>
            <ListRow
              label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.all"]}
              control={{
                kind: "radio",
                checked: !range,
                onSelect: () => {
                  setRange(false);
                  change({ from: null, to: null });
                },
              }}
            />
            <ListRow
              label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.range"]}
              control={{
                kind: "radio",
                checked: range,
                onSelect: () => {
                  setRange(true);
                  change({ from: choice.from ?? scan.first, to: choice.to ?? scan.last });
                },
              }}
            />
          </RadioGroup>
        </SectionRows>
        {range && choice.from !== null && choice.to !== null ? (
          <View className="mt-3 flex-row flex-wrap gap-2">
            <MonthPicker label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.from"]} months={months} value={choice.from} onChange={(from) => change({ from, to: choice.to !== null && choice.to < from ? from : choice.to })} />
            <MonthPicker label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.to"]} months={months.filter((month) => month >= (choice.from ?? ""))} value={choice.to} onChange={(to) => change({ to })} />
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <SectionRows>
          <ListRow label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.replies"]} description={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.replies.desc"]} control={{ kind: "switch", value: choice.replies, onValueChange: (replies) => change({ replies }) }} />
          {scan.warnings > 0 ? (
            <ListRow
              label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.warnings"]}
              description={fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.warnings"], { n: formatCount(scan.warnings) })}
              control={{ kind: "switch", value: choice.warnings, onValueChange: (warnings) => change({ warnings }) }}
            />
          ) : null}
          {view.source === "x" && scan.protectedPosts > 0 ? (
            <ListRow label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.protected"]} description={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.protected.desc"]} control={{ kind: "switch", value: choice.protected, onValueChange: (value) => change({ protected: value }) }} />
          ) : null}
          {on && images.kept > 0 ? (
            <ListRow label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.images"]} description={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.images.desc"]} control={{ kind: "switch", value: choice.images, onValueChange: (value) => change({ images: value }) }} />
          ) : null}
        </SectionRows>
        {bring && missing > 0 ? (
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-3">
            {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.images.noAlt"], { n: formatCount(missing) })}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        <Text as="h3" variant="body-strong" nativeID={longId} className="mt-5">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.long"]}
        </Text>
        <SectionRows>
          <RadioGroup labelledBy={longId}>
            <ListRow label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.long.leave"]} control={{ kind: "radio", checked: choice.long === "leave", onSelect: () => change({ long: "leave" }) }} />
            <ListRow label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose.long.shorten"]} control={{ kind: "radio", checked: choice.long === "shorten", onSelect: () => change({ long: "shorten" }) }} />
          </RadioGroup>
        </SectionRows>
        <Text variant="body-strong" className="mt-4">
          {result}
        </Text>
        <VisuallyHidden role="status">{said}</VisuallyHidden>
      </Card>

      <Text tone="medium" className="mt-6">
        {fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.keptUntil"], { time: keptUntil })}
      </Text>
      <Card heading={<CardTitle>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.confirm.title"]}</CardTitle>}>
        <Text className="mt-2">{IMPORT_WORDS["import.rules"]}</Text>
        <ViewLink label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.rules.link"]} href="/rules" />
        <Text tone="medium" className="mt-2">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.found"]}
        </Text>
        <Text tone="medium" className="mt-2">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.unchecked"]}
        </Text>
        <Checkbox ref={statementRef} label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.statement"]} checked={statement} onChange={setStatement} className="mt-4" />
        <Text tone="medium" className="pl-8">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.statement.after"]}
        </Text>
        {/* Publish stays a tab stop while it cannot be used (aria-disabled), its reason under it, tied by aria-describedby. */}
        <View className="mt-6 self-stretch">
          <Pressable
            ref={publishRef}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-describedby={reason === null ? undefined : reasonId}
            aria-busy={busy}
            onPress={() => void publish()}
            className={buttonFace({ face: can ? "primary" : "inactive", size: "lg" })}
          >
            <Text variant="body-strong" tone={LABEL_TONE[can ? "primary" : "inactive"]} className="shrink text-center">
              {busy ? UI_WORDS["button.busy"] : fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.publish"], { n: formatCount(totals.posts) })}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
        {reason !== null ? (
          <Text nativeID={reasonId} tone="medium" className="mt-2">
            {reason}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        <ErrorText message={error} />
        <View className="mt-2">
          <AskedAction label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel"]} question={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel.ask"]} confirm={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel"]} keep={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel.keep"]} act={() => imports.cancel(view.id)} onView={onView} />
        </View>
      </Card>
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/import/SourcePicker.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import type { ImportSource } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ListRow, RadioGroup } from "@/components/kit/ListRow";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { SectionRows } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "@/lib/import-words";

/**
 * Where from? (3b design, section 10.2, steps 2 and 3): a radio group of ListRows, one per source the site has on (the
 * `sources` of GET /api/imports, so Bluesky only when the owner turned it on, decision 16), each with its line; once a
 * source is chosen, how to get its archive as numbered steps, what korbat reads and never reads, the transit, and what
 * the person may delete from the archive first (decisions 4 and 28).
 */

/** The steps of import.how.<source>, written as "1. ... 2. ...", as a list of their sentences. */
export function howSteps(source: ImportSource): string[] {
  return IMPORT_WORDS[`import.how.${source}`]
    .split(/(?:^|\s)[0-9]+\.\s/)
    .map((step) => step.trim())
    .filter((step) => step !== "");
}

/** A heading inside the start's card, level 3, under Where from?'s level 2. */
function Subheading({ children }: { children: string }) {
  return (
    <Text as="h3" variant="body-strong" className="mt-5">
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

export function SourcePicker({ sources, chosen, onChoose }: { sources: readonly ImportSource[]; chosen: ImportSource | null; onChoose: (source: ImportSource) => void }) {
  const headingId = useId();
  return (
    <View className="mt-8 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1 p-4">
      <Text as="h2" variant="title" nativeID={headingId}>
        {IMPORT_WORDS["import.whereFrom"]}
      </Text>
      {sources.length === 0 ? (
        <Text tone="medium" className="mt-2">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.unavailable"]}
        </Text>
      ) : (
        <SectionRows end={chosen === null}>
          <RadioGroup labelledBy={headingId}>
            {sources.map((source) => (
              <ListRow key={source} label={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.source.${source}`]} description={IMPORT_WORDS[`import.source.${source}.desc`]} control={{ kind: "radio", checked: source === chosen, onSelect: () => onChoose(source) }} />
            ))}
          </RadioGroup>
        </SectionRows>
      )}
      {chosen === null ? null : (
        <View>
          <Subheading>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.how.title"]}</Subheading>
          <View role="list" className="mt-2 gap-2">
            {howSteps(chosen).map((step, index) => (
              <View key={step} role="listitem" className="flex-row gap-2">
                <Text tone="medium" aria-hidden>
                  {`${index + 1}.`}
                </Text>
                <Text className="flex-1">{step}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
          <Subheading>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.reads.title"]}</Subheading>
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-1">
            {IMPORT_WORDS["import.reads.body"]}
          </Text>
          <Subheading>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.never.title"]}</Subheading>
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-1">
            {IMPORT_WORDS[`import.never.${chosen}`]}
          </Text>
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-4">
            {IMPORT_WORDS["import.transit"]}
          </Text>
          <Text tone="medium" className="mt-2">
            {IMPORT_WORDS[`import.trim.${chosen}`]}
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/import/UploadProgress.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type Ref } from "react";
import { Platform, View } from "react-native";
import Animated from "react-native-reanimated";
import type { ImportSource, ImportView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Icon } from "@/components/kit/Icon";
import { ProgressBar } from "@/components/kit/ProgressBar";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";
import { VisuallyHidden } from "@/components/kit/VisuallyHidden";
import { Button, ErrorText } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, sourceName } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { archiveProblem, formatBytes, imports, startUpload, stopUpload, uploadFile, type UploadRunState } from "@/lib/imports";
import { useMotion, useSpin } from "@/lib/motion";
import { UI_WORDS, fill } from "@/lib/ui-words";
import { AskedAction, Line, StateHeading } from "./ImportProgress";

/**
 * The archive on its way in and being read (3b design, sections 4.2 and 10.3): the button that picks the file and checks
 * it before anything is sent, the upload's bar, the resume after a reload, and the reading screen. The file is held in
 * this tab's memory only (lib/imports.ts's runs); nothing is kept on the device.
 */

/** A file the browser handed over: a Blob with its name. */
export type ChosenFile = Blob & { name: string };

/** The browser's document, typed locally: the picker is an input element made for one choice and removed after it. */
interface PickerDocument {
  createElement(tag: "input"): {
    type: string;
    accept: string;
    style: { display: string };
    files: ArrayLike<ChosenFile> | null;
    addEventListener(type: "change" | "cancel", listener: () => void): void;
    click(): void;
    remove(): void;
  };
  body: { appendChild(node: unknown): void };
}

/** Opens the browser's file picker for one file of `accept` (10.2 step 4); null when the person picked none. */
function pickFile(accept: string): Promise<ChosenFile | null> {
  const doc = (globalThis as unknown as { document?: PickerDocument }).document;
  if (!doc) return Promise.resolve(null);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = doc.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = accept;
    input.style.display = "none";
    input.addEventListener("change", () => {
      const file = input.files && input.files.length > 0 ? input.files[0]! : null;
      input.remove();
      resolve(file);
    });
    input.addEventListener("cancel", () => {
      input.remove();
      resolve(null);
    });
    doc.body.appendChild(input);
    input.click();
  });
}

/** The archives each source gives (10.2 step 4): a zip for X and Mastodon, a CAR for Bluesky. */
const ACCEPT: Record<ImportSource, string> = { x: ".zip", mastodon: ".zip", bluesky: ".car" };

/** The first bytes the check reads (4.2 step 2), as many as the API's own check. */
const HEAD_BYTES = 16;

/**
 * "Choose your archive" (10.2 step 4, 10.3's resume): the browser's file picker, then the checks of 4.2 step 2 before
 * anything is sent, the size (at most 2 GB, or exactly the size the upload started with when it goes on) and the first
 * bytes; a problem is said at once under the button as an alert. A file that passes is handed to `onFile`.
 */
export function ArchiveButton({ source, expectedBytes, onFile }: { source: ImportSource; expectedBytes?: number; onFile: (file: ChosenFile) => void }) {
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const choose = async () => {
    const file = await pickFile(ACCEPT[source]);
    if (file === null) return;
    if (expectedBytes !== undefined && file.size !== expectedBytes) {
      setProblem(IMPORT_WORDS["import.wrongFile"]);
      return;
    }
    const head = new Uint8Array(await file.slice(0, HEAD_BYTES).arrayBuffer());
    const found = archiveProblem(source, file.size, head);
    setProblem(found === null ? null : fill(IMPORT_WORDS[found], { source: sourceName(source) }));
    if (found === null) onFile(file);
  };
  return (
    <View>
      <Button label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.choose"]} tone="secondary" icon="import" full={false} onPress={() => void choose()} />
      <ErrorText message={problem} />
    </View>
  );
}

/** Cancel import, asked once (10.3), stopping this tab's upload first. */
function CancelImport({ view, onView }: { view: ImportView; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  return (
    <AskedAction
      label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel"]}
      question={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel.ask"]}
      confirm={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel"]}
      keep={IMPORT_WORDS["import.cancel.keep"]}
      act={() => {
        stopUpload(view.id);
        return imports.cancel(view.id);
      }}
      onView={onView}
    />
  );
}

/** The upload's value text: "120 MB of 840 MB". */
const uploaded = (done: number, total: number): string => fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.uploaded"], { done: formatBytes(done), total: formatBytes(total) });

/**
 * Uploading (10.3). With the upload running in this tab: the bar, its value text, Keep this page open, and Cancel
 * import; a polite status says the value text at each tenth, not at every chunk. Its refusal is said with Try again,
 * which goes on with the same file from what the API holds. With no file in hand (a reload, another tab): where the upload
 * stopped and the file button, which takes only a file of the size it started with. The web is the only platform: on iOS
 * and Android the view says so.
 */
function Uploading({ view, run, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; run: UploadRunState | null; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const received = run?.receivedBytes ?? view.receivedBytes;
  const tenth = Math.floor((received / Math.max(1, view.declaredBytes)) * 10);
  const [said, setSaid] = useState("");
  const lastTenth = useRef(tenth);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tenth !== lastTenth.current) setSaid(uploaded(received, view.declaredBytes));
    lastTenth.current = tenth;
  }, [tenth, received, view.declaredBytes]);
  const again = async () => {
    const file = uploadFile(view.id);
    // The import as the API holds it now, so the upload goes on from its stored bytes.
    const fresh = await imports.get(view.id).catch(() => null);
    if (fresh === null) return;
    if (fresh.status !== "uploading" || file === null) {
      onView(fresh);
      return;
    }
    startUpload(fresh, file);
  };
  const inHand = run !== null && (run.running || run.error !== null);
  return (
    <View>
      <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.state.uploading"]}</StateHeading>
      {Platform.OS !== "web" ? (
        <Line>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.webOnly"]}</Line>
      ) : inHand ? (
        <>
          <View className="mt-4 gap-2">
            <Text variant="body-strong" aria-hidden>
              {uploaded(received, view.declaredBytes)}
            </Text>
            <ProgressBar label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.bar.upload"]} value={received} max={view.declaredBytes} valueText={uploaded(received, view.declaredBytes)} />
          </View>
          <VisuallyHidden role="status">{said}</VisuallyHidden>
          <Line>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.uploading"]}</Line>
          {run.error !== null ? (
            <>
              <ErrorText message={run.error.message} />
              <Button label={UI_WORDS["error.retry"]} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={() => void again()} />
            </>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Line>{fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.resume"], { done: formatBytes(view.receivedBytes), total: formatBytes(view.declaredBytes) })}</Line>
          <View className="mt-2">
            <ArchiveButton source={view.source} expectedBytes={view.declaredBytes} onFile={(file) => startUpload(view, file)} />
          </View>
        </>
      )}
      <View className="mt-2">
        <CancelImport view={view} onView={onView} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * Reading (10.3): an indeterminate spinner, named by the sentence it stands for, turning as the auth screens' does, and
 * under reduced motion the import icon standing still in its place; the sentence, and Cancel import.
 */
function Reading({ view, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  const motion = useMotion();
  const spin = useSpin();
  return (
    <View>
      <StateHeading headingRef={headingRef}>{IMPORT_WORDS["import.state.scanning"]}</StateHeading>
      <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-start gap-3">
        <View role="progressbar" aria-label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.reading"]} className="h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center">
          {motion.reduced ? (
            <View {...({ dataSet: { reading: "still" } } as object)}>
              <Icon name="import" size={24} tone="accent" />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <Animated.View style={spin} {...({ dataSet: { reading: "spin" } } as object)}>
              <View className="h-7 w-7 rounded-full border-[3px] border-x-accent border-b-accent border-t-accent/20" />
            </Animated.View>
          )}
        </View>
        <Text tone="medium" className="flex-1">
          {IMPORT_WORDS["import.reading"]}
        </Text>
      </View>
      <View className="mt-2">
        <CancelImport view={view} onView={onView} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/** An import that uploads or is being read. */
export function UploadProgress({ view, run, headingRef, onView }: { view: ImportView; run: UploadRunState | null; headingRef?: Ref<View>; onView: (next: ImportView) => void }) {
  return view.status === "scanning" ? <Reading view={view} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} /> : <Uploading view={view} run={run} headingRef={headingRef} onView={onView} />;
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/kit/Checkbox.tsx`

```tsx
import type { Ref } from "react";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { cn } from "@/theme/cn";
import { FOCUS_RING } from "./interaction";
import { Text } from "./Text";

/**
 * A statement or a choice the person ticks (3b design, section 10.1; the report form's good-faith statement moved onto
 * it): one control, role checkbox, which says in aria-checked whether it is ticked and is named by its label, its words
 * beside the box. The whole row is the target, 44 px tall at least, with the kit's 2 px focus ring; Space ticks it on the
 * web, as a button presses. The tick is drawn, two sides of a box turned 45 degrees in the colour that reads on the
 * accent, never written as a letter, and the box changes from line-high to the accent fill, so a ticked box differs by
 * shape as well as colour (UI design, section 4.8). `describedBy` ties a line under it to it (a reason, a hint).
 */
export function Checkbox({
  label,
  checked,
  onChange,
  describedBy,
  className,
  ref,
}: {
  label: string;
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
  describedBy?: string;
  className?: string;
  ref?: Ref<View>;
}) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      ref={ref}
      accessibilityRole="checkbox"
      aria-checked={checked}
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      onPress={() => onChange(!checked)}
      className={cn("min-h-[44px] flex-row items-start gap-3 rounded-control py-2.5", FOCUS_RING, className)}
    >
      <View className={cn("mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] border-2", checked ? "border-accent bg-accent" : "border-line-high bg-surface-1")}>
        {/* The tick: two sides of a box turned 45 degrees, in the colour that reads on the accent. */}
        {checked ? <View className="-mt-0.5 h-2.5 w-1.5 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-on-accent" style={{ transform: [{ rotate: "45deg" }] }} /> : null}
      </View>
      <Text className="flex-1">{label}</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/kit/MonthPicker.tsx`

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { buttonFace, Button, LABEL_TONE } from "@/components/ui";
import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "@/lib/import-words";
import { monthWords } from "@/lib/time";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { ListRow, RadioGroup } from "./ListRow";
import { Sheet } from "./Sheet";
import { Text } from "./Text";
import { VisuallyHidden } from "./VisuallyHidden";

/**
 * The months of a list as a radio group (3b design, section 10.1): one ListRow radio a month, written out ("March 2019"),
 * the chosen one the group's one tab stop, the arrows choosing at once (kit/ListRow.tsx's RadioGroup). Named by the
 * element whose id is `labelledBy`.
 */
export function MonthChoices({ labelledBy, months, value, onChange }: { labelledBy: string; months: readonly string[]; value: string; onChange: (month: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <RadioGroup labelledBy={labelledBy}>
      {months.map((month) => (
        <ListRow key={month} label={monthWords(month)} control={{ kind: "radio", checked: month === value, onSelect: () => onChange(month) }} />
      ))}
    </RadioGroup>
  );
}

/**
 * A month chosen from the scan's months (3b design, sections 10.1 and 10.4): a button that shows its label and the chosen
 * month ("From April 2019") and opens a Sheet holding MonthChoices and a Done button, since React Native has no native
 * select on its three platforms. A choice is taken at once, so the arrows can walk the months, and Done, Escape or the
 * scrim close the sheet; the focus then returns to the button. The sheet is mounted only while it is open or closing.
 */
export function MonthPicker({ label, months, value, onChange }: { label: string; months: readonly string[]; value: string; onChange: (month: string) => void }) {
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState({ mounted: false, open: false });
  const groupId = useId();
  const close = () => setSheet({ mounted: true, open: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Pressable accessibilityRole="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={sheet.open} onPress={() => setSheet({ mounted: true, open: true })} className={buttonFace({ face: "secondary", size: "md" })}>
        <Text variant="body-strong" tone={LABEL_TONE.secondary}>
          {label}
        </Text>
        <Text tone="medium" className="shrink">
          {monthWords(value)}
        </Text>
        <Icon name="next" size={16} tone="low" />
      </Pressable>
      {sheet.mounted ? (
        <Sheet open={sheet.open} onClose={close} onClosed={() => setSheet({ mounted: false, open: false })} title={label} size="tall" initialFocus="first">
          <VisuallyHidden nativeID={groupId}>{label}</VisuallyHidden>
          <MonthChoices labelledBy={groupId} months={months} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
          <View className="px-4 pb-4">
            <Button label={IMPORT_WORDS["import.month.done"]} tone="secondary" onPress={close} />
          </View>
        </Sheet>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/components/kit/ProgressBar.tsx`

```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import Animated, { useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue, withTiming } from "react-native-reanimated";
import { useMotion } from "@/lib/motion";

/**
 * A determinate progress bar (3b design, sections 10.1, 10.3 and 10.5): role progressbar with the four aria values
 * (aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100, aria-valuenow the percentage, and aria-valuetext the words a person reads, "120 MB
 * of 840 MB", "Publishing posts: 800 of 1,240"), named by `label`. The fill is the accent on a surface-2 track and grows by
 * a transform (scaleX from its start), 200 ms ease-out, since only transform and opacity move (UI design, section 5.1);
 * under reduced motion it is a static bar that takes each new value at once. `indeterminate` draws the track alone and
 * carries no value, for work whose length is not known.
 */
export function ProgressBar({ label, value = 0, max = 100, valueText, indeterminate = false }: { label: string; value?: number; max?: number; valueText?: string; indeterminate?: boolean }) {
  const motion = useMotion();
  const fraction = max > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value / max)) : 0;
  const shown = useSharedValue(fraction);
  useEffect(() => {
    shown.value = motion.reduced ? fraction : withTiming(fraction, motion.timing("easeOut", 200));
  }, [fraction, motion, shown]);
  const fill = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ transform: [{ scaleX: shown.value }] }));
  const values = indeterminate ? {} : { "aria-valuenow": Math.round(fraction * 100), "aria-valuetext": valueText };
  return (
    <View role="progressbar" aria-label={label} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} {...values} className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-2">
      {indeterminate ? null : <Animated.View className="h-full w-full rounded-full bg-accent" style={[{ transformOrigin: "left" } as object, fill]} />}
    </View>
  );
}
```
