```ts
export type ImportWord = keyof typeof IMPORT_WORDS;

/** The source's short name, as the label and the sentences print it: X, Mastodon, Bluesky. */
export const sourceName = (source: ImportSource): string => IMPORT_WORDS[`import.sourceName.${source}`];

/**
 * A rule as the import's sentences name it (import.stopped.by_staff, import.endedByStaff): its id and its title from the
 * rulebook, as the rules page words a rule (lib/public-pages.ts); an id the rulebook does not know stays as it is.
 */
export function ruleWords(id: string): string {
  const rule = RULES.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
  return rule === undefined ? id : `rule ${id} (${rule.title})`;
}

/**
 * The provenance label of an imported post (10.6, decision 6), made from the post's own label and nothing else (8.4): the
 * visible line "Imported from X, dated 3 Mar 2019" with ", shortened on import" for a shortened post, and the pressable
 * line's name, "Imported from X, dated 3 March 2019. About imported posts", the day written out. The day is the archive's,
 * in UTC: readers never see its second.
 */
export function importedLabel(label: ImportedLabel): { text: string; name: string } {
  const source = sourceName(label.source);
  const cut = label.shortened ? IMPORT_WORDS["import.label.shortened"] : "";
  return {
    text: fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.label"], { source, date: utcDay(label.at) }) + cut,
    name: fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.label.a11y"], { source, date: utcDay(label.at, "long") + cut }),
  };
}

/** QuoteEmbed's short form (10.6): "Imported from X". */
export const importedShort = (source: ImportSource): string => fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.label.short"], { source: sourceName(source) });

/**
 * Who sees this's provenance paragraph (10.6): its first sentence the fact of decision 28, then the source, the day the
 * post was published on korbat (the day it was imported, in the reader's zone) and the archive's day in UTC.
 */
export function provenanceWords(label: ImportedLabel, publishedAt: string): string {
  return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.provenance"], { source: sourceName(label.source), imported: localDay(publishedAt), date: utcDay(label.at, "long") });
}
```

### Create `apps/app/src/lib/imports.ts`

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS,
  IMPORT_MARKS,
  IMPORT_RULES,
  ImportLineView,
  ImportPickView,
  ImportSource,
  ImportView,
  type ImportChoice,
  type ImportImageSkip,
  type ImportPickRequest,
  type ImportStatus,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { API_BASE, api, ApiError, errorMessage, messageFor } from "./api";
import { IMPORT_WORDS, sourceName, type ImportWord } from "./import-words";
import { fill } from "./ui-words";

/**
 * The import's client in the app (3b design, sections 4.2, 7.3, 9.2 and 10; Task 7): the calls of 9.2, the chunked
 * uploader, the uploads running in this tab, and the pure functions the screens count and word with. The app imports no
 * other app, so chosenTotals mirrors the API's apps/api/src/imports/plan.ts over the view's month table and picks, and a
 * test holds both to the same table. Nothing here is kept on the device: an upload's file lives in this tab's memory
 * while it runs, and a reload asks the person to choose it again (10.3, resuming).
 */

/** GET /api/imports: the account's imports, newest first, and the sources a new one may name (9.2). */
export const ImportList = z.object({ imports: z.array(ImportView), sources: z.array(ImportSource) });
export type ImportList = z.infer<typeof ImportList>;

/** GET /api/imports/:id/lines?page=<n>: 50 lines of the preview and how many pages there are (9.2). */
export const ImportLinesPage = z.object({ lines: z.array(ImportLineView), pages: z.int().min(0) });
export type ImportLinesPage = z.infer<typeof ImportLinesPage>;

/** PUT /api/imports/:id/archive's answer: the bytes the API holds now. */
const ChunkAnswer = z.object({ receivedBytes: z.int().min(0) });

/** How often a screen reads an import that is moving while the page is visible (10.3). */
export const IMPORT_POLL_MS = 3_000;

/** Only a lowercase UUID names an import and becomes part of a path, as the API's own routes check (7.1). */
const IMPORT_ID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

export const isImportId = (id: string): boolean => IMPORT_ID.test(id);

function importPath(id: string): string {
  if (!isImportId(id)) throw new ApiError(404, "not_found", messageFor("not_found"));
  return `/api/imports/${id}`;
}

/**
 * The routes of 9.2, typed by the contracts. Cookies and CSRF are lib/api.ts's. Each call that names an import is async,
 * so an id that is no import's (a typed address) is a refused promise, never a throw while a screen renders.
 */
export const imports = {
  list: () => api("/api/imports", { schema: ImportList }),
  get: async (id: string) => api(importPath(id), { schema: ImportView }),
  create: (source: ImportSource, bytes: number) => api("/api/imports", { json: { source, bytes }, schema: ImportView }),
  /** One chunk, raw, at `offset`, with its SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex (7.3). */
  chunk: async (id: string, offset: number, chunk: Blob, sha256: string) =>
    api(`${importPath(id)}/archive`, {
      method: "PUT",
      raw: { type: "application/octet-stream", body: chunk },
      headers: { "import-offset": String(offset), "import-chunk-sha256": sha256 },
      schema: ChunkAnswer,
    }),
  lines: async (id: string, page: number) => api(`${importPath(id)}/lines?page=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(page))}`, { schema: ImportLinesPage }),
  pick: async (id: string, ref: number, pick: ImportPickRequest) => api(`${importPath(id)}/lines/${Math.floor(ref)}`, { method: "PUT", json: pick, schema: ImportPickView }),
  /** An image of the preview, the owner's only (9.2); the API sniffs it and never lets it be cached. */
  mediaUri: (id: string, file: string) => `${API_BASE}${importPath(id)}/media/${encodeURIComponent(file)}`,
  /** The choice with the statement (decision 14), which the request carries as `statement: true`. */
  confirm: async (id: string, choice: ImportChoice) => api(`${importPath(id)}/confirm`, { json: { choice, statement: true }, schema: ImportView }),
  cancel: async (id: string) => api(`${importPath(id)}/cancel`, { method: "POST", schema: ImportView }),
  stop: async (id: string) => api(`${importPath(id)}/stop`, { method: "POST", schema: ImportView }),
  undo: async (id: string) => api(`${importPath(id)}/undo`, { method: "POST", schema: ImportView }),
};

/** The browser's Web Crypto, typed locally so this file does not depend on the DOM type library. */
const web = globalThis as unknown as { crypto: { subtle: { digest(algorithm: string, data: ArrayBuffer): Promise<ArrayBuffer> } } };
const HEX = "0123456789abcdef";

/** A chunk's SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex, as Import-Chunk-Sha256 carries it (7.3). */
export async function chunkHash(bytes: ArrayBuffer): Promise<string> {
  const digest = new Uint8Array(await web.crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes));
  let out = "";
  for (const byte of digest) out += HEX[byte >> 4]! + HEX[byte & 15]!;
  return out;
}

/** The unsigned varint a CAR's header starts with, and its length; null when it does not end within 9 bytes. */
function varint(bytes: Uint8Array): [number, number] | null {
  let value = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length && i < 9; i++) {
    value += (bytes[i]! & 0x7f) * 2 ** (7 * i);
    if ((bytes[i]! & 0x80) === 0) return [value, i + 1];
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * What the app says of a chosen file before anything is sent (4.2 step 2): its size against 2 GiB, then its first bytes,
 * read as the API reads them (apps/api/src/imports/flows/chunk.ts's firstBytesVerdict): gzip's two bytes are the
 * .tar.gz of an old Mastodon server, X and Mastodon need a zip's local header, Bluesky a CAR's header (its length as a
 * varint within the block cap, then a CBOR map). Null for a file that may be sent; otherwise the words' key.
 */
export function archiveProblem(source: ImportSource, size: number, head: Uint8Array): "import.tooLarge" | "import.notArchive" | "import.tarGz" | null {
  if (size > IMPORT_RULES.maxBytes) return "import.tooLarge";
  if (size < 1 || head.length < 2) return "import.notArchive";
  if (head[0] === 0x1f && head[1] === 0x8b) return "import.tarGz";
  if (source === "bluesky") {
    const read = varint(head);
    if (read === null) return "import.notArchive";
    const [length, used] = read;
    return length > 0 && length <= IMPORT_RULES.carBlockMaxBytes && head.length > used && head[used]! >> 5 === 5 ? null : "import.notArchive";
  }
  return head.length >= 4 && head[0] === 0x50 && head[1] === 0x4b && head[2] === 0x03 && head[3] === 0x04 ? null : "import.notArchive";
}

/** How a run of the uploader ended. */
export type UploadOutcome =
  | { status: "done"; receivedBytes: number }
  | { status: "stopped"; receivedBytes: number }
  /** The import left uploading meanwhile (a cancel in another tab, its 24 hours): its view as the API answered it. */
  | { status: "moved"; view: ImportView }
  | { status: "failed"; receivedBytes: number; error: ApiError };

export interface UploadOptions {
  id: string;
  file: Blob;
  /** The bytes the API holds already: 0 for a new upload, the view's receivedBytes when it goes on. */
  from: number;
  /** The view's chunkBytes, IMPORT_RULES.chunkBytes. */
  chunkBytes: number;
  onProgress?: (receivedBytes: number) => void;
  /** Read before every chunk: true when the person cancelled. */
  stopped?: () => boolean;
  /** Waits before a chunk is tried again; tests pass one that does not. */
  wait?: (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
}

/** wrong_offset at the very place the uploader is, as for a chunk of this import still in flight: tried this often, a second apart. */
const IN_FLIGHT_TRIES = 10;
const IN_FLIGHT_WAIT_MS = 1_000;
/** Network errors in a row, each followed by a read of the import, before the upload gives up. */
const NETWORK_TRIES = 5;

/** The stored size wrong_offset's details carry. */
function storedOf(details: unknown): number | null {
  const stored = (details as { receivedBytes?: unknown } | null)?.receivedBytes;
  return typeof stored === "number" && Number.isInteger(stored) && stored >= 0 ? stored : null;
}

/**
 * The chunked uploader (7.3, 10.3): the file from `from`, one chunk of exactly chunkBytes at a time (the last one
 * shorter), each hashed with crypto.subtle.digest and sent with Import-Offset and Import-Chunk-Sha256. chunk_mismatch
 * sends the chunk again, at most IMPORT_RULES.chunkRetries times; wrong_offset goes on from the stored size its details
 * carry (waiting a second when another request of this import is still in flight); after a network error the import is
 * read (GET /api/imports/:id) before anything more is sent, and the upload goes on from its receivedBytes. Any other
 * refusal ends the run with its error: a refused first chunk (not_an_archive) has failed the import already.
 */
export async function uploadArchive(options: UploadOptions): Promise<UploadOutcome> {
  const { id, file, chunkBytes } = options;
  const wait = options.wait ?? ((ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)));
  let offset = options.from;
  let mismatches = 0;
  let stalled = 0;
  let lost = 0;
  while (offset < file.size) {
    if (options.stopped?.()) return { status: "stopped", receivedBytes: offset };
    const chunk = file.slice(offset, Math.min(offset + chunkBytes, file.size));
    try {
      const sha256 = await chunkHash(await chunk.arrayBuffer());
      const answer = await imports.chunk(id, offset, chunk, sha256);
      offset = answer.receivedBytes;
      mismatches = 0;
      stalled = 0;
      lost = 0;
      options.onProgress?.(offset);
    } catch (thrown) {
      const err = thrown instanceof ApiError ? thrown : new ApiError(500, "internal", errorMessage(thrown));
      if (err.code === "chunk_mismatch" && mismatches < IMPORT_RULES.chunkRetries) {
        mismatches += 1;
        continue;
      }
      if (err.code === "wrong_offset") {
        const stored = storedOf(err.details);
        if (stored === null || stored > file.size) return { status: "failed", receivedBytes: offset, error: err };
        if (stored === offset) {
          stalled += 1;
          if (stalled > IN_FLIGHT_TRIES) return { status: "failed", receivedBytes: offset, error: err };
          await wait(IN_FLIGHT_WAIT_MS);
        }
        offset = stored;
        mismatches = 0;
        continue;
      }
      if (err.status === 0 && lost < NETWORK_TRIES) {
        lost += 1;
        await wait(IN_FLIGHT_WAIT_MS * lost);
        // The chunk may have arrived and only its answer been lost: the import says what the API holds.
        let view: ImportView;
        try {
          view = await imports.get(id);
        } catch (again) {
          return { status: "failed", receivedBytes: offset, error: again instanceof ApiError ? again : err };
        }
        if (view.status !== "uploading") return { status: "moved", view };
        offset = view.receivedBytes;
        mismatches = 0;
        options.onProgress?.(offset);
        continue;
      }
      return { status: "failed", receivedBytes: offset, error: err };
    }
  }
  return { status: "done", receivedBytes: offset };
}

/** An upload running in this tab, as the import's screen draws it. */
export interface UploadRunState {
  receivedBytes: number;
  running: boolean;
  error: ApiError | null;
}

interface UploadRun {
  state: UploadRunState;
  /** The file, in this tab's memory only, while the run may go on or be tried again. */
  file: Blob | null;
  stop: boolean;
  /** How the last run ended, for the screen to read the import again. */
  outcome: UploadOutcome | null;
  listeners: Set<() => void>;
}

/** The uploads of this tab, by import: they go on while the person moves between screens, and end with the tab. */
const runs = new Map<string, UploadRun>();

const notify = (run: UploadRun) => {
  for (const listener of [...run.listeners]) listener();
};

/** Starts (or starts again) the upload of `file` for an import, from the bytes the view says the API holds. */
export function startUpload(view: Pick<ImportView, "id" | "receivedBytes" | "chunkBytes">, file: Blob): void {
  const run: UploadRun = runs.get(view.id) ?? { state: { receivedBytes: view.receivedBytes, running: false, error: null }, file: null, stop: false, outcome: null, listeners: new Set() };
  if (run.state.running) return;
  runs.set(view.id, run);
  run.file = file;
  run.stop = false;
  run.outcome = null;
  run.state = { receivedBytes: view.receivedBytes, running: true, error: null };
  notify(run);
  void uploadArchive({
    id: view.id,
    file,
    from: view.receivedBytes,
    chunkBytes: view.chunkBytes,
    stopped: () => run.stop,
    onProgress: (receivedBytes) => {
      run.state = { ...run.state, receivedBytes };
      notify(run);
    },
  }).then((outcome) => {
    run.outcome = outcome;
    const receivedBytes = outcome.status === "moved" ? outcome.view.receivedBytes : outcome.receivedBytes;
    run.state = { receivedBytes, running: false, error: outcome.status === "failed" ? outcome.error : null };
    // A finished or abandoned upload has no use for its file; a failed one keeps it, so Try again needs no new choice.
    if (outcome.status !== "failed") run.file = null;
    notify(run);
  });
}

/** Stops the upload before its next chunk (Cancel import). */
export function stopUpload(id: string): void {
  const run = runs.get(id);
  if (run) run.stop = true;
}

/** The file of a run that failed, to try it again from what the API holds; null when the tab holds none. */
export const uploadFile = (id: string): Blob | null => runs.get(id)?.file ?? null;

/** Forgets an import's run once its upload has nothing more to do (the import moved on). */
export function forgetUpload(id: string): void {
  const run = runs.get(id);
  if (run && !run.state.running) runs.delete(id);
}

/** The run of an import in this tab, followed as it goes; null when this tab is not uploading it. */
export function useUploadRun(id: string): UploadRunState | null {
  const [state, setState] = useState<UploadRunState | null>(() => runs.get(id)?.state ?? null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const follow = () => setState(runs.get(id)?.state ?? null);
    follow();
    let run = runs.get(id);
    const attach = () => {
      run?.listeners.delete(follow);
      run = runs.get(id);
      run?.listeners.add(follow);
    };
    attach();
    // A run started after the screen mounted (the start screen hands the file over just before it navigates) is found
    // by a short check while none is held.
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (runs.get(id) !== run) {
        attach();
        follow();
      }
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      run?.listeners.delete(follow);
    };
  }, [id]);
  return state;
}

const bit = (mark: (typeof IMPORT_MARKS)[number]): number => 1 << IMPORT_MARKS.indexOf(mark);

/** Whether a choice keeps a line of these marks, as plan.ts's marksPass: replies, long posts, warnings and protected posts each as chosen. */
export function marksPass(marks: number, choice: Pick<ImportChoice, "replies" | "long" | "warnings" | "protected">): boolean {
  if (marks & bit("reply") && !choice.replies) return false;
  if (marks & bit("long") && choice.long !== "shorten") return false;
  if (marks & bit("warning") && !choice.warnings) return false;
  if (marks & bit("protected") && !choice.protected) return false;
  return true;
}

/** Whether a month (YYYY-MM) is within the choice's range, either end open when null, as plan.ts's monthInChoice. */
export const monthInChoice = (month: string, choice: Pick<ImportChoice, "from" | "to">): boolean => (choice.from === null || month >= choice.from) && (choice.to === null || month <= choice.to);

type MonthTable = ImportView["picks"];

/** What the totals read of a view: the scan's month table and the picks' counts. */
export interface Tables {
  scan: { months: MonthTable } | null;
  picks: MonthTable;
}

/**
 * The posts and images a choice holds (4.4; the orchestrator's ruling for Task 5), counted exactly as the API's
 * chosenTotals counts them and stores them at the confirmation: the scan's groups [marks, posts, images, images without
 * a source's description] over the months and marks the choice keeps, less the picks' posts left out and their described
 * images, plus the descriptions the picks gave. Images count only while `images` (the site brings them and so does the
 * choice).
 */
export function chosenTotals(view: Tables, choice: ImportChoice, images: boolean): { posts: number; images: number } {
  let posts = 0;
  let kept = 0;
  for (const { month, groups } of view.scan?.months ?? []) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, count, withImages, undescribed] of groups) {
      if (!marksPass(marks, choice)) continue;
      posts += count;
      kept += withImages - undescribed;
    }
  }
  for (const { month, groups } of view.picks) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, out, described, given] of groups) {
      if (!marksPass(marks, choice)) continue;
      posts -= out;
      kept -= described - given;
    }
  }
  return { posts: Math.max(0, posts), images: images ? Math.max(0, kept) : 0 };
}

/** The reasons the app counts itself (9.3), in the order a line's first refused mark names it. */
const MARK_REASONS = [
  ["reply", "reply"],
  ["long", "too_long"],
  ["warning", "warning"],
  ["protected", "protected"],
] as const;

export type ChoiceSkip = "reply" | "too_long" | "warning" | "protected" | "left_out";

/**
 * The posts the choice leaves out by a reason of its own (9.3: reply, too_long, warning, protected and left_out), within
 * the months it keeps: each group the marks refuse counted once, by the first mark the choice refuses, and the picks that
 * leave a line out among the lines the marks keep. Zero counts are left out.
 */
export function leftOutCounts(view: Tables, choice: ImportChoice): Partial<Record<ChoiceSkip, number>> {
  const counts: Partial<Record<ChoiceSkip, number>> = {};
  const add = (reason: ChoiceSkip, n: number) => {
    if (n > 0) counts[reason] = (counts[reason] ?? 0) + n;
  };
  for (const { month, groups } of view.scan?.months ?? []) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, count] of groups) {
      const refused = MARK_REASONS.find(([mark]) => (marks & bit(mark)) !== 0 && !marksPass(marks & bit(mark), choice));
      if (refused) add(refused[1], count);
    }
  }
  for (const { month, groups } of view.picks) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, out] of groups) if (marksPass(marks, choice)) add("left_out", out);
  }
  return counts;
}

/** The images of the chosen posts that still have no description (import.choose.images.noAlt): the scan's, less those the picks gave one. */
export function undescribedCount(view: Tables, choice: ImportChoice): number {
  let missing = 0;
  for (const { month, groups } of view.scan?.months ?? []) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, , , undescribed] of groups) if (marksPass(marks, choice)) missing += undescribed;
  }
  for (const { month, groups } of view.picks) {
    if (!monthInChoice(month, choice)) continue;
    for (const [marks, , , given] of groups) if (marksPass(marks, choice)) missing -= given;
  }
  return Math.max(0, missing);
}

/**
 * Whether this import brings images at all: the importer counts every image images_off while the site's switch is off
 * (decision 15), and a Bluesky export holds none (decision 16).
 */
export const imagesOn = (view: Pick<ImportView, "source" | "scan">): boolean => view.source !== "bluesky" && !((view.scan?.imagesSkipped.images_off ?? 0) > 0);

/** The images the archive named, kept or not, and those the scan kept: import.found.images' two numbers. */
export function foundImages(scan: NonNullable<ImportView["scan"]>): { n: number; kept: number } {
  let skipped = 0;
  for (const reason of IMPORT_IMAGE_SKIPS) skipped += scan.imagesSkipped[reason as ImportImageSkip] ?? 0;
  return { n: scan.images + skipped, kept: scan.images };
}

/** The choice a preview starts from (4.4): everything, no replies, no warnings, no protected posts, no images, long posts left out. */
export function startingChoice(view: Pick<ImportView, "choice">): ImportChoice {
  return view.choice ?? { from: null, to: null, replies: false, warnings: false, protected: false, images: false, long: "leave" };
}

/**
 * The polite sentence of a change of state the screen saw while it was open (10.1): the news the import brought by itself.
 * A change the person's own press made (their confirm, cancel or remove) is answered where they pressed, so it says
 * nothing here; nor does an admin's end, which the view's own sentence says with its rule.
 */
export function announcement(from: ImportStatus, to: ImportStatus): string | null {
  if (from === to) return null;
  if (to === "cancelled" || to === "undoing" || (from === "ready" && (to === "preparing" || to === "publishing"))) return null;
  switch (to) {
    case "scanning":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.scanning"];
    case "ready":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.ready"];
    case "failed":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.failed"];
    case "publishing":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.publishing"];
    case "done":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.done"];
    case "stopped":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.stopped"];
    case "undone":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.now.undone"];
    case "expired":
      return IMPORT_WORDS["import.expired"];
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** The refusals of 9.4 in 10.9's words. rate_limited is the per-address limit only when an import is created. */
const REFUSALS: Partial<Record<string, ImportWord>> = {
  import_active: "import.active",
  imports_unavailable: "import.unavailable",
  import_weekly_limit: "import.limit",
  import_too_soon: "import.tooSoon",
  archive_too_large: "import.tooLarge",
  wrong_state: "import.wrongState",
  statement_required: "import.statementRequired",
  nothing_chosen: "import.publish.nothing",
};

/**
 * The sentence for a refusal of the import's routes: 10.9's for the codes of 9.4, the source's not_an_archive with its
 * name, and the shared sentence for the rest (account_suspended, not_found, a network error).
 */
export function importErrorMessage(err: unknown, options: { source?: ImportSource; during?: "create" | "act" } = {}): string {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) {
    if (err.code === "rate_limited" && options.during === "create") return IMPORT_WORDS["import.limit.network"];
    if (err.code === "not_an_archive") return fill(IMPORT_WORDS["import.notArchive"], { source: options.source === undefined ? "" : sourceName(options.source) });
    const key = REFUSALS[err.code];
    if (key !== undefined) return IMPORT_WORDS[key];
  }
  return errorMessage(err);
}

const COUNT = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB");

/** A count as the screens print one: "1,240". */
export const formatCount = (n: number): string => COUNT.format(n);

/** One decimal, without a trailing ".0". */
const oneDecimal = (n: number): string => String(Number(n.toFixed(1)));

/** A size in decimal units, as the value text prints it (10.3): "0 KB" before the first chunk, "4 KB", "2.5 MB", "120 MB", "1.5 GB". */
export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1_000_000) return `${bytes <= 0 ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1_000))} KB`;
  if (bytes < 1_000_000_000) {
    const mb = bytes / 1_000_000;
    return `${mb < 10 ? oneDecimal(mb) : Math.round(mb)} MB`;
  }
  return `${oneDecimal(bytes / 1_000_000_000)} GB`;
}

/**
 * Decision 13's cut as plan.ts makes it, for the preview's cards of a long post the choice shortens: at the last space
 * or line break within the first shortenTo - 1 code points (at shortenTo - 1 without one), and the ellipsis.
 */
export function shortened(text: string): { body: string; cut: boolean } {
  const points = Array.from(text);
  if (points.length <= IMPORT_RULES.shortenTo) return { body: text, cut: false };
  const head = points.slice(0, IMPORT_RULES.shortenTo - 1);
  const space = Math.max(head.lastIndexOf(" "), head.lastIndexOf(String.fromCharCode(10)));
  return { body: (space > 0 ? head.slice(0, space) : head).join("").trimEnd() + String.fromCharCode(0x2026), cut: true };
}
```

```ts
/**

 * origin, with the staff session's cookies. Each echoes the staff CSRF cookie in x-staff-csrf (the API requires it on

/** The staff CSRF cookie, which the page can read and the API compares with the header; never the app's. */

export const STAFF_CSRF_HEADER = "x-staff-csrf";
/** The mark of a request a person's action started: only such a request moves the session's idle end. */

/** A failed call: the API's code, or the console's own (network, invalid_answer), with the console's words for it. */
export class ApiError extends Error {

    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string = messageFor(code),

}

/** What the API client runs on: the page's fetch and cookies, or a test's. */
export interface StaffApiDeps {
  fetch(input: string, init: RequestInit): Promise<Response>;

}

/**
 * What the store listens for. Any staff_session_required answer means the API has already cleared both staff cookies,
 * so the store shows sign-in in place; a marked request that succeeded restarts the idle timer.

export interface ApiHooks {

   * for a session that has now ended, even when no page held that session (a reload or a new tab after an idle-out).

  onSessionRequired(carriedStaffCookie: boolean): void;
  onActivity(): void;
  /**

  onMe(me: StaffMe): void;

/** A call's options: `activity` is true only when a person's action (a click, a form, opening a screen) started it. */

/**

 * Task 6: or the rows a step-up of one key confirmed (`key`, a lower-case uuid), in a period (`from`, `to`, instants).

/** A cookie's value by its exact name, from a document.cookie string. */
export function readCookie(cookies: string, name: string): string | undefined {

/**

function sameCase(asked: string, view: CaseView): CaseView {

/** 3d Task 7: a held upload answered under another refusal's address is no answer, as for a case. */
function sameUpload(asked: string, view: HeldUpload): HeldUpload {

export type StaffApi = ReturnType<typeof createStaffApi>;

export function createStaffApi(deps: StaffApiDeps) {
  const hooks: ApiHooks = { onSessionRequired: () => undefined, onActivity: () => undefined, onMe: () => undefined };

  /**
   * One request. `schema` parses a 2xx answer; null means the route answers 204 with no body. A non-2xx answer becomes an
   * ApiError with the envelope's code (or not_found and internal when there is none), worded by the console.
   */
  async function request<T>(method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE", path: string, schema: z.ZodType<T> | null, call: Call, body?: unknown): Promise<T>;
  // 3f Task 6: the audit log's download answers JSON lines, which the screen reads as text and checks itself.
  async function request(method: "POST", path: string, schema: "text", call: Call, body?: unknown): Promise<string>;
  async function request<T>(method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE", path: string, schema: z.ZodType<T> | null | "text", call: Call, body?: unknown): Promise<T | string> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { accept: "application/json" };
    const csrf = readCookie(deps.cookie(), STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE);
    if (csrf) headers[STAFF_CSRF_HEADER] = csrf;
    if (call.activity === true) headers[STAFF_ACTIVITY_HEADER] = "1";
    if (body !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";

    let response: Response;
    try {
      // Same origin only, never cached, and never redirected: the staff API answers every request itself.
      response = await deps.fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        redirect: "error",
      });
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError(0, "network");
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const envelope = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => null));
      const code = envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.code : response.status === 404 ? "not_found" : "internal";
      // The API cleared both staff cookies with this answer; the store shows sign-in in place. The cookie is gone from
      // the page by now, so what the request carried, read before it was sent, is the only record that it was there.
      if (code === "staff_session_required") hooks.onSessionRequired(Boolean(csrf));
      throw new ApiError(response.status, code, undefined, envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.details : undefined);
    }

    let value: T | string;
    if (schema === null) {
      value = undefined as T;
    } else if (schema === "text") {
      // A body that breaks off on the way ends here as a shorter text, or as a network failure.
      try {
        value = await response.text();
      } catch {
        throw new ApiError(0, "network");
      }
    } else {
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => undefined));
      if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError(response.status, "invalid_answer");
      value = parsed.data;
    }
    // Only a marked success restarts the idle timer. A refused request moved nothing; one that did move the idle end but
    // failed later, or whose answer the schemas refused, only makes the timer read /me early, and it follows the answer.
    if (call.activity === true) hooks.onActivity();
    return value;
  }

  const query = (q: AuditQuery): string => {
    // Fixed order, numbers only: nothing a person typed reaches the address unchecked.
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (q.action !== undefined) params.set("action", q.action);
    if (q.cursor !== undefined) params.set("cursor", String(q.cursor));
    if (q.at !== undefined) params.set("at", String(q.at));
    // 3f Task 6: a key's id is a checked lower-case uuid and a time an instant the screen checked; both are encoded.
    if (q.key !== undefined) params.set("key", q.key);
    if (q.from !== undefined) params.set("from", q.from);
    if (q.to !== undefined) params.set("to", q.to);
    const text = params.toString();
    return text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`;
  };

  return {
    hooks,
    me: async (call: Call = {}) => {
      const me = await request("GET", "/api/staff/me", StaffMe, call);
      hooks.onMe(me);
      return me;
    },
    sessions: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/sessions", StaffSessionsResponse, call),
    keys: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/keys", StaffKeysResponse, call),
    audit: (q: AuditQuery, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/audit${query(q)}`, AuditPage, call),
    signOut: (call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/signout", null, call),
    signInOptions: (call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/options", StaffSignInOptionsResponse, call),
    signInVerify: (body: StaffSignInVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/verify", StaffSignInVerifyResponse, call, body),
    enrollOptions: (body: StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/options", StaffEnrollOptionsResponse, call, body),
    enrollVerify: (body: StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/verify", StaffEnrollVerifyResponse, call, body),
    stepUpOptions: (body: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/step-up/options", StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, call, body),
    /** The handle must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    revokeSession: (handle: string, body: StaffSessionRevokeRequest, call: Call = {}) =>
      request<void>("DELETE", `/api/staff/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}`, null, call, body),

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3). A case's address is built from a checked id; every other value goes in
    // a body or, for the queue's cursor, is one the API itself handed out, encoded.
    overview: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/overview", StaffOverview, call),
    /** A page of the queue. Its refreshes carry no mark: they are the page's own, never its person's. */
    queue: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/queue${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, QueuePage, call),
    caseView: async (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => sameCase(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}`, CaseView, call)),
    takeSnapshot: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/snapshots`, StaffSnapshotTaken, call, {}),
    saveText: (id: CaseId, body: StaffTextSaveRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextSaved, call, body),
    texts: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextsResponse, call),
    openFinding: (body: FindingRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/findings", FindingResponse, call, body),
    /**
     * A decision on a case, with the key's confirmation: the case must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up
     * confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the case as it now stands, and it is that case's.
     */
    decide: async (caseId: string, body: CaseDecisionRequest, call: Call = {}, gap: string | null = null) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || (gap !== null && !isLowerUuid(gap))) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      // 3f Task 6: a decision that takes a lost one again names the restore gap it closes, as the query member `gap`.
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions${gap === null ? "" : `?gap=${gap}`}`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3e: the Standing screen's four lists. */
    standing: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/standing", StandingLists, call),
    /** A page of the pending appeals, newest first. The cursor is one the API itself handed out, encoded. */
    appeals: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/appeals${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, AppealsPage, call),
    /**
     * The review of the appeal of a decision, with the key's confirmation: the decision must already be the lower-case
     * uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the decision's case as it now stands,
     * and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    review: async (caseId: string, decisionId: string, body: AppealReviewRequest, call: Call = {}, gap: string | null = null) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || !isLowerUuid(decisionId) || (gap !== null && !isLowerUuid(gap))) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/decisions/${decisionId}/review${gap === null ? "" : `?gap=${gap}`}`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3f: a page of the messages at the contact point, newest first, all or only those nobody has handled. The cursor is
     * one the API itself handed out, encoded.
     */
    contact: (cursor: string | null, open: boolean, call: Call = {}) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (cursor !== null) params.set("cursor", cursor);
      if (open) params.set("open", "1");
      const text = params.toString();
      return request("GET", `/api/staff/contact${text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`}`, ContactPage, call);
    },
    /** 3f: closes a message as what it was. Its id must be a lower-case uuid; the route answers 204. */
    closeContact: async (messageId: string, body: ContactCloseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(messageId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request<void>("POST", `/api/staff/contact/${messageId}/close`, null, call, body);
    },
    /** 3f: the orders not closed and those closed in the last 30 days. */
    orders: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/orders", OrdersPage, call),
    /** 3f: one order. An answer about another order than the one asked is no answer. */
    order: async (id: OrderId, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/orders/${id}`, OrderView, call)),
    /** 3f: opens an order, with or without a message, without a key. */
    openOrder: (body: OrderOpenRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/orders", OrderView, call, body),
    /** 3f: more links for an order, without a key. */
    addOrderItems: async (id: OrderId, body: OrderItemsRequest, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/items`, OrderView, call, body)),
    /** 3f: a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    recordOrderEvent: async (id: string, body: OrderEventRecordRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/events`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f Task 3: "Disable for an order"; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    effectOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderEffectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/effect`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f: a correction of what the order shows, with the step-up only under the rule admin. */
    correctOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderCorrectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/correct`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3f Task 6 (7.16): the audit log's tail after `after` up to `through`, confirmed with the key, as the text of its JSON
     * lines; the screen checks the lines before anything is saved or marked. A refusal is an ApiError as for any call.
     */
    exportAudit: async (body: AuditExportedParams & { stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON }, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/audit/export", "text", call, body),
    /** 3f Task 6: the keeper's confirmation that the whole file is held: its last line's place and hash; 204, or copy_mismatch. */
    markCopy: (body: AuditMarkRequest, call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/audit/export/mark", null, call, body),
    /** 3f Task 6: what an import after a restore found lost. */
    restore: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/restore", RestoreView, call),
    /** 3f Task 6: an admin's "Not needed" on a gap; its id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    closeGap: async (gapId: string, body: { disposition: "not_needed"; stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON }, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(gapId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/restore/gaps/${gapId}/close`, RestoreView, call, body);
    },
    /**
     * 3d Task 2: an admin's release of a seal for good, with the key's confirmation: the seal's ledger row must already be
     * the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the seal's case as it now
     * stands, and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    releaseSeal: async (caseId: string, actionId: string, body: SealReleaseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(actionId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/seals/${actionId}/release`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3b (design, sections 8.7 and 10.7): an admin's end of a whole import, with the key's confirmation: the import must
     * already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the case the end
     * was taken from as it now stands, and it must be the case the body names, the page that asked.
     */
    endImport: async (importId: string, body: ImportEndRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(importId) || !isLowerUuid(body.caseId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(body.caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/imports/${importId}/end`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3d Task 7 (8.6): a page of Held uploads. The cursor is one the API itself handed out, encoded. */
    uploads: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/uploads${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, UploadsPage, call),
    /**
     * 3d Task 7 (8.6): an admin's end of a held upload's hold, with the key's confirmation: the refusal must already be the
     * lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is that refusal as it now shows.
     */
    endHold: async (refusalId: string, body: UploadHoldEndRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(refusalId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameUpload(refusalId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/uploads/${refusalId}/end`, HeldUpload, call, body));
    },
    /** 3d Task 7 (8.6): the release of a held upload ended as report, built and checked as the end is. */
    releaseUpload: async (refusalId: string, body: UploadReleaseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(refusalId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameUpload(refusalId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/uploads/${refusalId}/release`, HeldUpload, call, body));
    },
    /** The item must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    reveal: async (itemId: string, body: IdentityRevealRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(itemId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/items/${itemId}/reveal`, RevealResponse, call, body);
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
    days: (max: number) => `Days (1 to ${max})`,
  },
  /** 8.7: [review.basis], when a suspension or termination taken at once rests on the reviewed decision. */
  reviewBasis: "A suspension (or termination) of this account rests on this decision. If you reverse it, or lift the seal, that measure ends when you confirm, and this decision's statement says so.",
  /** 8.7: [review.protective], beside the review or correction of a protective suspension. */
  reviewProtective: "A protective suspension is reviewed at once, on what korbat knows: the review does not wait for the authorities, and it may lift the suspension while the seal stays. Only the appeal of the seal's own decision waits.",
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 4 (design, sections 8.3 and 8.5 to 8.8)
  /** 8.3: an announced suspension. */
  suspend: {
    /** The control's name. */
    label: "Announce a suspension",

With no reply the suspension starts by itself, ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent the mail, on your signature: nobody acts at the start. korbat cannot see whether the mail reached the person; the app always shows the notice.`,

    /** [suspend.rule] */
    rule: (ladderRule: string) =>
      `The decision cites ${ladderRule}, the rule of the newest strike; the composer sets it. The statement names korbat's terms as its ground, that rule as the rule of the newest strike, and every strike it rests on.`,
    /** [suspend.short] */
    short: (activeStrikes: number) => `Not open: an announced suspension needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes. This account has ${activeStrikes}.`,
    /** [suspend.stale] */
    stale: "Not open: no strike is newer than the account's last suspension under the ladder. A next step needs at least one new strike.",
    /** How many days, at most the rung. */

  },
  /** 8.3: a termination, announced or at once. */
  terminate: {
    announceLabel: "Announce a termination",
    atOnceLabel: "Terminate at once",
    /** [terminate.what] */
    what: "A termination is a suspension without end. Until the decision is final for the account (six months unused, or its appeal answered and kept) the account is only suspended: it signs in, replies, appeals, exports and may delete itself, and its posts stay visible. Nothing is deleted while its appeal or its reply, on time or late, is unanswered. Then korbat deletes it, and keeps nothing to recognise a new account of the person by; images that korbat sealed stay for the authorities.",
    /** [terminate.notYet] */
    notYet: `Not open: an announced termination needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length} suspensions under the ladder decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days, whatever their length, and ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes of which one is newer than the last of them.`,
    /** [terminate.noRepeat] */
    noRepeat: `Not open: a termination at once needs a second direct threat after a suspension for the first. That is: a suspension at once for a direct threat, decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days, that still stands with the decision it rests on; and a final R5 decision at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days old about a post the account made after it was told of that suspension. A second post from before the suspension, or a first threat that was overruled, is no ground.`,

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 5 (design, sections 8.3, 8.4 and 8.7)
  /** 8.3: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it. Both cite R6; the composer sets it. */

    restrictLabel: "Restrict reporting",
    /** Beside both controls. */

    /** [warn.what], with the account's counts as this page read them. */

It tells the account that ${unfounded} of the ${reports} reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded, lists them, and says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction. A report counts once, however many of its items were marked, and by the day it was sent. A notice of illegal content is never counted.`,
    /** [warn.short] */
    warnShort: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `Not open: a warning needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks} marked reports among those the account sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days, and they must be at least half of its rule reports sent in that time. This account has ${unfounded} of ${reports}. One report never reaches the number alone.`,

      `This stops the account's reports under korbat's rules for ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination stay open to it.`,
    /** [restrict.noWarning] */
    restrictNoWarning: "Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.",

    restrictShort: (marksSince: number, warnedOn: string) => `Not open: ${marksSince} of the reports the account sent since the warning of ${warnedOn} were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`,

    restrictRunning: (restrictedUntil: string) => `Not open: a restriction runs until ${restrictedUntil}.`,

    liftWarning: "Lift the warning about reporting",
    liftRestriction: "Lift the restriction of reporting",

    /** [mark.label] */

    rule: `Tick only a report that anyone could see was unfounded without weighing it: it names nothing the rule could cover. The person who sent it sees the mark on their own list of reports once this answer is released to them, and can ask for a re-examination.`,
    /** [mark.never], once, when an item the decision answers cannot be marked. */
    never: "Only a signed-in person's report under a rule can be marked: never a notice of illegal content, a report on the path for child sexual abuse material, or a report sent without an account.",
    /** [mark.undone] */

    /** On the case page, beside an item whose mark stands and one whose mark was withdrawn (CaseItem.markWithdrawn). */

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile; and the refusals of
  // Task 2's order routes.
  "message_handled",
  "order_needs_message",
  "order_exists",
  "order_closed",
  "order_event_refused",
  "already_released",
  // 3f Task 3 (design, sections 8.5 and 8.9): the refusals of giving effect to an order.
  "order_changed",
  "order_not_verified",
  "order_cap",
  // 3f Task 6 (design, sections 8.7 to 8.9): a gap that is closed or that a decision does not fit, and a copy mark the
  // database did not take.
  "gap_mismatch",
  "copy_mismatch",
  // 3d Task 2 (design, section 8.8): the release's refusals and its check at commit.
  "release_not_open",
  "release_not_reported",
  "release_not_quarantined",
  "release_preserved",
  "release_no_leave",
  "release_period_unset",
  "release_period_running",
  "release_mismatch",
  // 3d Task 7 (design, section 8.8): an end of a hold its state does not allow or without its reason, and an image that a
  // match names, which staff are never served.
  "hold_not_open",
  "invalid_hold_end",
  "image_matched",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** 3f Task 6 [copy.broken] (8.7): a download that broke off, whose mark the database refused or the console never sent. */
const COPY_BROKEN = "The download broke off, or its lines do not continue each other. Nothing was recorded as copied: press again.";

/** 3f [open.duplicate]: an order of this state, authority and reference is recorded already (order_exists). */
const OPEN_DUPLICATE =
  "An order of this authority with this reference is already recorded. If that record is wrong, correct it on its screen; if it is closed, an admin reopens it there. Do not open the order a second time under a changed reference.";

/** 3d Task 7 [case.image.matched] (8.4): in the place of an image that an unerased match record names, with no reveal control. */
const IMAGE_MATCHED = "Not opened: this image matched a list of known material. Nobody at korbat opens it, also after an answer without a seal.";

  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",

  reply_not_open: "This measure takes no reply: it has ended or was lifted.",

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 8.2, 8.3 and 18): the console's sentences of authorities' orders, each under the design's key
 * (`home.contact` is [home.contact]). Every number in one is printed from the answer or from ORDER_RULES, never typed, and
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.
 */
export const ORDER_WORDS = {
  home: {
    title: "Authorities",
    /** [home.contact], in three parts: the words before the link to Contact point, the link's own words, and the rest. */
    contact: (oldestAt: string, open: number) => ({
      before: `Mail at the authorities' contact point since ${oldestAt}: ${open} ${open === 1 ? "message" : "messages"} nobody has handled. Read it in the mail host's app, then open `,
      link: "Contact point",
      after: `. A removal order is due ${HOUR_WORDS} after it arrived.`,
    }),
    channel: (since: string) =>
      `Phone alerts are down since ${since}. Alerts arrive by mail only: keep the mail host's app open on the contact-point mailbox until this line is gone. An order you find there that Contact point does not list is opened under Orders, with ${NOT_LISTED}.`,
```
