/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8.1, 8.2 and 8.4): the words of sealed files and their custody, the quarantine, the release and
 * held uploads, each under its key. Every number is printed from the answer or from a constant (QUARANTINE_RULES), never
 * typed; every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. Task 1 has the quarantine's.
 */
export const CUSTODY_WORDS = {
  /** The home screen's block below "Authorities", each line only while it applies. */
  homeTitle: "Sealed files and programs",
  /** [home.quarantine], while a move into the quarantine or back is due. */
  homeQuarantine: (dueIn: number, dueOut: number, oldest: string) =>
    `Files to move or return: ${dueIn} images to move into the quarantine, ${dueOut} to return to the image store, the oldest due since ${oldest}. Whoever has the server runs the README's steps under Quarantine (staff.js quarantine-list). Until then a sealed image's files are still in the image store, and an image whose seal was lifted is not shown.`,
  /** Its addition once the oldest due move is older than the alert's threshold. */
  homeQuarantineLate: `More than ${QUARANTINE_RULES.dueHours} hours: every staff account is alerted daily until the move is recorded.`,
  /** [case.custody.in], on a seal for good in force. */
  custodyIn: (moved: number, files: number, movedAt: string | null) => (moved > 0 && movedAt !== null ? `Files: ${moved} of ${files} are in the quarantine, since ${movedAt}.` : "Files: not moved to the quarantine yet."),
  custodyInRest: "The others are still in the image store until whoever has the server moves them (the README, Quarantine).",
  /**
   * [case.custody.return], while files of a lifted seal are still in the quarantine. 3d review M12: beside a lost file, only
   * the images whose files are all kept are shown again.
   */
  custodyReturn: (toReturn: number, lost = 0) =>
    lost > 0
      ? `Files to return: the seal was lifted and ${toReturn} files of its images are still in the quarantine. The images whose files are all kept are shown again once whoever has the server has returned them (the README, Quarantine); an image with a lost file is not.`
      : `Files to return: the seal was lifted and ${toReturn} files of its images are still in the quarantine. The images are shown again once whoever has the server has returned them (the README, Quarantine).`,
  /**
   * [case.custody.lost], under a seal for good in force, and after a lifted seal. 3d review M12: after the lift korbat's
   * daily round mails the author (image_lost), unless the post was deleted or erased; the console says no more than that.
   */
  custodyLost: (lost: number, inForce: boolean) =>
    inForce
      ? `Files lost: ${lost}. They were found in neither the image store nor the quarantine and are recorded as lost; there is nothing to move, hand over or destroy for them.`
      : `Files lost: ${lost}. Their images cannot be shown again. korbat tells their author so by mail, unless the post was deleted or erased.`,
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 8.2 and 8.6): Held uploads. No sentence names a handle, an image, a hash or a file's name;
   * the two ends are worded as what each does, neither is preselected and no sentence says which to take (rule 4 of
   * section 8). Every number is printed from the answer or from AUTOMATION_RULES and ORDER_RULES.
   */
  uploads: {
    title: "Held uploads",
    /** [uploads.what]. */
    what: "An upload was not accepted because its source reports its fingerprint as an exact match with an entry that the source classifies as child sexual abuse material. It is on no post, nothing serves it, no data export holds it, and nobody at korbat opens it: this screen shows no image. It is held, with no end by a timer, until an admin ends the hold one of the two ways below.",
    empty: "No upload is held, and none was released or ended in the last 30 days.",
    more: "Show more",
    refusedAt: (at: string) => `Refused at ${at}`,
    /** [uploads.others]: counted over the refusals whose hold has not ended or ended as "Report". */
    others: (n: number) => `Other held uploads of the same uploader: ${n}.`,
    /** [uploads.gone], while the uploader's account no longer exists. */
    gone: `The uploader's account no longer exists. A report can carry the file's facts and times, and the account's address only while korbat still holds it for a report: up to ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days from the refusal, as after a seal. After that a report can carry the file's facts and times alone.`,
    objection: { lead: (at: string) => `The uploader objected on ${at}:`, by: "Written by the uploader" },
    /** [uploads.unseen], above the two controls, which stand side by side with the same weight. */
    unseen:
      "You decide without seeing the image, and this screen does not tell you which way. What you have is the record above: the source, the kind of match, the time, what the uploader wrote, and how many other uploads of the same uploader are held. Whether a match obliges korbat to report is a question of law that this screen does not answer: read the README's section A held upload, which holds what counsel has advised korbat, decide with whoever has the server, and write your ground into the operator's notes.",
    /** The two ends, each its label and [uploads.report] or [uploads.noReport]. */
    report: {
      label: "Report",
      what: 'The upload stays held and its files move to the quarantine, kept for the authority alone. Whoever has the server opens the record of the report (staff.js upload-report) and reports. The uploader reads on the notice that korbat reports the file. The hold then ends by a release on a recorded leave to destroy, or by "No report" later, with a reason.',
    },
    noReport: {
      label: "No report",
      what: `The hold ends. korbat deletes the upload ${AUTOMATION_RULES.noReportHours} hours from now; until then an admin can still end it as "Report" instead. Every staff account is mailed now that a hold ended without a report; the uploader is told that the hold was lifted only once the upload is deleted.`,
      reason: "The reason",
    },
    /** The choice before the key: which end, and for "No report" which reason. Nothing is chosen when the page loads. */
    choose: "Choose one of the two ends.",
    chooseReason: 'Choose the reason of "No report".',
    sign: 'You confirm with your staff key: this upload, the end you chose and, for "No report", its reason.',
    confirm: "Confirm with your staff key",
    adminOnly: "Only an admin can end a hold or release a held upload.",
    /** The state lines. */
    state: {
      open: "Held, waiting for an admin.",
      report: (endedAt: string, reported: boolean, quarantined: boolean) =>
        `Held for a report since ${endedAt}. Report recorded: ${reported ? "yes" : "no"}. Files in the quarantine: ${quarantined ? "yes" : "no"}.`,
      noReport: (endedAt: string, reason: string, deletesAt: string) => `Hold ended at ${endedAt}: ${reason}. The upload is deleted after ${deletesAt}; until then it can still be ended as "Report".`,
      released: (releasedAt: string) => `Released at ${releasedAt}. Home counts the released files that are left to destroy.`,
    },
    /** The release block of a held upload: 8.5's, with "this upload" in place of "this seal, its posts". */
    releaseSign: "You confirm with your staff key: this upload, the ground, and the leave with its reference as shown above.",
    releaseDone: (releasedAt: string, held: boolean, backupsClearAt: string) =>
      `Released at ${releasedAt}. Its files are in the quarantine until whoever has the server destroys them (the README, Quarantine), and every staff account is alerted daily while one is still recorded there. The uploader's notice: ${held ? "held until the person may be told" : "sent at once"}. No backup that is deleted on time holds these files after ${backupsClearAt}; a backup kept for an authority is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups).`,
  },
  /** [home.uploads] (8.2): a link to Held uploads; `oldest` printed by the screen. */
  homeUploads: (open: number, oldest: string | null, objected: number) =>
    `Held uploads: ${open} matched uploads wait for an admin${oldest === null ? "" : `, the oldest since ${oldest}`}; ${objected} uploaders objected and have no answer.`,
  homeUploadsCapped: (capped: number) =>
    `${capped} uploads matched over the limit of refusals an hour and are neither refused nor accepted: the operator looks at the comparison first (the alert says so).`,
  homeUploadsLink: "Open Held uploads",
  /** [home.released] (8.2) for a held upload: one line a release, newest first. */
  homeReleasedUpload: (at: string) => `Released in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}, a held upload.`,
  /** [home.unreported] (8.2): one line an end, newest first. */
  homeUnreported: (at: string) => `Holds ended without a report in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}.`,
} as const;

/**
 * 3d (design, sections 8 and 8.4): the console's words of what a program does and of the edge's purge, each under the
 * design's key. Task 3 brings the four lines of the edge's purge; every number is EDGE_WORDS', never typed, and the time
 * is the answer's, printed by the screen with bothTimes.
 */
export const AUTOMATION_WORDS = {
  /**
   * [case.purge.accepted], [case.purge.failed], [case.purge.off] and [case.purge.pending]: beside each image of a case
   * that stopped being public, and for each image of an order's disabled item, from the newest outbox row's outcome.
   */
  purge: (outcome: EdgePurgeView["outcome"], at: string): string => {
    switch (outcome) {
      case "accepted":
        return `Edge copy: purge accepted at ${at}.`;
      case "failed":
        return `Edge copy: purge failed. A copy may have been served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes after the measure; the operator is alerted.`;
      case "off":
        return `Edge copy: no purge (off): a copy may be served for up to ${EDGE_WORDS.edgeMinutes} minutes.`;
      case "pending":
        return "Edge copy: purge not sent yet.";
    }
  },
  /**
   * Task 6 (8.3): the queue's three chips, [queue.found], [queue.taken] and [queue.objected]. Only the last moves a case:
   * the API sorts it first inside its lane.
   */
  queue: { found: "Found by a program", taken: "Taken by a program", objected: "The author asked for a person" },
  /** Task 6 (8.4): the chip in the place of a staff handle, on a decision without a decider and on Home's lists. */
  byProgram: "Taken by a program",
  /** Task 6: a program's finding as the case's history names its item. */
  historyItem: "a program's finding",
  /** [home.automated] (8.2): the measures of a program in force, which wait for a person; `oldestAt` printed by the screen. */
  homeAutomated: (waiting: number, oldestAt: string) =>
    `Measures a program took, waiting for a person: ${waiting}, the oldest since ${oldestAt}. A moderator decides a hidden image; an admin answers sealed images.`,
  /** [home.objected] (8.2): the cases whose author asked for a person; the target is the contracts' constant. */
  homeObjected: (objected: number, oldestObjectionAt: string) =>
    `The author asked for a person: ${objected} ${objected === 1 ? "case" : "cases"}, the oldest request of ${oldestObjectionAt}. korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours.`,
  /** [case.r1] (8.4), on an item a score opened: the threshold's version and never the score, which would read as a verdict. */
  caseR1: (thresholdVersion: number) =>
    `A program rated this image as likely within rule R1: over the threshold (version ${thresholdVersion}). That is a reason to look, not a finding. Look at the image and decide as for any report. The statement will say that a moderator looked at the image only if you opened it on this case before you decided; otherwise it says that you decided without opening it.`,
  /** [case.auto] (8.4), on a decision without a decider, before the statement's preview its author was sent. */
  caseAuto: (decidedAt: string, measure: string) =>
    `A program took this measure at ${decidedAt}, with no person involved: ${measure}. It lasts until a person decides this case. Its author was told at once, with these words:`,
  /** [case.autoR1] (8.4), for a program's withhold of an image. */
  caseAutoR1: 'Any moderator may lift it now ("Lift what was done while deciding", with your reason), or decide the case. A final decision ends it either way.',
  /** [case.autoRecord] (8.4), beside "Decide the case" while an unanswered item of the case is a program's finding. */
  caseAutoRecord: "Your decision is recorded as found by automated means.",
  /** [case.objection] (8.4), at the top of the case while its measure is in force: the lead, the frame's label, the end. */
  objection: {
    lead: (createdAt: string) => `The author asked for a person on ${createdAt}:`,
    by: "Written by the author",
    tail: `korbat's published target is an answer within ${AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours} hours. Lift the measure or decide the case; either way the author gets that decision's statement, and nothing else answers this.`,
  },
  /** 3d Task 7 [queue.matchFlag] (8.3): a match that only flags; it moves nothing. */
  queueMatchFlag: "A match that only flags",
  /**
   * 3d Task 8 [queue.flag] (8.3), and the chip beside [case.flag]: the flag "possible coordinated reporting". It moves
   * nothing: the case stands where its lane and age put it.
   */
  queueFlag: "Possible coordinated reporting",
  /**
   * [case.flag] (8.4), under the case's header with the chip: the two counts from the answer, the window's minutes and the
   * linked share from SIGNAL_RULES (the share as a word while it is one half). It names no reporter.
   */
  caseFlag: (items: number, reporters: number) =>
    `Many reports in a short time from accounts that are linked: ${items} unanswered reports from ${reporters} accounts within ${SIGNAL_RULES.windowMinutes} minutes, and at least ${SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare === 0.5 ? "half" : `${SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare * 100} percent`} of those accounts follow one another. This is not a finding: decide the content as always.`,
  /** [case.sameSource] (8.4), on an item whose signed-in reporter has other unanswered items on other open cases: a count, never a case. */
  sameSource: (n: number) => `${n} other open ${n === 1 ? "item" : "items"} from this source.`,
  /** [home.flags] (8.2). */
  homeFlags: (flags: number) =>
    `Matches that only flag: ${flags} open cases hold one, a match with an entry that its source does not class as child sexual abuse material. Each stands in the queue where its lane and age put it.`,
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 [case.match] (8.4): a match's record as a list of label and value. The source, the list version and the
   * classification are a source's strings, drawn framed under `frame`, never in a label's place (rule 3 of section 8).
   */
  match: {
    title: "The match's record",
    frame: "As the source returned it",
    source: "Source",
    listVersion: "List version",
    hashType: "Hash type",
    matchKind: "Kind of match, as the source reported it",
    classification: "Classification, as the source returned it",
    queriedAt: "Compared at",
    none: "not returned",
    /** [case.matchWeak]: under the record for a hash that can be made to collide on purpose, or a perceptual one. */
    weak: (hashType: "sha256" | "sha1" | "md5" | "pdq"): string | null =>
      hashType === "md5"
        ? "A file with the same MD5 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
        : hashType === "sha1"
          ? "A file with the same SHA-1 as another can be made on purpose by whoever made both files."
          : hashType === "pdq"
            ? "A perceptual hash describes how a picture looks. Two different pictures can have the same one, by accident or on purpose."
            : null,
    /** [case.matchActing]. */
    acting:
      "The source reports this as an exact match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material. That is the one kind of match on which korbat's program refuses an upload or, where the owner has switched that on, seals a post's images. It is the source's word about a fingerprint: nobody at korbat has checked it, and nobody can.",
    /** [case.matchNear]. */
    near: "The source reports this as a match with an entry that it classifies as child sexual abuse material, but it is not a match on which korbat's program acts: the source does not report it as exact (the kind of match is shown above), or the entry is outside the part of its list that korbat acts on. The program refused and sealed nothing on it, and the author was told nothing. It opened this finding under rule R2, so the post is frozen as after any such finding: korbat keeps its images, also against the author's deletion, until an admin has answered, and the urgent alert went out. A similar fingerprint can be made on purpose for a harmless image. Only an admin answers: seal for good, or answer without a seal, without seeing the images.",
    /** [case.matchFlag]. */
    flag: "This match is a flag and nothing more: the source does not class the entry as child sexual abuse material. The program refused, sealed and froze nothing and cited no rule, nobody was alerted, and the author was told nothing. Decide the case on what you can read: this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. If they give you a ground of your own, decide on that rule or the law; if they do not, decide that nothing breaks a rule, which answers the flag.",
    /** [case.matchWhat], under either. */
    what: "What a match shows: a file has the same, or a similar, fingerprint as one that the source classified. It does not show what the image is. Nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, before an answer or after it. Decide as for a report: on this record, the post's text and alt texts, and the account's conduct. Never write that the image is child sexual abuse material or that korbat confirmed it.",
  },
  /** [case.image.matched] (8.4). */
  imageMatched: IMAGE_MATCHED,
  /** [case.autoR2] (8.4), for a program's seal of a post's images. */
  caseAutoR2:
    "Only an admin answers a seal: seal for good, or answer without a seal. You answer without seeing the images, and nobody at korbat opens them afterwards either. An answer without a seal puts them before everyone again: it needs one of the reasons below.",
  /** [case.liftedMatch] (8.4), in the place of 3c's sentence after an answer without a seal, on a case that holds a match. */
  liftedMatch: "After an answer without a seal the images are served again as before. They stay closed to staff: nobody at korbat opens an image that a match names, on this case or on any other. No person will have looked at them.",
  /** [case.autoRecord]'s second sentence, for an admin who restricts on a match's finding citing R2. */
  caseAutoRecordPartly: "It is recorded as taken partly by automated means: you cannot view the images, so the comparison is a fact your decision rests on.",
  /** The reason an answer without a seal on an acting match asks for, before the key (8.4). */
  answerReason: { legend: "The reason of this answer without a seal", choose: "Choose the reason of this answer without a seal: it is part of what your key signs." },
  /** [restore.program] (8.7), beside a gap whose lost row is a program's decision. */
  restoreProgram: "A program took this measure, not a person. Take it again as your own decision while you decide; the author is sent your decision's statement.",
} as const;

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 8.2, 8.5 and 8.7): the console's words of the release, each under the design's key
 * (`what` is [release.what]). Every number is printed from the answer or from the contracts' constants, never typed;
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes. An authority's reference and a leave's are
 * an outsider's text, drawn framed, never in a label's place.
 */
export const RELEASE_WORDS = {
  title: "Release",
  /** The block's labels and values (8.5's table). */
  facts: {
    reported: { label: "Reported to an authority", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
    theirReference: { label: "The authority's reference", frame: "As recorded from the authority", none: "not recorded" },
    answer: {
      label: "The authority's assessment",
      values: { illegal: "illegal", not_illegal: "not illegal", no_assessment: "no assessment", other: "another answer" } as Record<string, string>,
      none: "none recorded",
    },
    answeredAt: { label: "Assessed on", none: "no answer" },
    handedOverAt: { label: "Files handed over on", none: "nothing was handed over" },
    leave: { label: "Leave or instruction to destroy", none: "none recorded", from: { authority: "from the authority", court: "from a court" } as Record<string, string> },
    leaveReference: { label: "Its reference", none: "none recorded" },
    leaveDay: { label: "Its day", none: "none recorded" },
    tell: {
      label: "The author may be told",
      atOnce: "at once",
      untold: (until: string | null) => `not yet: the leave is recorded as not to be told to the person, ${until === null ? "with no end recorded" : `until ${until}`}`,
      record: "not yet: the record of the report, or an authority's order about one of these posts, says that the person is not to be told",
    },
    quarantined: { label: "Files in the quarantine", yes: "all of them, by the record", no: "not all: the move is not recorded" },
    preserved: { label: "Preserved for an order", yes: "yes", no: "no" },
  },
  what: "A release ends korbat's keeping of these sealed images for good. It marks the posts as released and erases their image rows now. Whoever has the server then destroys the files in the quarantine, and the digest of each destroyed file is recorded as the proof. It cannot be undone: nothing brings a destroyed file back. The seal stays in the record as a measure, and the post's text is not touched.",
  tells:
    `The author is told what korbat did: that it released the images, and that an authority's or a court's leave or instruction is its ground. The notice names no authority and no reference and says nothing of what any authority found. It is sent at once, or, while the leave, the record of the report or an authority's order says that the person is not to be told, when the last of these has ended and never before. If an authority has asked korbat not to tell the person and the line above still reads "at once", do not release: whoever has the server records the authority's request first (with the leave when the leave is recorded, staff.js release-leave --untold; for a leave that is recorded already, notification-event on the record of the report).`,
  backups: (backupDays: number) =>
    `A backup of the image store taken before the files moved may still hold them: korbat's backups are deleted ${backupDays} days after they were taken, except a backup kept for an authority, which is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups). The release's record prints the day after which no backup that is deleted on time holds these files.`,
  leave: (from: string) => `Ground: leave to destroy. The record holds a leave or an instruction to destroy these images, ${from}, of the day and with the reference shown above.`,
  assessed:
    "The authority assessed these images as illegal. An assessment is not leave to destroy: it is a reason an authority may want them kept. The images stay sealed and kept until the authority or a court gives korbat leave or an instruction to destroy them and whoever has the server has recorded it (staff.js release-leave).",
  notIllegal:
    "The authority answered that the images are not illegal. That is no ground for a release. Lift the seal instead (Correct this decision, Lift the seal): the images are shown again once their files are returned.",
  conflict:
    'The record holds an assessment "not illegal" and a leave to destroy. The two do not fit. Ask whoever has the server which is wrong before you do either: lifting the seal returns the images, a release destroys them.',
  nothing: "This ends nothing by itself. The images stay sealed and kept.",
  periodUnset: "korbat has set no period after which sealed images are released when an authority stays silent. Until counsel has set one and the terms publish it, nothing is released by time.",
  more: (max: number, remaining: number) =>
    `This seal lists more posts than one confirmation can release. This one releases the first ${max} of them, in the order of their ids; ${remaining} more remain. Read the case again and confirm again for the rest.`,
  sign: (posts: number) => `You confirm with your staff key: this seal, its ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, the ground, and the leave with its reference as shown above.`,
  done: (releasedAt: string, posts: number, images: number, filesLeft: number, held: boolean, backupsClearAt: string) =>
    `Released at ${releasedAt}: ${posts} ${posts === 1 ? "post" : "posts"}, ${images} ${images === 1 ? "image row" : "image rows"} erased. Files left to destroy: ${filesLeft}. They are in the quarantine until whoever has the server destroys them (the README, Quarantine), and every staff account is alerted daily while one is still recorded there. The author's notice: ${held ? "held until the person may be told" : "sent at once"}. No backup that is deleted on time holds these files after ${backupsClearAt}; a backup kept for an authority is destroyed by hand (the README, Backups).`,
  button: "Release and destroy",
  /** The block greyed for a moderator: admin_required's words. */
  adminOnly: "Only an admin can release sealed images.",
  /** [appeals.released] (8.7). */
  appealReleased: (releasedAt: string, basis: "leave" | "period") =>
    `The images this appeal is about were released on ${releasedAt}, on the ground: ${basis === "leave" ? "a recorded leave to destroy" : "the period's end"}. korbat has released them: it will not show them again or give them back. The appeal is still open: an admin reviews it, and the release closed nothing.`,
  /** [home.undestroyed] (8.2). */
  homeUndestroyed: (undestroyed: number) =>
    `Released files to destroy: ${undestroyed}. Their release is recorded and the files are still in the quarantine. Whoever has the server runs the same steps; the list's destroy lines name them.`,
  /** [home.released] (8.2): one line a release, newest first. */
  homeReleased: (at: string) => `Released in the last 30 days, each by an admin's key: ${at}, sealed images of a case.`,
} as const;

/**
 * 3f Task 6 (design, sections 8.2, 8.5, 8.7 and 8.8): the console's sentences of recovery, each under the design's key
 * (`restore.what` is [restore.what]). Every number is printed from the answer or from the contracts, never typed, and
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by the screen with bothTimes.
 */
export const RECOVERY_WORDS = {
  // The audit log's download (8.7).
  downloadTitle: "Download since my last copy",
  download: (lastPlace: number, max: number) =>
    `Downloads the rows after place ${lastPlace}, the newest you downloaded, as one file of JSON lines, at most ${max} rows at a time. Keep the file off the server with the head you note. After a restore it is what names the lost orders and decisions.`,
  downloadFirst: (max: number) => `You have downloaded nothing yet: this downloads the first ${max} rows. Press again until nothing is newer.`,
  key: "The file holds more than this page: confirm with your staff key.",
  downloadButton: "Download since my last copy",
  done: (from: number, to: number, rows: number) => `Downloaded places ${from} to ${to}: ${rows} rows. The copy is recorded.`,
  none: (lastPlace: number) => `Nothing is newer than place ${lastPlace}.`,
  broken: COPY_BROKEN,
  // "What one key confirmed" (8.7).
  keyTitle: "What one key confirmed",
  keyWhat:
    "Use this when a key may have been in someone else's hands. Each decision listed is undone by an admin's correction on its case; there is no batch. An order's disabling is reinstated only on one of its grounds: a stolen key is not one, so check the order itself.",
  keyField: "Staff key's id",
  keyFrom: "From (UTC, for example 2026-10-10T01:00:00Z)",
  keyTo: "To (UTC)",
  keyShow: "Show what it confirmed",
  keyAll: "All rows",
  keyRule: "Enter a key's id as staff.js keys prints it, and each time as 2026-10-10T01:00:00Z, or leave a time empty.",
  thisKey: "This key",

/**
 * The composer's sentences beside its texts and its preview. The rule on personal data is the design's sentence in three
 * parts, so that each part is written once: the rule itself, and where the text goes, which differs for a decision
 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

/**
 * 3b (design, sections 8.7 and 10.7): an admin's "End this import" on an imported post's case, with what follows said
 * before the key is asked, the picker of the decision the end rests on when the case has several, and the refusals the
 * route can answer, in the console's own words (describeError's table for this action).
 */
export const IMPORT_END_WORDS = {
  title: "The whole import",
  what: "Every post of this import is removed, as if the person removed them, and the person is told.",
  /** The rule and the decision go into what the key confirms; the person's mail names both, and the decision can be appealed. */
  sign: "Your staff key confirms the end, with this case, the decision it rests on and that decision's rule.",
  legend: "The decision the end rests on",
  basis: (ruleId: string, decidedAt: string) => `${ruleId}, the final decision of ${decidedAt}`,
  button: "End this import",
  done: "The import was ended. Its posts are being removed, and the person is told.",
  refused: {
    admin_required: "Only an admin can end a whole import.",
    wrong_state: "This import cannot be ended now: it was ended already, or its posts are being removed or were removed.",
    not_found: "This import is gone: its account was deleted, or its record was erased.",
    invalid_request: "This decision cannot end the import: it is not a final decision of this case that restricted the post under a rule. Read the case again.",
  },
} as const;

import type { StaffApi } from "../api";

} from "../compose";
import { Frame } from "../frames";
import { parseImageId, StaffImage, type ImageId } from "../media";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, AUTOMATION_WORDS, CASE_WORDS, CUSTODY_WORDS, DECISION_KINDS, DECISION_OUTCOMES, describeError, IMPORT_END_WORDS, messageFor, NOTE_WORDS, ORDER_WORDS, OUTCOME_WORDS, RECOVERY_WORDS, RELEASE_WORDS, REVEAL_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink, OrderLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, parseOrderId, type CaseId, type OrderId } from "../router";
import { endImportWithKey, releaseWithKey, revealWithKey } from "../step-up";
import type { DraftSlots } from "../store";
import { normalised, saveStaffText, type RandomBytes } from "../texts";
import { bothTimes, dateTime, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel, COLLAPSED_RULES, counted, importedLine, importedSize, LANE_NAMES, revealable, sourceWords, writtenBy } from "../words";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { AnswerControl, ComposerView, CorrectControl, ReinstateControl, ReviewControl, WithdrawControl, WithdrawMarksControl, type ComposerViewProps } from "./Composer";

/**
 * The case page (3c design, sections 7.3 and 8): the header, the banners, the evidence with its images, the items with
 * their sources, the decisions with what can still be lifted or corrected, the history, the notes, the reveal of a
 * source, and the decision composer. Every string someone wrote is drawn as text inside a frame that says who wrote it;
 * every address is text, since the console holds no link into the app; and an image is asked of the API only when its
 * person asks to see it.
 */

/** The Art. 18 check, shown above the evidence of every case in the urgent lane, to everyone who opens it. */
export const ART_18_BANNER = `Art. 18: decide now, as soon as you have read this case, whether it suggests a crime that threatens someone's life or safety. If it does, or you are unsure, wake the operator at once, at any hour. Record your check in a note ("Art. 18 check: no suspicion" or "Art. 18 check: operator told at <time>"). Nobody gives this case its final decision before that note exists.`;

/** The sentences of the banner of a case that holds an unanswered suspect item. */
export const SUSPECT_BANNER = {
  nobody: "Nobody opens the images this report concerns, here or in the app.",
  reach: (reach: { images: number; posts: number; sealed: number; served: number }) =>
    `This case reaches ${reach.images} images on ${reach.posts} posts; ${reach.sealed} are sealed and ${reach.served} are still shown to someone. Seal them now, while an admin decides: they are then shown to nobody, their author included.`,
  noImage: "This case reaches no image, so there is nothing to seal.",
  post: "Do not open this post in the app while a report of this kind about it is unanswered or its images are sealed: its page also shows the post it replies to and its replies, whose images this case neither freezes nor seals.",
  account:
    "Do not open this account's profile in the app while a report of this kind about it is unanswered or its images are sealed: the profile also shows posts of other accounts that it reposted or quoted, whose images this case neither freezes nor seals, and images posted since the seal. When this page shows images that are not sealed, seal again.",
  quotes: "This post quotes another, whose images its card shows; korbat opened a case on that post too:",
  added: "korbat added this item: a reported post quotes this one, and its card shows this post's images.",
  earlierTarget: (count: number, lastOn: string) => `An admin answered ${count} earlier reports of this kind about this target without a seal in the last ${SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS} months, the last on ${lastOn}.`,
  opened: (day: string) => `Staff last opened an image of this post in the console on ${day}.`,
  earlierAuthor: (count: number, lastOn: string) => `An admin answered ${count} such reports about this author's profile or posts without a seal in the last ${SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS} months, the last on ${lastOn}.`,
  newest: (day: string) => `The newest post with images this case reaches is of ${day}.`,

/** In place of every image of a post whose images cannot be opened now. */
export const IMAGES_NOT_SHOWN =
  "Images of this post are not shown: a report or finding of child sexual abuse material about it or about its author's account is open, or its images are sealed. Decide what turns on an image on the text alone, or wait until an admin has answered that report.";

/** The reveal dialog's four reasons, as its list words them. */
const REVEAL_REASONS: Record<RevealReasonCategory, string> = {
  impersonation_claim: "A claim of impersonation",
  abuse_of_reporting: "Abuse of reporting",
  legal_requirement: "A legal requirement",
  other: "Another reason",
};

/** The frame a revealed name is shown in. */
const REVEALED_LABEL = "Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member";

/** What "Confirm with your staff key" in the reveal dialog comes to: the answer, or the console's words for the step that failed. */
export type RevealOutcome = { answer: RevealResponse } | { error: string };

/**
 * The reveal as the page runs it. The reason is saved first, without the key; the key then confirms the reveal under the
 * digest the console computed from what its person wrote (saveStaffText answers no other), never the text and never a
 * digest an answer carried. The two steps fail apart: a save refused for the minute's limit on saved texts is worded as
 * that, never as the day's limit on reveals.
 */
export async function revealSource(
  deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; random?: RandomBytes },
  caseId: CaseId,
  itemId: string,
  category: RevealReasonCategory,
  reason: string,
): Promise<RevealOutcome> {
  let reasonDigest: string;
  try {
    reasonDigest = (await saveStaffText(deps, caseId, "reveal_reason", reason)).digest;
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS) };
  }
  try {
    return { answer: await revealWithKey(deps, itemId, { reasonCategory: category, reasonDigest }) };
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, REVEAL_WORDS) };
  }
}

/**
 * What a read of the case that failed leaves on the page. Only the first read may put the page into its failed state:
 * there is no case to show then. Once the case was read, a later read that fails (after a snapshot, a note, a reveal or a
 * refused image) keeps the page as it is, the name a reveal has just shown with it, and says why on the page's error
 * line. Either way the words are the console's own for the code.
 */
export function afterFailedRead(current: Loadable<CaseView>, err: unknown): { view: Loadable<CaseView>; error: string | null } {
  const message = describeError(err, CASE_WORDS);
  return current.state === "ready" ? { view: current, error: message } : { view: { state: "failed", message }, error: null };
}

/**
 * The reveal dialog's state: which item, the category once one is chosen (the dialog opens with none: the reason on the
 * record is the person's own choice, never a default), the reason as typed, and the answer once the key confirmed.
 */
export interface RevealState {
  itemId: string;
  category: RevealReasonCategory | null;
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  answer: RevealResponse | null;
}

/** Whether the dialog holds what a reveal needs: a chosen category and a reason that says something. The API refuses an empty reason too. */
const revealReady = (reveal: RevealState): boolean => reveal.category !== null && reveal.reason.trim() !== "";

/** The one image the person asked to see: whether clearly, and whether it failed to load (the API refused it, or the request failed). */
export interface ShownImage {
  id: ImageId;
  clear: boolean;
  failed: boolean;
}

export interface CaseScreenViewProps {
  caseId: CaseId;
  view: CaseView;
  /** The one image the person asked to see; null while none is shown. */
  shownImage: ShownImage | null;
  busy: "snapshot" | "note" | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  note: string;
  reveal: RevealState | null;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onShowImage(id: ImageId): void;
  onShowClearly(): void;
  onHideImage(): void;
  /** The shown image did not load. */
  onImageError(): void;
  onSnapshot(): void;
  onNoteChange(text: string): void;
  onNoteSave(): void;
  onRevealOpen(itemId: string): void;
  onRevealChange(change: Partial<Pick<RevealState, "category" | "reason">>): void;
  onRevealConfirm(): void;
  onRevealClose(): void;
  /** 3f: an order's intake item links to its order. */
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
  /** 3f Task 6: [restore.again], when the decision taken here takes again one lost with a restore. */
  again?: string | null;
  /** 3d Task 2: the release of a seal for good, on its decision's block; without it the block shows its facts and no working control. */
  release?: ReleaseProps;
  /** 3b: an admin's "End this import" under an imported post's label; without it, or for a moderator, the page offers none. */
  importEnd?: ImportEndProps;
  /**
   * The decision composer, for the person's role, with "Lift what was done while deciding" and "Correct this decision"
   * beside the decisions. Without it the page shows the case and decides nothing.
   */
  compose?: Omit<ComposerViewProps, "view"> & {
    onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onReview(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onAnswer(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onWithdraw(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    /** 3e Task 5: "Withdraw this decision's marks" beside a "No breach" decision whose marks stand. */
    onWithdrawMarks(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    /** 3f Task 3: "Reinstate" beside an order's measure that is in force. */
    onReinstate?: (decision: CaseDecision) => void;
  };
}

/** Whether the target as it stands differs from the case's newest snapshot: then the moderator takes a fresh one before deciding. */
export function targetDiffers(view: CaseView): boolean {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest || newest.withheld) return true;
  if (view.target.type === "post") return newest.postState !== view.target.state;
  return newest.handle !== view.target.handle || newest.displayName !== view.target.displayName || newest.bio !== view.target.bio;
}

/**
 * The rule whose texts open collapsed, when an item of the case cites one: its words for the button. Everything the
 * target's author wrote takes it, as copied in a snapshot and as it reads now: the post's text, the alt texts, the
 * display name and the bio.
 */
function collapsedLabel(view: CaseView): string | undefined {
  const rule = (["R5", "R3"] as const).find((id) => view.items.some((item) => item.ruleId === id));
  return rule === undefined ? undefined : `Show text (${rule}: ${COLLAPSED_RULES[rule]})`;
}

function SuspectBanner({ view, onOpenCase }: Pick<CaseScreenViewProps, "view" | "onOpenCase">) {
  const { suspicion } = view;
  if (!suspicion?.open) return null;
  const { reach, earlier } = suspicion;
  const quotedCases = [...new Set(view.items.flatMap((item) => (item.quotedCaseId === null ? [] : [item.quotedCaseId])))].flatMap((id) => {
    const checked = parseCaseId(id);
    return checked ? [checked] : [];
  });
  const earlierAny = earlier.target.count > 0 || earlier.author.count > 0;
  return (
    <section className="banner suspect" aria-label="Report of child sexual abuse material">
      <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.nobody}</p>
      <p>{reach.images === 0 ? SUSPECT_BANNER.noImage : SUSPECT_BANNER.reach(reach)}</p>
      <p>{view.target.type === "post" ? SUSPECT_BANNER.post : SUSPECT_BANNER.account}</p>
      {quotedCases.map((id) => (
        <p key={id}>
          {`${SUSPECT_BANNER.quotes} `}
          <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
            the case on the quoted post
          </CaseLink>
        </p>
      ))}
      {view.items.some((item) => item.quotedByPosition !== null) ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.added}</p> : null}
      {earlier.target.count > 0 && earlier.target.lastOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.earlierTarget(earlier.target.count, earlier.target.lastOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlier.target.count > 0 && earlier.target.imagesOpenedOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.opened(earlier.target.imagesOpenedOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlier.author.count > 0 && earlier.author.lastOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.earlierAuthor(earlier.author.count, earlier.author.lastOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlierAny && reach.newestPostOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.newest(reach.newestPostOn)}</p> : null}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 [case.match] (section 8.4): a match's record as a list of label and value, never a hash value. The source, its
 * list version and the classification are a source's strings, each drawn in a frame "As the source returned it" (rule 3
 * of section 8); the hash type and the kind of match are the console's own words. Under it [case.matchWeak] for a hash
 * that can be made to collide on purpose, then [case.matchActing], [case.matchNear] or [case.matchFlag] by what the record
 * says, and on a case [case.matchWhat]. Held uploads prints the same record (8.6).
 */
export function MatchRecordView({ match, onCase = false }: { match: MatchRecord; onCase?: boolean }) {
  const M = AUTOMATION_WORDS.match;
  const weak = M.weak(match.hashType);
  return (
    <div className="match" role="group" aria-label={M.title}>
      <dl>
        <dt>{M.source}</dt>
        <dd>
          <Frame by={M.frame} text={match.source} />
        </dd>
        <dt>{M.listVersion}</dt>
        <dd>{match.listVersion === null ? M.none : <Frame by={M.frame} text={match.listVersion} />}</dd>
        <dt>{M.hashType}</dt>
        <dd>{match.hashType}</dd>
        <dt>{M.matchKind}</dt>
        <dd>{match.matchKind}</dd>
        <dt>{M.classification}</dt>
        <dd>{match.classification === null ? M.none : <Frame by={M.frame} text={match.classification} />}</dd>
        <dt>{M.queriedAt}</dt>
        <dd>{bothTimes(match.queriedAt)}</dd>
      </dl>
      {weak === null ? null : <p className="notice">{weak}</p>}
      <p className="notice">{match.acting ? M.acting : match.listed ? M.near : M.flag}</p>
      {onCase ? <p className="hint">{M.what}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The images a post's newest snapshot lists. Each has its entry whatever may be opened: its number, its width and height
 * as text, and its alt text in an author frame, since an alt text is text, which staff read on every path. Only the
 * image itself is held back while the post's images cannot be opened: then no grey box stands for it, nothing offers to
 * show it, and the sentence above the list says why.
 */
function Images({
  view,
  caseId,
  media,
  collapsed,
  shownImage,
  onShowImage,
  onShowClearly,
  onHideImage,
  onImageError,
}: Pick<CaseScreenViewProps, "view" | "caseId" | "shownImage" | "onShowImage" | "onShowClearly" | "onHideImage" | "onImageError"> & {
  media: NonNullable<Extract<CaseSnapshot, { withheld: false }>["media"]>;
  /** The words of the button behind which this case's texts open collapsed, when one of its items cites R3 or R5. */
  collapsed: string | undefined;
}) {
  if (view.target.type !== "post") return null;
  const openable = view.imagesAllowed;
  return (
    <>
      {openable ? null : <p className="notice">{IMAGES_NOT_SHOWN}</p>}
      {media.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="quiet">The snapshot lists no image.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="images">
          {media.map((image, index) => {
            const id = parseImageId(image.id);
            // 3d Task 7 (rule 2 of section 8): an image that an unerased match record names is closed to staff on every case,
            // also after an answer without a seal: [case.image.matched] in its place, no reveal control and no request.
            const matched = view.matchedImages.includes(image.id);
            const shown = openable && !matched && id !== null && shownImage?.id === id ? shownImage : null;
            // 3d Task 3 (section 8.4): the edge's purge line of an image that stopped being public; none for one that never did.
            const purge = view.purges.find((entry) => entry.mediaId === image.id);
            return (
              <li key={image.id}>
                {matched ? (
                  <p className="notice">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.imageMatched}</p>
                ) : openable ? (
                  <div className="placeholder">
                    {shown === null || id === null ? (
                      <span>{`Image ${index + 1}, not shown`}</span>
                    ) : shown.failed ? (
                      // The API refused the image, or it did not load: the console's own words in its place.
                      <span>{messageFor("image_refused")}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <StaffImage caseId={caseId} mediaId={id} size={shown.clear ? "large" : "small"} clear={shown.clear} onError={onImageError} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p>{`Image ${index + 1}`}</p>
                )}
                <p>{`${image.width} by ${image.height} pixels`}</p>
                {purge === undefined ? null : (
                  <p className={purge.outcome === "failed" ? "purge notice" : "purge hint"}>{AUTOMATION_WORDS.purge(purge.outcome, bothTimes(purge.at))}</p>
                )}
                {image.alt === null ? (
                  <p className="quiet">Its alt text was erased.</p>
                ) : image.alt === "" ? (
                  <p className="quiet">No alt text.</p>
                ) : (
                  <Frame by="Alt text. Written by the author" text={image.alt} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />
                )}
                {!openable || matched || id === null ? null : shown === null ? (
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => onShowImage(id)}>
                    Show image
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {shown.clear || shown.failed ? null : (
                      <button type="button" onClick={onShowClearly}>
                        Show clearly
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <button type="button" onClick={onHideImage}>
                      Hide image
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function Snapshot({ snapshot, newest, props }: { snapshot: CaseSnapshot; newest: boolean; props: CaseScreenViewProps }) {
  const collapsed = collapsedLabel(props.view);
  return (
    <article className="panel snapshot">
      <h4>
        {newest ? "Newest snapshot, taken " : "Earlier snapshot, taken "}
        <time dateTime={snapshot.takenAt}>{dateTime(snapshot.takenAt)}</time>
      </h4>
      <p className="hint">
        Digest <code className="hash">{snapshot.digest}</code>
      </p>
      {snapshot.withheld ? (
        <p>Withheld: its content was erased, or copies content that was erased since.</p>
      ) : snapshot.targetType === "post" ? (
        <>
          <p>
            Post by <UserText>{snapshot.authorHandle}</UserText>
            {snapshot.postCreatedAt === null ? "" : `, posted ${dateTime(snapshot.postCreatedAt)}`}
            {snapshot.postState === null ? "" : `, then ${snapshot.postState.split("_").join(" ")}`}
          </p>
          {snapshot.body === null || snapshot.body === "" ? <p className="quiet">The snapshot holds no text.</p> : <Frame by="Written by the author" text={snapshot.body} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
          {snapshot.replyToId === null ? null : (
            <p>
              Replies to post <code>{snapshot.replyToId}</code>
            </p>
          )}
          {snapshot.quoteOfId === null ? null : (
            <p>
              Quotes post <code>{snapshot.quoteOfId}</code>
            </p>
          )}
          {newest ? (
            <Images
              view={props.view}
              caseId={props.caseId}
              media={snapshot.media ?? []}
              collapsed={collapsed}
              shownImage={props.shownImage}
              onShowImage={props.onShowImage}
              onShowClearly={props.onShowClearly}
              onHideImage={props.onHideImage}
              onImageError={props.onImageError}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="quiet">{counted((snapshot.media ?? []).length, "image", "images")} listed.</p>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p>
            Account <UserText>{snapshot.handle ?? snapshot.authorHandle}</UserText>
          </p>
          {snapshot.displayName === null || snapshot.displayName === "" ? <p className="quiet">No display name.</p> : <Frame by="Display name. Written by the author" text={snapshot.displayName} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
          {snapshot.bio === null || snapshot.bio === "" ? <p className="quiet">No bio.</p> : <Frame by="Bio. Written by the author" text={snapshot.bio} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
        </>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function Target({ view }: { view: CaseView }) {
  const { target } = view;
  if (target.type === "post") {
    const line = (
      <p>
        The post now: {target.state === null ? "its row is gone" : `${target.state.split("_").join(" ")}, level ${target.level ?? "unknown"}`}
        {target.authorHandle === null ? null : (
          <>
            , by <UserText>{target.authorHandle}</UserText>
          </>
        )}
        . Its address, as text: <code>{target.link}</code>
      </p>
    );
    if (target.imported === null) return line;
    // 3b (8.7, 10.7): the label and the import's size, from the post's own columns and its import's row, never the account elsewhere.
    return (
      <>
        {line}
        <p>{importedLine(target.imported.source, target.imported.at)}</p>
        <p className="hint">{importedSize(target.imported.importSize, target.imported.importedAt)}</p>
      </>
    );
  }
  // The fields as they read now are the same author's words as the snapshot's: on a case citing R3 or R5 they open
  // collapsed like those.
  const collapsed = collapsedLabel(view);
  return (
    <>
      <p>
        The account now: {target.handle === null ? "its row is gone" : <UserText>{target.handle}</UserText>}
        {target.deleted ? ", deleted" : ""}. The fields as they read now:
      </p>
      {target.displayName === null || target.displayName === "" ? <p className="quiet">No display name.</p> : <Frame by="Display name. Written by the author" text={target.displayName} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      {target.bio === null || target.bio === "" ? <p className="quiet">No bio.</p> : <Frame by="Bio. Written by the author" text={target.bio} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
    </>
  );
}

/** 3b: an admin's end of a whole import, as the case page runs it: whose role, the decision picked, whether the end is on its way, and its refusal. */
export interface ImportEndProps {
  role: StaffRole;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  /** The decision the admin picked to rest the end on; null until one is picked where the case has several. */
  chosen: string | null;
  onChoose(decisionId: string): void;
  onEnd(decision: CaseDecision): void;
}

/**
 * 3b (design, section 8.7; the orchestrator's ruling for Task 6): the decisions of a case that an end of the import may
 * rest on, as the API's importEndBasis reads them: final, restricting, under a rule; none on a case about an account or
 * about a post that was not imported. In the case's order.
 */
export function importEndBases(view: CaseView): CaseDecision[] {
  if (view.target.type !== "post" || view.target.imported === null) return [];
  return view.decisions.filter((decision) => decision.kind === "final" && decision.outcome === "restricted" && decision.ruleId !== null);
}

/** The decision the end rests on: the one basis, or the one the admin picked among several. */
export function importEndChoice(view: CaseView, chosen: string | null): CaseDecision | null {
  const bases = importEndBases(view);
  if (bases.length === 1) return bases[0]!;
  return bases.find((basis) => basis.id === chosen) ?? null;
}

/**
 * 3b (design, sections 8.7 and 10.7; decision 30): "End this import", under the imported post's label, for an admin
 * alone (a moderator is shown none of it, and the API refuses one with admin_required). What follows is said before the
 * button; with several decisions to rest on the admin picks one, each named by its rule and its time; the key confirms
 * the import, the case, the decision and its rule. The button is the console's red confirming button, the one fill it
 * keeps for an action that cannot be taken back.
 */
function ImportEndBlock({ view, importEnd }: { view: CaseView; importEnd: ImportEndProps | undefined }) {
  const bases = importEndBases(view);
  if (importEnd === undefined || importEnd.role !== "admin" || bases.length === 0) return null;
  const W = IMPORT_END_WORDS;
  const choice = importEndChoice(view, importEnd.chosen);
  return (
    <section className="block import-end" aria-labelledby="import-end-title">
      <h4 id="import-end-title">{W.title}</h4>
      <p>{W.what}</p>
      <p className="hint">{W.sign}</p>
      {bases.length > 1 ? (
        <fieldset>
          <legend>{W.legend}</legend>
          <ul className="choices">
            {bases.map((basis) => (
              <li key={basis.id}>
                <label className="choice">
                  <input type="radio" name="import-end-basis" value={basis.id} checked={importEnd.chosen === basis.id} disabled={importEnd.busy} onChange={() => importEnd.onChoose(basis.id)} />
                  {W.basis(basis.ruleId!, dateTime(basis.decidedAt))}
                </label>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </fieldset>
      ) : null}
      {importEnd.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {importEnd.error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" className="primary" disabled={importEnd.busy || choice === null} aria-busy={importEnd.busy} onClick={() => (choice === null ? undefined : importEnd.onEnd(choice))}>
          {W.button}
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Item({ item, props }: { item: CaseItem; props: CaseScreenViewProps }) {
  // 3f (design, section 8.6): an order's item is listed with its order, never with a reporter's summary, a reveal or a mark.
  const order = item.source.kind === "authority";
  const orderId = item.orderId ? parseOrderId(item.orderId) : null;
  const ground = order ? "an authority's order" : item.csam ? "child sexual abuse material (notice)" : item.allegesIllegal ? "notice under Art. 16: illegal" : "breaks a rule";
  const by = writtenBy(item.source);
  const collapsed = item.ruleId !== null && Object.hasOwn(COLLAPSED_RULES, item.ruleId) ? `Show text (${item.ruleId}: ${COLLAPSED_RULES[item.ruleId]})` : undefined;
  return (
    <li className="panel item">
      <p>
        <strong>{`Item ${item.seq}`}</strong>
        {` (item ${item.position} of its notice), received ${dateTime(item.createdAt)}. `}
        {`${ground}${item.ruleId === null ? "" : `, ${item.ruleId}`}; ${categoryLabel(item.category)}.`}
      </p>
      <p>
        {"Source: "}
        <UserText>{item.source.label}</UserText>
        {sourceWords(item.source) === "" ? "" : ` (${sourceWords(item.source)})`}
        {/* 3d Task 8 (section 8.4): [case.sameSource], a count of the reporter's other open items; it names no case. */}
        {item.sameSourceOpen > 0 ? ` ${AUTOMATION_WORDS.sameSource(item.sameSourceOpen)}` : ""}
        {orderId !== null && props.onOpenOrder !== undefined ? (
          <>
            {" "}
            <OrderLink id={orderId} onOpen={props.onOpenOrder}>
              Open the order
            </OrderLink>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </p>
      <p>
        Names, as text: <UserText>{item.link}</UserText>
        {item.mediaId === null ? null : (
          <>
            {" and points at image "}
            <code>{item.mediaId}</code>
          </>
        )}
      </p>
      {/* The number is the re-examined item's place in its own notice: the page numbers this case's items otherwise, and the item may lie in an earlier case. */}
      {item.reexaminesPosition === null ? null : <p>{`Re-examination of item ${item.reexaminesPosition} of its notice`}</p>}
      {item.reexaminesYourDecision ? <p className="notice">You decided the item this re-examines. Leave it to another staff member when there is one.</p> : null}
      {item.erased ? <p className="quiet">Its words were erased under korbat's retention rules.</p> : null}
      {item.citedLaw === null ? null : <Frame by={`Cited law. ${by}`} text={item.citedLaw} />}
      {item.explanation === null ? null : <Frame by={`Explanation. ${by}`} text={item.explanation} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      {item.statement === null ? null : <Frame by={`Statement for the re-examination. ${by}`} text={item.statement} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
      {/* 3d Task 6 (section 8.4): [case.r1] on an item a program's score opened; the threshold's version, never the score. */}
      {(() => {
        const signal = props.view.signals.find((found) => found.itemId === item.id && found.kind === "r1_score");
        return signal === undefined ? null : <p className="hint">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseR1(signal.thresholdVersion ?? 0)}</p>;
      })()}
      {/* 3d Task 7 (section 8.4): [case.match] on every item a match opened, whether it cites R2 or no rule. */}
      {(() => {
        const signal = props.view.signals.find((found) => found.itemId === item.id && found.kind === "known_match");
        return signal?.match == null ? null : <MatchRecordView match={signal.match} onCase />;
      })()}
      <p>{item.outcome === null ? "Unanswered." : `Answered: ${OUTCOME_WORDS[item.outcome]}.`}</p>
      {/* 3e Task 5 (design, section 8.4): the mark "manifestly unfounded" the answering decision set, or its withdrawal. */}
      {item.unfounded ? <p className="notice">{STANDING_WORDS.mark.marked}</p> : item.markWithdrawn ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.mark.withdrawn}</p> : null}
      {revealable(item.source) ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => props.onRevealOpen(item.id)} disabled={props.reveal !== null}>
          Reveal who sent this
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {props.reveal?.itemId === item.id ? <RevealDialog reveal={props.reveal} onChange={props.onRevealChange} onConfirm={props.onRevealConfirm} onClose={props.onRevealClose} /> : null}
    </li>
  );
}

export function RevealDialog({ reveal, onChange, onConfirm, onClose }: { reveal: RevealState; onChange: CaseScreenViewProps["onRevealChange"]; onConfirm(): void; onClose(): void }) {
  const { answer } = reveal;
  const revealed = answer === null ? null : (answer.handle ?? answer.name);
  return (
    <section className="dialog" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="reveal-title">
      <h4 id="reveal-title">Reveal who sent this</h4>
      {answer === null ? (
        <>
          <p className="hint">A reveal cannot be undone. It is recorded, mailed to every staff account and listed on every staff member's home screen for 30 days.</p>
          <label htmlFor="reveal-category">Why</label>
          {/* The list opens on a line that is no reason: the person chooses the one that goes on the record. */}
          <select
            id="reveal-category"
            value={reveal.category ?? ""}
            disabled={reveal.busy}
            onChange={(event) => onChange({ category: REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES.find((category) => category === event.target.value) ?? null })}
          >
            <option value="" disabled>
              Choose why
            </option>
            {REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
              <option key={category} value={category}>
                {REVEAL_REASONS[category]}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <label htmlFor="reveal-reason">Reason</label>
          <textarea id="reveal-reason" rows={3} value={reveal.reason} disabled={reveal.busy} onChange={(event) => onChange({ reason: event.target.value })} />
          <p className="hint">Write the reason in your own words. Never copy what a reporter or a notifier wrote.</p>
          {reveal.error ? (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {reveal.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <div className="actions">
            <button type="button" className="primary" onClick={onConfirm} disabled={reveal.busy || !revealReady(reveal)} aria-busy={reveal.busy}>
              Confirm with your staff key
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={reveal.busy}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {revealed === null ? (
            <p>The name is no longer kept, so nothing can be shown. The reveal is recorded all the same.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* What it is, in the console's words; the name alone in the frame, where its hidden characters can be shown. */}
              <p>{answer.handle === null ? "The name the notifier gave:" : "The reporter's handle:"}</p>
              <Frame by={REVEALED_LABEL} text={revealed} />
            </>
          )}
          <div className="actions">
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function SealList({ sealed }: { sealed: NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["sealed"]> }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const more = sealed.posts - sealed.list.length;
  return (
    <>
      <p>{`${sealed.images} images on ${sealed.posts} posts (${sealed.deletedPosts} of them deleted by their author)`}</p>
      <button type="button" className="quiet-button" onClick={() => setOpen((shown) => !shown)} aria-expanded={open}>
        {open ? "Hide the list of posts" : "Show the list of posts"}
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <>
          <ul className="seal-list">
            {sealed.list.map((row) => (
              <li key={row.postId}>
                {`${dateTime(row.createdAt)} `}
                <code>{row.postId}</code>
                {` ${counted(row.images, "image", "images")}`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {more > 0 ? <p>{`and ${more} more: use the runbook's query for a seal's posts`}</p> : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.5): under the decision that holds a suspension or a termination, the person's reply: its
 * text in a frame of its own ([reply.empty] when there is none), when it was filed and where that leaves the measure
 * ([reply.onTime], [reply.late], [reply.lateEnded]), or that the decision which broke its basis answered it
 * ([reply.basisGone]); and "Answer this reply" for whoever may. The text is read here, in the case's logged read only.
 */
function ReplyBlock({ decision, compose }: { decision: CaseDecision; compose: CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] }) {
  const found = replyOf(decision);
  if (found === null) return null;
  const { measure, reply } = found;
  const state = replyState(measure, reply);
  const where =
    state === "onTime"
      ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.onTime
      : state === "late"
        ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.late
        : state === "lateEnded"
          ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.lateEnded(dateTime(measure.period?.endsAt ?? ""))
          : state === "basisGone"
            ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.basisGone
            : STANDING_WORDS.reply.answered(dateTime(reply.answeredAt ?? ""));
  const waiting = state === "onTime" || state === "late" || state === "lateEnded";
  return (
    <div className="reply" role="group" aria-label={STANDING_WORDS.reply.blockTitle}>
      <h4>{STANDING_WORDS.reply.blockTitle}</h4>
      {reply.text === null ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.empty}</p> : <Frame by={STANDING_WORDS.reply.writtenBy} text={reply.text} />}
      <p>
        {"Filed on "}
        <time dateTime={reply.filedAt}>{dateTime(reply.filedAt)}</time>.
      </p>
      <p className="hint">{where}</p>
      {compose !== undefined && waiting ? (
        <>
          <AnswerControl decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onAnswer={compose.onAnswer} />
          {decision.needsAdmin && compose.role !== "admin" ? <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.admin}</p> : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d (design, section 8.4): under a seal for good's decision, where its files are, from its `custody` (counts and one
 * time, never a file's name): [case.custody.in] while the seal is in force, adding that the others are still in the
 * image store while some but not all are moved; [case.custody.return] while a lifted seal's files are still in the
 * quarantine; [case.custody.lost] in its form for a seal that stands or one that was lifted.
 */
function CustodyLines({ decision }: { decision: CaseDecision }) {
  const custody = decision.custody;
  if (custody === undefined) return null;
  const inForce = decision.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media" && action.inForce);
  const W = CUSTODY_WORDS;
  return (
    <div className="custody">
      {inForce ? (
        <p className={custody.moved + custody.lost < custody.files ? "notice" : "hint"}>
          {W.custodyIn(custody.moved, custody.files, custody.movedAt === null ? null : bothTimes(custody.movedAt))}
          {custody.moved > 0 && custody.moved + custody.lost < custody.files ? ` ${W.custodyInRest}` : ""}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {custody.toReturn > 0 ? <p className="notice">{W.custodyReturn(custody.toReturn, custody.lost)}</p> : null}
      {custody.lost > 0 ? <p className="error">{W.custodyLost(custody.lost, inForce)}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** 3d Task 2: the release of a seal for good, as the case page runs it: whose role, whether a release is on its way, and its refusal. */
export interface ReleaseProps {
  role: StaffRole;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onRelease(decision: CaseDecision): void;
}

/** The params the key signs for the next release of this seal: the posts as the page shows them, the ground leave, and the recorded leave with its reference. */
export function releaseParams(release: SealRelease): SealReleasedParams | null {
  // 3d review M1: a moderator's answer has no leave at all; neither answer signs anything without one.
  if (release.leave === null || release.leave === undefined || release.postIds.length === 0) return null;
  return { postIds: [...release.postIds], basis: "leave", leaveId: release.leave.id, theirReference: release.leave.reference };
}

/** "The author may be told" (8.5): at once; not yet, by the leave's own mark; or not yet, by the record of the report or an order. */
function tellWords(release: SealRelease): string {
  const W = RELEASE_WORDS.facts.tell;
  if (!release.tellHeld) return W.atOnce;
  const leave = release.leave ?? null;
  if (leave !== null && leave.untold && (leave.untoldUntil === null || Date.parse(leave.untoldUntil) > Date.now())) return W.untold(leave.untoldUntil === null ? null : bothTimes(leave.untoldUntil));
  return W.record;
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 7.2 and 8.5): the block "Release" under a seal for good in force: the facts of
 * release_facts, each a label and a value, then the words. An authority's assessment is shown as what it is and offers no
 * control; the one control, "Release and destroy", is offered only while a leave or an instruction to destroy is recorded.
 * The reference of the authority and the leave's are drawn framed. No image is requested or drawn here. 3d review M1: the
 * block is an admin's (11.4): a moderator, whose answer holds neither the authority's reference and assessment nor the
 * leave, is shown none of it.
 */
function ReleaseBlock({ decision, release }: { decision: CaseDecision; release: ReleaseProps | undefined }) {
  const whole = decision.release;
  const admin = release?.role === "admin";
  if (whole === undefined || !admin) return null;
  // An admin's answer holds every member; the four of the admin's block read as none should one be missing.
  const facts = { ...whole, theirReference: whole.theirReference ?? null, answer: whole.answer ?? null, answeredAt: whole.answeredAt ?? null, leave: whole.leave ?? null };
  const W = RELEASE_WORDS;
  const F = W.facts;
  const params = releaseParams(facts);
  const day = (at: string | null, none: string) => (at === null ? none : bothTimes(at));
  return (
    <section className="block release" aria-labelledby={`release-${decision.id}`}>
      <h4 id={`release-${decision.id}`}>{W.title}</h4>
      <dl>
        <dt>{F.reported.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.reported ? F.reported.yes : F.reported.no}</dd>
        <dt>{F.theirReference.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.theirReference === null ? F.theirReference.none : <Frame by={F.theirReference.frame} text={facts.theirReference} />}</dd>
        <dt>{F.answer.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.answer === null ? F.answer.none : F.answer.values[facts.answer]}</dd>
        <dt>{F.answeredAt.label}</dt>
        <dd>{day(facts.answeredAt, F.answeredAt.none)}</dd>
        <dt>{F.handedOverAt.label}</dt>
        <dd>{day(facts.handedOverAt, F.handedOverAt.none)}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leave.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leave.none : F.leave.from[facts.leave.from]}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leaveReference.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leaveReference.none : <Frame by={F.theirReference.frame} text={facts.leave.reference} />}</dd>
        <dt>{F.leaveDay.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.leave === null ? F.leaveDay.none : facts.leave.receivedOn}</dd>
        <dt>{F.tell.label}</dt>
        <dd>{tellWords(facts)}</dd>
        <dt>{F.quarantined.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.quarantined ? F.quarantined.yes : F.quarantined.no}</dd>
        <dt>{F.preserved.label}</dt>
        <dd>{facts.preserved ? F.preserved.yes : F.preserved.no}</dd>
      </dl>
      {facts.releasedAt !== null && facts.backupsClearAt !== null ? (
        <p className="notice">
          {W.done(bothTimes(facts.releasedAt), facts.releasedPosts, facts.releasedImages, decision.custody?.filesLeft ?? 0, facts.noticeHeld === true, bothTimes(facts.backupsClearAt))}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <p>{W.what}</p>
      <p>{W.tells}</p>
      <p className="hint">{W.backups(RETENTION.backupDays)}</p>
      {facts.silenceDays === null ? <p className="hint">{W.periodUnset}</p> : null}
      {facts.leave === null ? (
        <p className="notice">{facts.answer === "illegal" ? W.assessed : facts.answer === "not_illegal" ? W.notIllegal : W.nothing}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          {facts.answer === "not_illegal" ? <p className="error">{W.conflict}</p> : null}
          <p>{W.leave(F.leave.from[facts.leave.from]!)}</p>
        </>
      )}
      {facts.remaining > 0 ? <p className="notice">{W.more(RELEASE_POSTS_MAX, facts.remaining)}</p> : null}
      {params === null ? null : (
        <div className="actions">
          <p className="hint">{W.sign(params.postIds.length)}</p>
          {release?.error ? (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {release.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <button type="button" disabled={release === undefined || release.busy} aria-busy={release?.busy === true} onClick={() => release?.onRelease(decision)}>
            {W.button}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (section 8.4): what a program's decision was, in the console's words: [case.auto] with its one measure and the
 * statement its author was sent, drawn again from the decision, and while a withhold of an image is in force [case.autoR1].
 * The statement of a measure this version cannot word is left out rather than guessed; Task 7's seal on a match, with
 * [case.autoR2], is worded.
 */
function ProgramDecision({ decision, view }: { decision: CaseDecision; view: CaseView }) {
  const measure = decision.actions.find((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  let paragraphs: string[] = [];
  try {
    paragraphs = statementParagraphs(programStatementOf(view, decision));
  } catch {
    paragraphs = [];
  }
  return (
    <>
