```tsx
      <p className="notice">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAuto(bothTimes(decision.decidedAt), measure === undefined ? "" : MEASURES[measure.kind].label)}</p>
      {paragraphs.length === 0 ? null : (
        <div className="frame preview">
          {paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
            <p key={index} className="frame-text">
              <UserText>{paragraph}</UserText>
            </p>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {measure?.kind === "withhold_media" && measure.inForce ? <p className="hint">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR1}</p> : null}
      {/* 3d Task 7 [case.autoR2]: a program's seal of a post's images, which only an admin answers. */}
      {measure?.kind === "seal_media" && measure.inForce ? <p className="hint">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseAutoR2}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

function Decision({ decision, view, compose, release }: { decision: CaseDecision; view: CaseView; compose: CaseScreenViewProps["compose"]; release?: ReleaseProps }) {
  const lifted = (id: string | null) => {
    const by = id === null ? undefined : view.decisions.find((other) => other.id === id);
    return by ? `lifted by the decision of ${dateTime(by.decidedAt)}` : "lifted";
  };
  return (
    <li className="panel decision">
      <p>
        <strong>{DECISION_KINDS[decision.kind]}</strong>
        {`: ${DECISION_OUTCOMES[decision.outcome]}, ${dateTime(decision.decidedAt)}, `}
        {decision.byProgram || decision.staffHandle === null ? (
          // 3d Task 6 (section 8.4): a decision without a decider, listed with the chip in the place of a staff handle.
          <span className="chip">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.byProgram}</span>
        ) : (
          <>
            {"by "}
            <UserText>{decision.staffHandle}</UserText>
          </>
        )}
        {decision.ground === null ? "" : decision.ground === "illegal" ? "; on the law" : `; under ${decision.ruleId ?? "a rule"}`}
        {`; ${categoryLabel(decision.category)}.`}
      </p>
      {decision.byProgram ? <ProgramDecision decision={decision} view={view} /> : null}
      {decision.suspect ? <p className="hint">Taken on a report or finding of child sexual abuse material.</p> : null}
      {decision.unseen ? <p className="notice">Taken while nobody could open the post's images: what it answered about an image was answered unseen.</p> : null}
      {decision.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">An admin's decision.</p> : null}
      {decision.facts === null ? null : <Frame by="Facts. Written by staff" text={decision.facts} />}
      {decision.reason === null ? null : <Frame by="Reason. Written by staff" text={decision.reason} />}
      {decision.legalReference === null ? null : <Frame by="Legal reference. Written by staff" text={decision.legalReference} />}
      {decision.actions.length === 0 ? null : (
        <ul>
          {decision.actions.map((action) => (
            <li key={action.id}>
              {MEASURES[action.kind].label}
              {action.mediaId === null ? null : (
                <>
                  {" "}
                  <code>{action.mediaId}</code>
                </>
              )}
              {MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null
                ? ""
                : action.inForce
                  ? ": in force"
                  : action.liftedBy !== null
                    ? `: ${lifted(action.liftedBy)}`
                    : action.kind === "seal_media"
                      ? ": ended with the admin's answer"
                      : ": ended with the case's decision"}
              {action.noEffect === null ? "" : "; changed nothing when imposed"}
              {action.kind === "strike" && action.countsUntil !== null ? `; counts until ${dateTime(action.countsUntil)}` : ""}
              {action.kind === "retire_handle" && action.handle !== undefined ? `; the handle @${action.handle}` : ""}
              {action.kind === "warn_reporting" && action.countsUntil !== null ? `; counts until ${dateTime(action.countsUntil)}` : ""}
              {action.kind === "restrict_reporting" && action.days !== null ? `; ${action.days} ${action.days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}` : ""}
              {action.kind === "reset_display_name" || action.kind === "reset_bio" ? "; written once; the field as it reads now is shown above" : ""}
              {action.kind === "disable_by_order" && action.withholdAuthor !== undefined ? `; ${action.withholdAuthor ? ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.withheld : ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.shown}` : ""}
              {action.kind === "reinstate_by_order" && action.orderGround !== undefined ? `: ${ORDER_GROUND_LABELS[action.orderGround]}` : ""}
              {action.sealed === null ? null : <SealList sealed={action.sealed} />}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <CustodyLines decision={decision} />
      <ReleaseBlock decision={decision} release={release} />
      {compose === undefined ? null : <CorrectControl view={view} decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onCorrect={compose.onCorrect} />}
      {compose === undefined ? null : <WithdrawControl view={view} decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onWithdraw={compose.onWithdraw} />}
      {compose === undefined ? null : <WithdrawMarksControl view={view} decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onWithdrawMarks={compose.onWithdrawMarks} />}
      {compose === undefined || compose.onReinstate === undefined ? null : <ReinstateControl decision={decision} role={compose.role} disabled={compose.busy} onReinstate={compose.onReinstate} />}
      <ReplyBlock decision={decision} compose={compose} />
    </li>
  );
}

/** One event of the history in the console's words. A staff member is named by their handle, as text. */
function historyWords(entry: CaseHistoryEntry): string {
  switch (entry.event) {
    case "item":
      return `Item ${entry.seq ?? ""} arrived${entry.reexamination ? " (a re-examination)" : ""}: ${entry.intakeKind === "order" ? "an authority's order" : entry.intakeKind === "finding" ? "a moderator's finding" : entry.intakeKind === "automated" ? AUTOMATION_WORDS.historyItem : entry.csam ? "a notice of child sexual abuse material" : entry.allegesIllegal ? "a notice under Art. 16" : "a report"}${entry.ruleId === null ? "" : `, ${entry.ruleId}`}`;
    case "snapshot":
      return "A snapshot was taken";
    case "decision":
      return `${entry.decisionKind === null ? "Decision" : DECISION_KINDS[entry.decisionKind]}: ${entry.outcome === null ? "" : DECISION_OUTCOMES[entry.outcome]}`;
    case "appeal_filed":
      return "The author appealed";
    case "appeal_answered":
      return `The appeal was answered: ${entry.result === null ? "" : entry.result.split("_").join(" ")}`;
    case "note":
      return "A note was saved";
    case "seal_declined":
      return "Chose not to seal";
    case "reveal":
      return "A source was revealed";
    case "evidence_erased":
      return "A snapshot's content was erased";
    case "redaction":
      return "Content was erased when an R4 decision became final";
  }
}

/**
 * The author's standing on a post case (3e design, section 8.2), above the evidence and in bands, as D 8 words a
 * reporter's summary: so that the moderator knows what a strike here leads to, never as a reason to find a breach.
 */
function AuthorStandingBands({ view }: { view: CaseView }) {
  const standing = view.authorStanding;
  if (standing === null) return null;
  return (
    <section className="panel standing" aria-labelledby="standing-title">
      <h3 id="standing-title">The author's standing</h3>
      <ul className="plain">
        <li>{STANDING_WORDS.bands.activeStrikes[standing.activeStrikes]}</li>
        <li>{STANDING_WORDS.bands.suspensionsInYear[standing.suspensionsInYear]}</li>
        <li>{STANDING_WORDS.bands.now[standing.now]}</li>
      </ul>
      <p className="hint">{STANDING_WORDS.postStanding}</p>
    </section>
  );
}

export function CaseScreenView(props: CaseScreenViewProps) {
  const { view, busy, notice, error, note } = props;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="case-title">
      <h2 id="case-title">{view.target.type === "post" ? "Case about a post" : "Case about an account"}</h2>
      <p>
        {`${LANE_NAMES[view.lane]}${view.lane === 0 ? " lane" : ""}; opened ${dateTime(view.openedAt)}; version ${view.stateVersion}`}
        {view.closedAt === null ? "" : `; closed ${dateTime(view.closedAt)}`}
      </p>
      {/* 3d Task 8 (section 8.4): [case.flag] under the header, with its chip; counts only, never a reporter. */}
      {view.flag === null ? null : (
        <p className="notice">
          <span className="chip">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag}</span> <span>{AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseFlag(view.flag.items, view.flag.reporters)}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {view.lane === 0 ? <p className="banner art18">{ART_18_BANNER}</p> : null}
      <SuspectBanner view={view} onOpenCase={props.onOpenCase} />
      <AuthorStandingBands view={view} />
      {/* 3d Task 6 (section 8.4): [case.objection], while the measure the author asked about is in force; the text is theirs. */}
      {view.objection === null ? null : (
        <section className="panel objection" aria-label={AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.objected}>
          <p className="notice">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.lead(bothTimes(view.objection.createdAt))}</p>
          <Frame by={AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.by} text={view.objection.text} />
          <p className="hint">{AUTOMATION_WORDS.objection.tail}</p>
        </section>
      )}

      <h3>Evidence</h3>
      {/* 3f (design, section 8.6): a post preserved under an order shows no text and no image; korbat's rules are its own. */}
      {view.preserved ? <p className="notice">{ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.preserved}</p> : null}
      {view.decisions.some((decision) => decision.kind === "order") ? <p className="hint">{ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.own}</p> : null}
      {view.noticeHeld === null ? null : <p className="notice">{ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.heldToo(view.noticeHeld.until === null ? null : dateTime(view.noticeHeld.until))}</p>}
      {/* 3f Task 5 (sections 7.13 and 8.6): a report to the authorities owed for this case, since when; nothing more. */}
      {view.reportOwed === null ? null : <p className="notice">{ORDER_WORDS.caseOwed(bothTimes(view.reportOwed.since))}</p>}
      <Target view={view} />
      <ImportEndBlock view={view} importEnd={props.importEnd} />
      {targetDiffers(view) ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={props.onSnapshot} disabled={busy !== null} aria-busy={busy === "snapshot"}>
          Take a fresh snapshot
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {view.snapshots.length === 0 ? <p className="quiet">The case holds no snapshot.</p> : null}
      {view.snapshots.map((snapshot, index) => (
        <Snapshot key={snapshot.id} snapshot={snapshot} newest={index === 0} props={props} />
      ))}
      {/* The images' list says so itself, above its entries; a case whose newest snapshot shows no content has no list. */}
      {view.target.type === "post" && !view.imagesAllowed && (view.snapshots[0] === undefined || view.snapshots[0].withheld) ? <p className="notice">{IMAGES_NOT_SHOWN}</p> : null}

      <h3>Items</h3>
      <ul className="plain">
        {view.items.map((item) => (
          <Item key={item.id} item={item} props={props} />
        ))}
      </ul>

      <h3>Decisions</h3>
      {view.decisions.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="quiet">No decision yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="plain">
          {view.decisions.map((decision) => (
            <Decision key={decision.id} decision={decision} view={view} compose={props.compose} {...(props.release === undefined ? {} : { release: props.release })} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {view.appeals.map((appeal) => {
        const appealed = view.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === appeal.decisionId);
        return (
          <div key={appeal.id} className="panel">
            <p>{`The author appealed${appealed ? ` the decision of ${dateTime(appealed.decidedAt)}` : ""} on ${dateTime(appeal.filedAt)}${appeal.result === null ? "; not answered yet" : `; answered: ${appeal.result.split("_").join(" ")}`}.`}</p>
            {appeal.statement === null ? null : <Frame by="Written by the appellant" text={appeal.statement} />}
            {/* A pending appeal says who may review it; the control stands only for the person the API marked. */}
            {appeal.result !== null ? null : (
              <>
                {appeal.needsAdmin ? <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin}</p> : null}
                {appeal.reviewer === null || appeal.reviewer === "available" ? null : <p className="notice">{APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer[appeal.reviewer]}</p>}
                {appeal.mayReview ? null : <p className="hint">{APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview}</p>}
                {props.compose === undefined || !appealed ? null : <ReviewControl view={view} decision={appealed} disabled={props.compose.busy} onReview={props.compose.onReview} />}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}

      <h3>History</h3>
      <ol className="history">
        {view.history.map((entry, index) => (
          <li key={`${entry.at} ${entry.event} ${entry.refId ?? index}`}>
            <time dateTime={entry.at}>{dateTime(entry.at)}</time>
            {` ${historyWords(entry)}`}
            {entry.staffHandle === null ? null : (
              <>
                {", by "}
                <UserText>{entry.staffHandle}</UserText>
              </>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      <h3>Notes</h3>
      <p className="hint">Notes are for staff only and go with the case's evidence.</p>
      {view.notes.length === 0 && view.sealsDeclined.length === 0 ? <p className="quiet">No note yet.</p> : null}
      {view.notes.map((text) => (
        <div key={text.id}>
          <p>
            <UserText>{text.staffHandle}</UserText>
            {`, ${dateTime(text.createdAt)}`}
          </p>
          <Frame by="Note. Written by staff" text={text.text} />
        </div>
      ))}
      {view.sealsDeclined.map((text) => (
        <div key={text.id}>
          <p>
            {"Chose not to seal: "}
            <UserText>{text.staffHandle}</UserText>
            {`, ${dateTime(text.createdAt)}`}
          </p>
          <Frame by="Reason. Written by staff" text={text.text} />
        </div>
      ))}
      <label htmlFor="case-note">Add a note</label>
      <textarea id="case-note" rows={3} value={note} disabled={busy !== null} onChange={(event) => props.onNoteChange(event.target.value)} />
      <div className="actions">
        <button type="button" onClick={props.onNoteSave} disabled={busy !== null || note.trim() === ""} aria-busy={busy === "note"}>
          Save the note
        </button>
      </div>

      {props.again ? <p className="notice">{props.again}</p> : null}
      {props.compose === undefined ? null : <ComposerView view={view} {...props.compose} />}
    </section>
  );
}

export function CaseScreen({
  id,
  api,
  credentials,
  role,
  drafts,
  onOpenCase,
  onOpenOrder,
  gap = null,
  onGapTaken,
}: {
  id: CaseId;
  api: StaffApi;
  credentials: CredentialsLike;
  role: StaffRole;
  drafts: DraftSlots;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onOpenOrder?: (id: OrderId) => void;
  /** 3f Task 6: the restore gap this case was opened for from After a restore: the decision confirmed here closes it. */
  gap?: { id: string; actedAt: string } | null;
  /** Told once a decision that named the gap has been recorded. */
  onGapTaken?: () => void;
}) {
  const [view, setView] = useState<Loadable<CaseView>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [shownImage, setShownImage] = useState<ShownImage | null>(null);
  // 3d Task 6 (section 8.4, [case.r1]): every image this person opened on this case, which the API logged as viewed: the
  // composer's preview says from it whether the decision follows a look at the image a program rated.
  const [viewedImages, setViewedImages] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"snapshot" | "note" | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [reveal, setReveal] = useState<RevealState | null>(null);
  const [releasing, setReleasing] = useState(false);
  const [releaseError, setReleaseError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // 3b: an admin's end of the import the case's post came from: the decision picked, whether it is on its way, its refusal.
  const [ending, setEnding] = useState<{ chosen: string | null; busy: boolean; error: string | null }>({ chosen: null, busy: false, error: null });
  // The composer's draft lives in the store's slot for this case, so that it is still there after a session that ended
  // and a sign-in by the same handle; the page keeps its own copy to draw.
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<CaseDraft | null>(() => drafts.get(id));
  const draftNow = useRef<CaseDraft | null>(draft);
  /** The decision's draft that a correction or a review took the place of, to come back to when that is put away. */
  const beforeCorrection = useRef<CaseDraft | null>(null);
  const [composing, setComposing] = useState(false);
  const [composeError, setComposeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [textErrors, setTextErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>>>({});
  /** The saves of texts that are on their way, by the text's kind: a confirmation waits for them, so that no text is saved twice. */
  const saving = useRef(new Map<DraftTextKind, Promise<void>>());
  const [declining, setDeclining] = useState<{ reason: string; busy: boolean; error: string | null } | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  /** What the page shows of the case, as the last read left it: a read that fails is judged against it. */
  const page = useRef<Loadable<CaseView>>({ state: "loading" });

  /** Keeps a draft: in the store's slot, and on the page. */
  const keep = (next: CaseDraft) => {
    drafts.set(next);
    draftNow.current = next;
    setDraft(next);
  };

  /** A case with no draft yet gets a fresh one, with the texts its person saved on it before (a reload fetches them back). */
  const openDraft = async (value: CaseView) => {
    if (draftNow.current !== null) return;
    const fresh = await withSavedTexts(newDraft(id, value, role), value.drafts);
    if (!alive.current || draftNow.current !== null) return;
    // Not put into the store's slot before its person changes it: an untouched draft is made again from the case.
    draftNow.current = fresh;
    setDraft(fresh);
  };

  /**
   * Reads the case: its person opened the page or acted on it, so the read is marked. True when the page now shows what
   * was just read. A read that fails after the first keeps the page and uses its error line (afterFailedRead).
   */
  const read = (): Promise<boolean> =>
    api.caseView(id, { activity: true }).then(
      (value) => {
        if (!alive.current) return false;
        page.current = { state: "ready", value };
        setView(page.current);
        void openDraft(value);
        return true;
      },
      (err: unknown) => {
        if (!alive.current) return false;
        const failed = afterFailedRead(page.current, err);
        page.current = failed.view;
        setView(failed.view);
        if (failed.error !== null) setError(failed.error);
        return false;
      },
    );

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void read();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the page; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api, id]);

  const snapshot = async () => {
    setBusy("snapshot");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.takeSnapshot(id, { activity: true });
      // The snapshot's content is read with the case: that read is what the access log and the day's limit count.
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? "A fresh snapshot is the case's newest now." : "A fresh snapshot was taken. This page still shows the case as it was read before.");
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const saveNote = async () => {
    setBusy("note");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await saveStaffText({ api }, id, "note", note);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNote("");
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? "The note is saved." : "The note is saved. This page still shows the case as it was read before.");
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const confirmReveal = async () => {
    if (reveal === null || reveal.busy || reveal.category === null || !revealReady(reveal)) return;
    const { itemId, category, reason } = reveal;
    setReveal({ ...reveal, busy: true, error: null });
    const outcome = await revealSource({ api, credentials }, id, itemId, category, reason);
    if (!alive.current) return;
    if ("error" in outcome) {
      setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, error: outcome.error }));
      return;
    }
    setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, answer: outcome.answer }));
    // The history gains the reveal. Should this read fail, the page and the name it shows stay as they are.
    void read();
  };

  /**
   * 3d Task 2 (section 7.2): "Release and destroy" on a seal for good, confirmed by the key with exactly the params the
   * block shows. The answer is the case as it now stands; a refusal is worded in place and the case is read again, since
   * the facts it rests on moved between the read and the key.
   */
  const release = async (decision: CaseDecision) => {
    const seal = decision.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
    const params = decision.release === undefined ? null : releaseParams(decision.release);
    if (releasing || seal === undefined || params === null) return;
    setReleasing(true);
    setReleaseError(null);
    try {
      const answer = await releaseWithKey({ api, credentials }, id, seal.id, params);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      page.current = { state: "ready", value: answer };
      setView(page.current);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setReleaseError(describeError(err));
      void read();
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setReleasing(false);
    }
  };

  /**
   * 3b (design, sections 8.7 and 10.7): "End this import", confirmed by the key with the import, this case, the decision
   * the block shows as chosen and its rule. The answer is the case as it now stands, whose target shows the import; a
   * refusal is worded in place, in the action's own words, and the case is read again, since what the end rests on may
   * have moved between the read and the key.
   */
  const endImport = async (decision: CaseDecision) => {
    const shown = page.current.state === "ready" ? page.current.value : null;
    const target = shown?.target;
    if (ending.busy || target?.type !== "post" || target.imported === null || decision.ruleId === null) return;
    setEnding((current) => ({ ...current, busy: true, error: null }));
    setNotice(null);
    try {
      const answer = await endImportWithKey({ api, credentials }, target.imported.importId, { caseId: id, decisionId: decision.id, ruleId: decision.ruleId });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      page.current = { state: "ready", value: answer };
      setView(page.current);
      setNotice(IMPORT_END_WORDS.done);
      setEnding({ chosen: null, busy: false, error: null });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setEnding((current) => ({ ...current, busy: false, error: describeError(err, IMPORT_END_WORDS.refused) }));
      void read();
    }
  };

  /** A text that is saved now: the refusal of an earlier save of it, worded under its field, no longer holds. */
  const textSaved = (kind: DraftTextKind) => setTextErrors((errors) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(errors).filter(([refused]) => refused !== kind)));

  /**
   * A text's field lost focus: the text is saved, without the key, so that a reload before the first confirmation brings
   * it back (3c design, section 7.4). A refusal is worded under its field. What was written stays in the draft either
   * way: a text whose save failed is saved again by the confirmation.
   */
  const saveText = (kind: DraftTextKind) => {
    const written = draftNow.current;
    if (written === null || composing) return;
    const run = (async () => {
      const outcome = await saveDraftText({ api }, id, written, kind);
      if (!alive.current || outcome === null) return;
      if ("error" in outcome) {
        setTextErrors((errors) => ({ ...errors, [kind]: outcome.error }));
        return;
      }
      textSaved(kind);
      // Remembered only while the draft still holds the text that was saved: its person may have typed on meanwhile.
      const now = draftNow.current;
      if (now !== null && now.kind === written.kind && normalised(now.written[kind]) === outcome.saved.text) keep({ ...now, texts: { ...now.texts, [kind]: outcome.saved } });
    })();
    saving.current.set(kind, run);
    void run.finally(() => {
      if (saving.current.get(kind) === run) saving.current.delete(kind);
    });
  };

  /**
   * "Confirm with your staff key": the draft as the composer showed it, saved, confirmed and sent; the page then shows
   * what the answer says now stands. The busy flag is confirmWhileBusy's: down again on every way out.
   */
  const confirm = () => {
    if (composing) return Promise.resolve();
    const confirming = {
      alive: () => alive.current,
      shown: () => (page.current.state === "ready" ? page.current.value : null),
      draft: () => draftNow.current,
      saving: () => [...saving.current.values()],
      setBusy: setComposing,
    };
    return confirmWhileBusy(confirming, async (shown, held) => {
      setComposeError(null);
      setNotice(null);
      setError(null);
      const sent = offeredDraft(shown, role, held);
      const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api, credentials, gap: gap?.id ?? null }, id, shown, sent, (kind, saved) => {
        // The confirmation saved a text whose save had failed when its field lost focus.
        textSaved(kind);
        if (draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, texts: { ...draftNow.current.texts, [kind]: saved } });
      });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if ("error" in outcome) {
        // The refusal is worded in place and the draft kept. A text that is gone or was used is saved again at the next
        // try; a case or a snapshot that is no longer what the page shows is read again.
        const then = afterRefusal(outcome.code);
        if (then.saveAgain && draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, texts: {} });
        setComposeError(outcome.error);
        if (then.readAgain) void read();
        return;
      }
      const now = "view" in outcome ? outcome.view : outcome.fresh;
      page.current = { state: "ready", value: now };
      setView(page.current);
      if ("fresh" in outcome) {
        setNotice(outcome.notice);
        return;
      }
      // Decided: the draft is done with, and the composer starts anew on the case as it now stands.
      drafts.clear(id);
      // Task 6: the gap the decision named is closed with it; the next decision here is a new one.
      if (gap !== null) onGapTaken?.();
      beforeCorrection.current = null;
      draftNow.current = newDraft(id, now, role);
      setDraft(draftNow.current);
      setTextErrors({});
      setNotice(sent.kind === "review" ? COMPOSER.reviewed : decidedNotice(shown, now, sent.kind === "final"));
    });
  };

  /** "Do not seal now": the reason is saved as a text of its own kind, which is complete when saved, and the case is read again. */
  const declineSeal = async () => {
    if (declining === null || declining.busy) return;
    setDeclining({ ...declining, busy: true, error: null });
    try {
      await saveStaffText({ api }, id, "seal_declined", declining.reason);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setDeclining(null);
      const fresh = await read();
      if (alive.current) setNotice(fresh ? COMPOSER.declined : `${COMPOSER.declined} This page still shows the case as it was read before.`);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setDeclining((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, busy: false, error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS) }));
    }
  };

  /**
   * Opens a correction of Task 4 (an answer to a reply, a withdrawal) as "Correct this decision" opens one: the draft it
   * replaces is kept for Cancel, and the reason its person saved on this case before comes back, unless they have typed.
   */
  const openAnother = (value: CaseView, opened: CaseDraft) => {
    setComposeError(null);
    setTextErrors({});
    if (draftNow.current !== null && draftNow.current.kind !== "correction" && draftNow.current.kind !== "review") beforeCorrection.current = draftNow.current;
    keep(opened);
    void withSavedTexts(opened, value.drafts).then((restored) => {
      if (alive.current && draftNow.current === opened) keep(restored);
    });
  };

  const composeProps = (value: CaseView): CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] =>
    draft === null
      ? undefined
      : {
          role,
          draft,
          now: new Date(),
          viewedImages,
          busy: composing,
          error: composeError,
          textErrors,
          declining,
          onChange: (change) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            // A text that is typed on again is judged anew at its next save.
            if (change.written !== undefined) setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null) keep({ ...draftNow.current, ...change });
          },
          onTextBlur: saveText,
          onSeal: () => {
            setComposeError(null);
            if (draftNow.current !== null) keep(withSeal(value, offeredDraft(value, role, draftNow.current)));
          },
          onConfirm: () => void confirm(),
          onDeclineOpen: () => setDeclining({ reason: "", busy: false, error: null }),
          onDeclineChange: (reason) => setDeclining((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, reason })),
          onDeclineSave: () => void declineSeal(),
          onDeclineClose: () => setDeclining(null),
          onCorrect: (decision) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null && draftNow.current.kind !== "correction" && draftNow.current.kind !== "review") beforeCorrection.current = draftNow.current;
            const opened = correctionDraft(id, value, decision, role);
            keep(opened);
            // The reason its person saved for a correction on this case before comes back with it, unless they have typed since.
            void openCorrection(id, value, decision, role).then((restored) => {
              if (alive.current && draftNow.current === opened) keep(restored);
            });
          },
          onReview: (decision) => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            if (draftNow.current !== null && draftNow.current.kind !== "correction" && draftNow.current.kind !== "review") beforeCorrection.current = draftNow.current;
            const opened = reviewDraft(id, value, decision, role);
            keep(opened);
            // As for a correction: a review reason saved on this case before comes back, unless its person has typed since.
            void openReview(id, value, decision, role).then((restored) => {
              if (alive.current && draftNow.current === opened) keep(restored);
            });
          },
          // 3e Task 4: an answer to the reply, and the withdrawal of an announced measure, open as a correction does.
          onAnswer: (decision) => openAnother(value, answerDraft(id, value, decision, role)),
          onWithdraw: (decision) => openAnother(value, withdrawDraft(id, value, decision, role)),
          // 3e Task 5: the withdrawal of a decision's marks opens as a correction does.
          onWithdrawMarks: (decision) => openAnother(value, withdrawMarksDraft(id, value, decision, role)),
          // 3f Task 3: the reinstatement after an order opens as a correction does.
          onReinstate: (decision) => openAnother(value, reinstateDraft(id, value, decision, role)),
          onCancelCorrection: () => {
            setComposeError(null);
            setTextErrors({});
            keep(beforeCorrection.current ?? newDraft(id, value, role));
            beforeCorrection.current = null;
          },
        };

  return (
    <Loaded
      value={view}
      render={(value) => (
        <CaseScreenView
          caseId={id}
          view={value}
          compose={composeProps(value)}
          shownImage={shownImage}
          busy={busy}
          notice={notice}
          error={error}
          note={note}
          reveal={reveal}
          onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
          {...(onOpenOrder === undefined ? {} : { onOpenOrder })}
          again={gap === null ? null : RECOVERY_WORDS.again(bothTimes(gap.actedAt))}
          release={{ role, busy: releasing, error: releaseError, onRelease: (decision) => void release(decision) }}
          importEnd={{
            role,
            busy: ending.busy,
            error: ending.error,
            chosen: ending.chosen,
            onChoose: (decisionId) => setEnding((current) => ({ ...current, chosen: decisionId, error: null })),
            onEnd: (decision) => void endImport(decision),
          }}
          // One image at a time: showing another puts the first back behind its placeholder.
          onShowImage={(image) => {
            setShownImage({ id: image, clear: false, failed: false });
            setViewedImages((seen) => (seen.includes(image) ? seen : [...seen, image]));
          }}
          onShowClearly={() => setShownImage((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, clear: true }))}
          onHideImage={() => setShownImage(null)}
          // The image did not load: its place says so, and the case is read again, since what may be opened has
          // probably changed (a report froze the post, or its images were sealed, since the page read the case).
          onImageError={() => {
            setShownImage((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, failed: true }));
            void read();
          }}
          onSnapshot={() => void snapshot()}
          onNoteChange={setNote}
          onNoteSave={() => void saveNote()}
          onRevealOpen={(itemId) => setReveal({ itemId, category: null, reason: "", busy: false, error: null, answer: null })}
          onRevealChange={(change) => setReveal((current) => (current === null ? null : { ...current, ...change }))}
          onRevealConfirm={() => void confirmReveal()}
          onRevealClose={() => setReveal(null)}
        />
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/step-up.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import {
  STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE,
  StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  stepUpActionHash,
  stepUpBinding,
  type AppealsReviewedParams,
  type AuditExportedParams,
  type AuthenticationResponseJSON,
  type CaseDecidedParams,
  type IdentityRevealedParams,
  type ImportEndedByStaffParams,
  type OrderCorrectFacts,
  type OrderEffectedParams,
  type OrderEventRecordedParams,
  type SealReleasedParams,
  type UploadHoldEndedParams,
  type UploadReleasedParams,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ApiError, type StaffApi } from "./api";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { authenticationResponseToJSON, ceremonyFailure, fromBase64url, requestOptionsFromJSON, type CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The step-up as the console runs it (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Before it asks the key to confirm an action, the page
 * checks the options the API gave it: the challenge must be the 74 bytes of the contracts' step-up layout with the
 * staff_step_up purpose, bound to the sha256 of this session's handle and the hash of exactly the `{ action, target,
 * params }` the page chose, and the allow list must hold one key. Otherwise the key is never asked, so an API under an
 * attacker's control cannot have it sign an action the person did not choose. The check trusts the page, which Caddy
 * serves from its image, not the API.
 */

/** Options that bind something other than the action the person chose; the key was not asked. */
export class StepUpMismatch extends Error {
  readonly code = "step_up_mismatch";
  readonly status = 0;
  constructor() {
    super(messageFor("step_up_mismatch"));
    this.name = "StepUpMismatch";
  }
}

const sameBytes = (a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): boolean => a.length === b.length && a.every((byte, i) => byte === b[i]);

/**
 * Checks step-up options against this session's handle and the action the page is about to confirm, with the contracts'
 * layout, purpose code, sorted-JSON text and hash, never a copy of them. Throws StepUpMismatch on any difference.
 */
export async function checkStepUpOptions(options: { challenge: string; allowCredentials?: unknown }, sessionHandle: string, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest): Promise<void> {
  const layout = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
  let challenge: Uint8Array;
  try {
    challenge = fromBase64url(options.challenge);
  } catch {
    throw new StepUpMismatch();
  }
  if (challenge.length !== layout.bytes) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  if (challenge[layout.versionAt] !== layout.version || challenge[layout.purposeAt] !== layout.purpose) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // The binding is recomputed here from what the page chose, so a challenge bound to another action, target, params or
  // session never reaches the key.
  const expected = await stepUpBinding(sessionHandle, await stepUpActionHash(action));
  if (!sameBytes(challenge.subarray(layout.bindingAt, layout.bindingAt + layout.bindingBytes), expected)) throw new StepUpMismatch();
  // Exactly one key, the session's own: an empty list would let the browser offer any key the person holds.
  if (!Array.isArray(options.allowCredentials) || options.allowCredentials.length !== 1) throw new StepUpMismatch();
}

/**
 * The action that revokes one of the person's staff sessions: its handle as the target, in lower case, the one spelling
 * the API accepts for a step-up target (it hashes the id exactly as sent), and no params.
 */
export function sessionRevokeAction(handle: string): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: handle.toLowerCase() }, params: {} });
}

/**
 * The action that reveals who sent an item: the item's id as the target and, as params, the reason's category and the
 * digest of the reason the person saved. The console builds it from what it shows, with the contracts' schema, so the
 * binding it checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function revealAction(itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: itemId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that decides a case: the case's id as the target and, as params, the decision as the composer built it from
 * what the page shows: ids, enums, whole numbers and the digests the console computed, never a text. The contracts'
 * schema refuses anything else, so the binding the console checks before it asks the key is its own.
 */
export function decisionAction(caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: caseId }, params });
}

/**
 * The action that reviews an appeal: the appealed decision's id as the target and, as params, the review as the review
 * composer built it from what the page shows: the appeal, ids, enums, whole numbers and digests, never a text.
 */
export function reviewAction(decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: decisionId }, params });
}

/**
 * One action confirmed by the key (3c design, section 8): the session's handle read from a marked /me right before,
 * since the API binds the challenge to the session the request's cookie names, which another tab's sign-in may have
 * replaced since the page read its session; then options for exactly this action, asked right before the key (the API
 * reads a step-up challenge only while more than a minute of its ten is left), checked against what the page chose,
 * signed, and handed to `send`, which sends the action's own request with the assertion. The only place the console asks
 * a key to confirm anything: the revocation of a session, a decision, a review and a reveal all go through it. Every
 * request is marked: the person clicked.
 */
export async function confirmWithKey<T>(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, send: (stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const { sessionHandle } = await deps.api.me({ activity: true });
  const { options } = await deps.api.stepUpOptions(action, { activity: true });
  await checkStepUpOptions(options, sessionHandle, action);
  let credential: unknown;
  try {
    credential = await deps.credentials.get({ publicKey: requestOptionsFromJSON(options) });
  } catch (err) {
    throw ceremonyFailure(err);
  }
  return send(authenticationResponseToJSON(credential));
}

/** "Sign out that session", confirmed by the key. "gone" when the session had already ended. */
export async function revokeSessionWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, targetHandle: string): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> {
  const action = sessionRevokeAction(targetHandle);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, async (stepUp): Promise<"revoked" | "gone"> => {
    try {
      await deps.api.revokeSession(action.target.id, { stepUp }, { activity: true });
      return "revoked";
    } catch (err) {
      // The API answers a handle that names no live session of the person's as the app does: 404.
      if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 && err.code === "not_found") return "gone";
      throw err;
    }
  });
}

/**
 * "Reveal who sent this", confirmed by the key: the reveal of the item with the category and the digest of the saved
 * reason. Answers the reporter's handle or the notifier's given name; both are null when the name was forgotten.
 */
export function revealWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, itemId: string, params: IdentityRevealedParams) {
  const action = revealAction(itemId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.reveal(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the decision composer: the decision on the case, with exactly the params the page
 * built. Answers the case as it stands after the decision, which the page then shows.
 */
export function decideWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams, gap: string | null = null) {
  const action = decisionAction(caseId, params);
  // 3f Task 6: a decision that takes a lost one again names its restore gap; the key signs the decision as always.
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.decide(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }, gap));
}

/**
 * "Confirm with your staff key" in the review composer: the review of the decision's appeal, with exactly the params the
 * page built. Answers the decision's case as it stands after the review, which must be the case the page shows.
 */
export function reviewWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams, gap: string | null = null) {
  const action = reviewAction(decisionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.review(caseId, action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }, gap));
}

/**
 * 3f Task 6 (7.16): the audit log's download, confirmed by the key: the places after `after` up to `through`, the target
 * being `through` as decimal digits. Answers the text of the JSON lines, which the page checks before it saves or marks.
 */
export function exportAuditWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, params: AuditExportedParams) {
  const action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = { action: "audit_exported", target: { type: "audit", id: String(params.through) }, params };
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.exportAudit({ ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3d Task 2 (sections 7.2, 8.5 and 10.4): the action of a release of a seal for good: the seal's ledger row as the target,
 * and as params the posts, the ground, and the recorded leave with its reference, as the page showed them. checkStepUpOptions
 * compares the options the server answers with exactly this before the key is asked.
 */
export function releaseAction(actionId: string, params: SealReleasedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "seal_released", target: { type: "seal", id: actionId }, params };
}

/** "Release and destroy": the release confirmed by the key. Answers the seal's case as it now stands, which the page shows. */
export function releaseWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, caseId: string, actionId: string, params: SealReleasedParams) {
  const action = releaseAction(actionId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.releaseSeal(caseId, actionId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (sections 7.12, 8.6 and 10.4): the action of an end of a held upload's hold: the refusal as the target, and as
 * params the end and its reason exactly as the person chose them; neither end is a default.
 */
export function holdEndAction(refusalId: string, params: UploadHoldEndedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "upload_hold_ended", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: refusalId }, params };
}

/** "Report" or "No report" on Held uploads, confirmed by the key. Answers the refusal as it now shows. */
export function endHoldWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, refusalId: string, params: UploadHoldEndedParams) {
  const action = holdEndAction(refusalId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.endHold(refusalId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** 3d Task 7 (8.6): the action of a held upload's release: the refusal as the target, the ground and the recorded leave with its reference. */
export function uploadReleaseAction(refusalId: string, params: UploadReleasedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return { action: "upload_released", target: { type: "upload_refusal", id: refusalId }, params };
}

/** "Release and destroy" on Held uploads, confirmed by the key. Answers the refusal as it now shows. */
export function releaseUploadWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, refusalId: string, params: UploadReleasedParams) {
  const action = uploadReleaseAction(refusalId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.releaseUpload(refusalId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** 3f Task 6 (8.8): an admin's "Not needed" on a gap, confirmed by the key. Answers After a restore as it now stands. */
export function closeGapWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, gapId: string) {
  const params = { disposition: "not_needed" as const };
  const action: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = { action: "gap_closed", target: { type: "restore_gap", id: gapId }, params };
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.closeGap(gapId, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3f: the action that records a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension on an order: the order's id as the
 * target and the event's kind, ground and message as params, as the page chose them.
 */
export function orderEventAction(orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_event_recorded", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params });
}

/** 3f: the action that corrects an order under the rule admin: the order's id and, as params, the facts to change. */
export function orderCorrectAction(orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_corrected", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params: { facts } });
}

/**
 * 3f Task 3: the action of "Disable for an order": the order's id as the target and, as params, the order's facts as the
 * page showed them, `urgent`, and the ticked items with their posts, sorted by post. The schema refuses any other order,
 * so one action has one hash and its order is the lock order.
 */
export function orderEffectAction(orderId: string, params: OrderEffectedParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "order_effected", target: { type: "order", id: orderId }, params });
}

/** "Disable {n} posts: confirm with your staff key"; answers the order as it stands after the effect. */
export function effectOrderWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, params: OrderEffectedParams) {
  const action = orderEffectAction(orderId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.effectOrder(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an order's event; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function recordOrderEventWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, params: OrderEventRecordedParams) {
  const action = orderEventAction(orderId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.recordOrderEvent(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/** "Confirm with your staff key" on an admin's correction; answers the order as it stands after it. */
export function correctOrderWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, orderId: string, facts: OrderCorrectFacts) {
  const action = orderCorrectAction(orderId, facts);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.correctOrder(action.target.id, { facts, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
}

/**
 * 3b (design, sections 8.7 and 10.7; decision 30): the action of an admin's end of a whole import: the import as the
 * target, and as params the case it is ended from, the decision it rests on and that decision's rule, as the case page
 * shows them. The contracts' schema refuses an id that is not lower case and anything typed, so checkStepUpOptions
 * compares the options with exactly this before the key is asked.
 */
export function importEndAction(importId: string, params: ImportEndedByStaffParams): StaffStepUpOptionsRequest {
  return StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse({ action: "import_ended_by_staff", target: { type: "import", id: importId }, params });
}

/** "End this import", confirmed by the key. Answers the case it was ended from as it now stands, which the page shows. */
export function endImportWithKey(deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike }, importId: string, params: ImportEndedByStaffParams) {
  const action = importEndAction(importId, params);
  return confirmWithKey(deps, action, (stepUp) => deps.api.endImport(action.target.id, { ...params, stepUp }, { activity: true }));
```

```ts
import type { ImportSource, SourceSummary } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The console's own words for what its screens count and name (3c design, section 8): lanes, waiting times, categories
 * and the bands of a source's summary. No screen prints a value an answer carried in a place where the console speaks
 * for itself: an enum is worded here, and a string a person wrote is shown as text in a frame.
 */

/** The queue's three lanes, as the home screen and the queue name them. */
export const LANE_NAMES = { 0: "Urgent", 1: "Lane 1", 2: "Lane 2" } as const;

/** "1 case", "2 cases". */
export const counted = (n: number, one: string, many: string): string => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

/** How long something has waited, coarsely: minutes under an hour, hours under two days, days after that. */
export function waited(since: string, now: number): string {
  const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - Date.parse(since)) / 60_000));
  if (minutes < 60) return counted(minutes, "minute", "minutes");
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 48) return counted(hours, "hour", "hours");
  return counted(Math.floor(hours / 24), "day", "days");
}

/** A Transparency Database category as a few plain words: "protection of minors" for STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS. */
export function categoryLabel(category: string): string {
  const words = category.replace(/^STATEMENT_CATEGORY_/, "").toLowerCase().split("_").join(" ");
  return words === "other violation tc" ? "other breach of the rules" : words;
}

/** The two rules whose texts open collapsed: what they are about, for the button that shows the text. */
export const COLLAPSED_RULES: Record<string, string> = { R3: "hatred or harassment", R5: "direct threats" };

const AGE: Record<NonNullable<SourceSummary["accountAge"]>, string> = { under_1_month: "under 1 month old", "1_to_12_months": "1 to 12 months old", over_12_months: "over 12 months old" };
const FILED: Record<NonNullable<SourceSummary["itemsFiled"]>, string> = { "1": "this is its only report", "2_to_9": "2 to 9 reports filed", "10_or_more": "10 or more reports filed" };
const ACTED: Record<NonNullable<SourceSummary["actedOn"]>, string> = {
  none_decided: "none decided yet",
  none: "none of the decided ones acted on",
  under_half: "under half of the decided ones acted on",
  half_or_more: "half or more of the decided ones acted on",
};
const UNSEEN: Record<NonNullable<SourceSummary["answeredUnseen"]>, string> = { none: "", "1": "1 answered without the images", "2_to_9": "2 to 9 answered without the images", "10_or_more": "10 or more answered without the images" };

/**
 * A source's summary in words, after its label: bands for a signed-in reporter, never a count; for a notifier what was
 * given and whether it is confirmed or stopped, never what; nothing more for an anonymous notice or a finding.
 */
export function sourceWords(source: SourceSummary): string {
  if (source.kind === "reporter") {
    const parts = [source.accountAge === null ? "" : `account ${AGE[source.accountAge]}`, source.itemsFiled === null ? "" : FILED[source.itemsFiled], source.actedOn === null ? "" : ACTED[source.actedOn]];
    if (source.answeredUnseen !== null) parts.push(UNSEEN[source.answeredUnseen]);
    return parts.filter((part) => part !== "").join("; ");
  }
  if (source.kind === "notifier") {
    if (source.contactLost) return "signed out; contact lost or forgotten";
    const parts = ["signed out", source.named ? "gave a name" : "gave no name", source.contactGiven ? "gave an address" : "gave no address"];
    if (source.contactGiven) parts.push(source.confirmed ? "address confirmed" : "address not confirmed");
    if (source.suppressed) parts.push("asked korbat to stop its emails");
    return parts.join("; ");
  }
  if (source.kind === "anonymous") return "a notice of child sexual abuse material records no sender";
  if (source.kind === "unlinked") return "the link to the account is no longer kept";
  return "";
}

/** Who a frame says wrote an item's words. */
export function writtenBy(source: SourceSummary): string {
  if (source.kind === "reporter") return `Written by ${source.label}`;
  if (source.kind === "authority") return "Written by an authority";
  if (source.kind === "unlinked") return "Written by a reporter no longer linked";
  return "Written by a notifier";
}

/** Whether "Reveal who sent this" is offered: only when the summary names someone, a linked reporter or a notifier who gave a name. */
export const revealable = (source: SourceSummary): boolean => source.kind === "reporter" || (source.kind === "notifier" && source.named === true && !source.contactLost);

/** The platforms an import comes from, as the label names them (3b design, section 10.9's import.source keys, short). */
const SOURCE_NAMES: Record<ImportSource, string> = { x: "X", mastodon: "Mastodon", bluesky: "Bluesky" };

/** The months as the label writes them: three letters each, so September is Sep wherever a browser's Intl writes Sept. */
const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] as const;

/** A day the API gives as YYYY-MM-DD, a UTC day, as "3 Mar 2019": read from its digits, never through the browser's zone. */
function shortDay(day: string): string {
  const [year, month, date] = day.split("-").map(Number);
  return `${date} ${MONTHS[(month ?? 1) - 1]} ${year}`;
}

/**
 * 3b (design, sections 8.4, 8.7 and 10.7; decision 30): an imported post's label, under the post's address on a case:
 * "Imported from X, dated 3 Mar 2019". Made from the post's own columns, the source and the archive's day, and nothing
 * else, so it never names the account elsewhere.
 */
export const importedLine = (source: ImportSource, day: string): string => `Imported from ${SOURCE_NAMES[source]}, dated ${shortDay(day)}`;

/**
 * The size of the import a case's post came from, the posts it published, and the day it was imported: "One of 1,240
 * posts imported together on 21 Oct 2026." An import of one post says so in its own words.
 */
export function importedSize(posts: number, importedAt: string): string {
  if (posts <= 1) return `The only post of its import, imported on ${shortDay(importedAt)}.`;
  return `One of ${new Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB").format(posts)} posts imported together on ${shortDay(importedAt)}.`;
}
```

```tsx
import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";
import { Link, router, useFocusEffect, useLocalSearchParams } from "expo-router";
import { PostId, type PostView, type ThreadResponse, type Tombstone } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { FOCUS_RING, dataAttribute } from "@/components/kit/interaction";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/kit/Skeleton";
import { Text } from "@/components/kit/Text";

import { IMPORT_WORDS } from "@/lib/import-words";

import { UI_WORDS } from "@/lib/ui-words";
import { cn } from "@/theme/cn";

/** A link of the status line: a 44 px target, as TextLink draws one. */
const LINE_LINK = cn("min-h-[44px] justify-center rounded-control active:opacity-70", FOCUS_RING);

/**
 * A post above the focused one, in the chain it replies to (UI design, section 8.3): a compact card joined to the next
 * by the 2 px thread line through the avatars; a post that is gone keeps its sentence, in the italic text face on a
 * surface-2 block, on the same line.
 */
function AncestorRow({ item }: { item: PostView | Tombstone }) {
  if (!("author" in item)) {
    return (
      <View className="px-4 pb-1 pt-3">
        <View className="rounded-media bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2.5">
          <Text tone="medium" italic>
            {item.deleted ? UI_WORDS["post.deleted"] : UI_WORDS["post.unavailable"]}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }
  return <PostCard post={item} joined />;
}

/**
 * 3b Task 7 (design, section 10.6): the author's line under their own imported post, which no Explore status needs to be
 * asked for: imported posts enter no feed on their own. It keeps the line's way to how Explore works.
 */
function ImportedExploreLine() {
  return (
    <View className="px-4 pb-2">
      <Text variant="meta" tone="medium">
        {IMPORT_WORDS["import.explore"]}
      </Text>
      <Link href="/explore/about" asChild>
        <Pressable className={cn(LINE_LINK, "self-start")}>
          <Text tone="accent" className="underline web:underline-offset-2">
            {EXPLORE_WORDS.about}
          </Text>
        </Pressable>
      </Link>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The author's line under their own post (2c design, section 11): whether it is in Explore and, if not, which rule keeps
 * it out, in the formula's words and without any count, with the way to the rules and to the switch. Until the answer
 * comes, and if it fails, there is no line: the post is the screen, and the line only explains. It is asked again every
 * time the screen gains focus: the web keeps this screen mounted under the ones it links to, and Back shows it again as
 * it was, so after the switch is turned through the line's own link the line would otherwise still give the old reason.
 */
function ExploreStatusLine({ id }: { id: string }) {
  // The line with the post it was read for: the same post's line stays while it is asked again, and another post's never shows.
  const [line, setLine] = useState<{ id: string; text: string | null } | null>(null);
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      let cancelled = false;
      social
        .exploreStatus(id)
        .then((answer) => {
          if (!cancelled) setLine({ id, text: exploreStatusText(answer.status) });
        })
        .catch(() => {
          if (!cancelled) setLine(null);
        });
      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
      };
    }, [id]),
  );

  const text = line?.id === id ? line.text : null;
  if (!text) return null;
  return (
    <View className="px-4 pb-2">
      <Text variant="meta" tone="medium">
        {text}
      </Text>
      <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-x-4">
        <Link href="/explore/about" asChild>
          <Pressable className={LINE_LINK}>
            <Text tone="accent" className="underline web:underline-offset-2">
              {EXPLORE_WORDS.about}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
        <Link href="/settings/privacy" asChild>
          <Pressable className={LINE_LINK}>
            <Text tone="accent" className="underline web:underline-offset-2">
              {UI_WORDS["thread.exploreSetting"]}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * A post with the chain it replies to above it and its direct replies below, oldest first. Under the focused post, the
 * reply card (Task 6) at every width: "Write your reply", opening in place on focus; `?reply=1`, which a card's Reply
 * gives, opens it at once with the focus in it, and the focused post's own Reply opens it too. A reply sent reads the
 * replies again (and the composer's toast says it was sent). `?quote=1` opens the quote sheet, whose post goes on top of
 * Home's feeds; its toast's View opens it, where today's code went to it at once.
 */
export default function Thread() {
  const { id, quote, reply } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string; quote?: string; reply?: string }>();
  const { state } = useSession();
  const viewer = state.status === "signed-in" && state.me.user.onboarded ? state.me.user.id : null;
  const signedIn = viewer !== null;
  const [thread, setThread] = useState<ThreadResponse | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const [quoting, setQuoting] = useState(quote === "1");
  const replyCard = useRef<ComposerCardHandle>(null);
  const title = usePageTitle("title.post");
  const missingTitle = usePageTitle("title.postMissing");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setThread(null);
    setError(null);
    // The id comes from the address bar; anything but a post id is refused before a request is built from it.
    if (!PostId.safeParse(id).success) {
      setError("That address is not a post.");
      return;
    }
    social
      .thread(id)
      .then((t) => {
        if (!cancelled) setThread(t);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(errorMessage(err));
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [id]);

  // The screen stays mounted under the ones it links to, and Back shows it again as it was: on every focus after the
  // first, the post is read again into the thread on screen, without clearing it, so its card (the In Explore chip
  // included) follows a change made there. An id's first focus comes with the read above.
  const focusedFor = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      if (focusedFor.current !== id) {
        focusedFor.current = id;
        return undefined;
      }
      // An address that is not a post has its error on screen already, and no request may be built from it.
      if (!PostId.safeParse(id).success) return undefined;
      let cancelled = false;
      social
        .getPost(id)
        .then((post) => {
          if (!cancelled) setThread((current) => (current && current.post.id === post.id ? { ...current, post } : current));
        })
        // What is on screen stays: the next focus asks again.
        .catch(() => undefined);
      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
      };
    }, [id]),
  );

  // A new `version` (a reply sent here) is a new source, which the list reads again from its first page; the list and its
  // header, where the reply card holds the focus, stay mounted.
  const fetchReplies = useCallback((cursor?: string) => social.thread(id, cursor).then((t) => t.replies), [id, version]);

  // The page opens with the focused post at the top of the view and its ancestors above it, kept there by the list's
  // anchor while they and the replies are drawn (section 7.5); a reply written here reads the replies again, not the post.
  const list = useRef<ListHandle>(null);
  const opened = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!thread || opened.current === thread.post.id || thread.ancestors.length === 0) return;
    opened.current = thread.post.id;
    list.current?.hold("focused");
  }, [thread]);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <AppShell>
        {missingTitle}
        <ScreenHeader title={UI_WORDS["thread.missing"]} back="/" />
        <HeaderSpace />
        <View className="items-start gap-2 px-4 py-6">
          <Text tone="medium">{error}</Text>
          <TextLink label={UI_WORDS["thread.back"]} href="/" replace />
        </View>
      </AppShell>
    );
  }
  if (!thread) {
    return (
      <AppShell>
        {title}
        <ScreenHeader title={UI_WORDS["thread.title"]} back="/" />
        <HeaderSpace />
        <Skeleton.List kind="posts" count={1} />
      </AppShell>
    );
  }

  const mine = viewer !== null && thread.post.author.id === viewer;
  const header = (
    <View>
      <View {...dataAttribute("thread")}>
        {thread.ancestors.map((item) => (
          <AncestorRow key={item.id} item={item} />
        ))}
        {/* The focused post, which the list holds at the top when the page opens. */}
        <View {...dataAttribute("row", "focused")} className="border-b border-line-low">
          <PostCard post={thread.post} large onDeleted={() => router.replace("/")} onReply={signedIn ? () => replyCard.current?.open() : undefined} />
          {/* Replies and quotes never enter Explore, so they get no line and no request. */}
          {mine && thread.post.replyTo === null && thread.post.quoteOf === null && thread.post.imported === null ? <ExploreStatusLine id={thread.post.id} /> : null}
          {/* 3b (10.6): the author's own imported post is never in Explore, which is known without asking /explore. */}
          {mine && thread.post.imported !== null ? <ImportedExploreLine /> : null}
          {signedIn ? (
            <View className="flex-row justify-end px-4 pb-3">
              <View className="-mt-6">
                <Button label={UI_WORDS["thread.quote"]} tone="secondary" full={false} onPress={() => setQuoting(true)} />
              </View>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </View>
      {signedIn ? (
        <View className="border-b border-line-low px-4 py-3">
          <ComposerCard
            key={thread.post.id}
            handle={replyCard}
            replyTo={thread.post}
            startOpen={reply === "1"}
            onPosted={() => {
              // The replies are read again; the focused post counts the new one at once, without reading the thread.
              setThread((current) => (current ? { ...current, post: { ...current.post, counts: { ...current.post.counts, replies: current.post.counts.replies + 1 } } } : current));
              setVersion((v) => v + 1);
            }}
          />
        </View>
      ) : (
        <View className="border-b border-line-low px-4 py-1">
          <TextLink label={UI_WORDS["thread.signIn"]} href="/signin" />
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <AppShell>
      {title}
      <ScreenHeader title={UI_WORDS["thread.title"]} back="/" />
      <PostList handle={list} fetchPage={fetchReplies} empty={UI_WORDS["thread.empty"]} header={header} />
      <ComposeSheet open={quoting} quoteOf={thread.post} onClose={() => setQuoting(false)} onPosted={(post) => insertPosted(viewer, post)} />
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { View } from "react-native";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, PublicFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RULES, RULES_CHANGES, RULES_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/AppShell";
import { DatedList, Heading, Paragraph, ProseList } from "@/components/Prose";
import { ScreenHeader, ScreenScroll } from "@/components/ScreenHeader";
import { TextLink } from "@/components/ui";
import { api } from "@/lib/api";
import { usePageTitle } from "@/lib/page-title";
import { PAGE_DOWN, RULES_PAGE, toolBlocks, type AutomationLimits } from "@/lib/public-pages";
import { MEASURES_PARAGRAPH, REPORTING_IN_BAD_FAITH, STRIKES, SUSPENSION, TERRORIST_CONTENT, termsParagraphs } from "@/lib/terms";

/** The sections the terms build from STANDING_RULES and ORDER_RULES, which this page prints with the same builders. */
const NUMBERED_SECTIONS: { title: string; body: string }[] = [
  { title: "Strikes", body: STRIKES },
  { title: "Suspension and termination", body: SUSPENSION },
  { title: "Reporting in bad faith", body: REPORTING_IN_BAD_FAITH },
  { title: "Terrorist content", body: TERRORIST_CONTENT },
];

/**
 * The rules page as it reads with the facts it was given (3d design, section 9.2; W.1): the rules in force, what korbat
 * can do and when, what each automated tool does in the state the running server reports, and the change log. While the
 * facts are on their way the automation section holds its lead alone; when the route did not answer (`"down"`) the fixed
 * texts stand and it reads [page.down]: the page never prints a tool as off or on without the route's answer. `limits` are the program's caps, printed once a tool that rates or
 * compares images is on (their constant comes with the automated decision, Task 6). UI Task 7 (section 8.9): the
 * page's title is the screen's ScreenHeader; here the lead, the sections in the reading layout of components/Prose.tsx,
 * each tool a card, and the change log a dated list.
 */
export function RulesView({ facts, limits = null }: { facts: PublicFacts | "loading" | "down"; limits?: AutomationLimits | null }) {
  const blocks = typeof facts === "string" ? [] : toolBlocks(facts);
  const anyImageTool = blocks.some((block) => (block.tool === "r1" || block.tool === "match") && block.on);
  return (
    <View>
      <Paragraph tone="high">{RULES_PAGE.lead}</Paragraph>

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.rulesHeading}</Heading>
      {RULES.map((rule) => (
        <View key={rule.id}>
          <Heading level={3}>{`${rule.id}: ${rule.title}`}</Heading>
          <Paragraph>{rule.text}</Paragraph>
          <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.allowed}</Paragraph>
          <ProseList label={`${rule.id}: ${RULES_PAGE.allowed}`} items={rule.allowed} />
          <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.notAllowed}</Paragraph>
          <ProseList label={`${rule.id}: ${RULES_PAGE.notAllowed}`} items={rule.notAllowed} />
        </View>
      ))}
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.law}</Paragraph>

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.measuresHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{MEASURES_PARAGRAPH}</Paragraph>
      {NUMBERED_SECTIONS.map((section) => (
        <View key={section.title}>
          <Heading level={3}>{section.title}</Heading>
          {termsParagraphs(section.body).map((paragraph, index) => (
            <Paragraph key={index}>{paragraph}</Paragraph>
          ))}
        </View>
      ))}

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.automationHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoLead}</Paragraph>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoImports}</Paragraph>
      {facts === "loading" ? null : facts === "down" ? (
        <Paragraph>{PAGE_DOWN}</Paragraph>
      ) : (
        <View>
          {blocks.map((block) => (
            <View key={block.tool} role="group" className="mt-4 rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1 px-4 pb-4">
              {block.paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => (
                <Paragraph key={index}>{paragraph}</Paragraph>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
          {anyImageTool ? (
            limits === null ? null : (
              <>
                <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoCap(limits)}</Paragraph>
                <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoTarget(limits.objectionTargetHours)}</Paragraph>
              </>
            )
          ) : (
            <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.autoNone}</Paragraph>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      <Heading level={2}>{RULES_PAGE.versionHeading}</Heading>
      <Paragraph>{RULES_PAGE.version(RULES_VERSION)}</Paragraph>
      <DatedList label={RULES_PAGE.versionHeading} entries={[...RULES_CHANGES].reverse().map((change) => ({ key: String(change.version), text: RULES_PAGE.change(change) }))} />

      <TextLink label={RULES_PAGE.transparencyLink} href="/transparency" />
      <TextLink label={RULES_PAGE.exploreLink} href="/explore/about" />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * /rules (3d design, sections 9.1 and 9.2), public, signed in or out: it reads no session for its content and sends one
 * GET, /api/public/facts, which the API answers no-cache, so the page prints what is switched on now.
 */
export default function RulesPage() {
  const [facts, setFacts] = useState<PublicFacts | "loading" | "down">("loading");
  const title = usePageTitle("title.rules");
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    api("/api/public/facts", { schema: PublicFacts })
      .then((answer) => {
        if (live) setFacts(answer);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (live) setFacts("down");
      });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);
  return (
    <AppShell>
      {title}
      <ScreenHeader title={RULES_PAGE.title} />
      <ScreenScroll screen="rules">
        {/* 3d Task 6: the program's caps and the target of an answer are the contracts' constants, which the database mirrors. */}
        <RulesView facts={facts} limits={AUTOMATION_RULES} />
      </ScreenScroll>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { UI_WORDS } from "@/lib/ui-words";

/**
 * The Settings index (UI design, section 8.8; the owner's ruling 10), which the nav's Settings item and a profile's
 * settings button open: one card of link rows, Appearance first, then Security, Privacy, Profile, Account, Import posts
 * and Cases, each with its icon and a chevron, so the page a newcomer looks for is the first thing Settings shows. It is
 * the one settings screen without the settings row, since it is the list; signed out the settings layout sends it to
 * sign-in. 3b Task 7 (design, section 10.1): Import posts says "Ready to review" while an import of the account waits in

 */
export default function SettingsIndex() {

  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let current = true;
    imports.list().then(
      (list) => {
        if (current) setReady(list.imports.some((found) => found.status === "ready"));
      },
      () => undefined,
    );

      current = false;
    };
  }, []);

    <AppShell>
      {title}
      <ScreenHeader title={UI_WORDS["settings.title"]} />
      <ScreenScroll screen="settings">
        {/* The card clips its rows to its corners, and the last row's divider goes under its border: one line closes it. */}
        <View className="mt-4 overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line-low bg-surface-1">
          <View className="-mb-px">
            {SETTINGS_PAGES.map(({ page, label, icon, row }) => (
              <ListRow key={page} label={row ?? label} icon={icon} href={`/settings/${page}`} value={page === "import" && ready ? IMPORT_WORDS["import.settings.ready"] : undefined} />

          </View>
        </View>
      </ScreenScroll>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Pressable, View } from "react-native";

import type { ProfileView } from "@korbat/contracts";
```
